package main

import (
        "flag"
        "fmt"
        "os"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/server"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

func main() {
        // Parse CLI flags
        // Go실행할때 port를 준다던지, 읽어준다는지 하는 거를 cli option으로 줌.
        // Viper가 다 해줌.
        var (
                configPath  = flag.String("config", "", "Path to configuration file")
                healthCheck = flag.Bool("health-check", false, "Perform health check and exit")
        )
        flag.Parse()

        // Load configuration
        cfg, err := config.Load(*configPath)
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to load configuration: %v\n", err)
                os.Exit(1)
        }

        // Initialize logger
        logger, err := logging.NewLogger(cfg.Logging)
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Failed to initialize logger: %v\n", err)
                os.Exit(1)
        }
        // 이 프로그램에서 이 로거를 전역으로 쓸것이다. 함수로 쓰면 불편하니까 어디서든 쓸수있게.
        logging.SetGlobal(logger)

        // Handle health check
        if *healthCheck {
                // TODO: Implement actual health check logic
                // For now, just check if we can load config and initialize logger
                logger.Info("Health check passed")
                os.Exit(0)
        }

        // Create and start server
        srv, err := server.New(cfg)
        if err != nil {
                logger.Error("Failed to create server", zap.Error(err))
                os.Exit(1)
        }

        if err := srv.Start(); err != nil {
                logger.Error("Server failed to start", zap.Error(err))
                os.Exit(1)
        }
}

func printDiffResult(result *protocol.DiffResponse) {
        if result == nil {
                fmt.Println("Result: nil")
                return
        }

        jsonData, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")

// Test 7: Package Integration Features
func testPackageIntegration() {
        fmt.Println("\n🔧 Test 7: Package Integration Features")

        // Create temporary directory for testing
        tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "integration-test-")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create temp dir: %v\n", err)
                return
        }
        defer func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(tempDir) }()

        // Create test config
        testConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(tempDir)
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create test config: %v\n", err)
                return
        }

        // Set as global config
        err = repository.SetGlobalConfig(testConfig)
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to set global config: %v\n", err)
                return
        }

        // Test high-level integration functions
        fmt.Println("\n🚀 High-Level Integration Functions:")

        // 1. GetAndValidateRepoPath
        path, err := repository.GetAndValidateRepoPath(testConfig, "integration", "test")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ GetAndValidateRepoPath failed: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("✅ GetAndValidateRepoPath: %s\n", path)
        }

        // 2. Create a mock repository for testing
        repoPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "integration", "valid-repo.git")
        err = createMockBareRepo(repoPath)
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create mock repo: %v\n", err)
                return
        }

        // 3. VerifyRepositoryAccess
        verifiedPath, err := repository.VerifyRepositoryAccess(testConfig, "integration", "valid-repo")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ VerifyRepositoryAccess failed: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("✅ VerifyRepositoryAccess: %s\n", verifiedPath)
        }

        // 4. GetRepositoryInfo
        info, err := repository.GetRepositoryInfo(testConfig, "integration", "valid-repo")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ GetRepositoryInfo failed: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("✅ Repository Info:\n")
                fmt.Printf("   Owner: %s\n", info.Owner)
                fmt.Printf("   Name: %s\n", info.Name)
                fmt.Printf("   Type: %s\n", info.Type)
                fmt.Printf("   Exists: %v\n", info.Exists)
                fmt.Printf("   IsValid: %v\n", info.IsValid)
                fmt.Printf("   IsAccessible: %v\n", info.IsAccessible)
        }

        // Test default configuration functions
        fmt.Println("\n🌐 Default Configuration Functions:")

        // Using global config
        defaultPath, err := repository.GetAndValidateRepoPathWithDefault("global", "test")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ GetAndValidateRepoPathWithDefault failed: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("✅ GetAndValidateRepoPathWithDefault: %s\n", defaultPath)
        }

        // Test batch operations
        fmt.Println("\n📦 Batch Operations:")

        // Create multiple test repositories
        _ = createMockNonBareRepo(filepath.Join(tempDir, "batch", "repo1.git"))

        repos := []struct{ Owner, Repo string }{
                {"integration", "valid-repo"},
                {"batch", "repo1"},
                {"missing", "repo"},
                {"../malicious", "attack"},
        }

        batchInfo := repository.GetBatchRepositoryInfo(testConfig, repos)
        fmt.Printf("✅ Batch Repository Info:\n")
        fmt.Printf("   Total: %d\n", batchInfo.TotalCount)
        fmt.Printf("   Valid: %d\n", batchInfo.ValidCount)
        fmt.Printf("   Errors: %d\n", batchInfo.ErrorCount)

        for i, repo := range batchInfo.Repositories {
                fmt.Printf("   [%d] %s/%s: exists=%v, valid=%v, accessible=%v\n",
                        i+1, repo.Owner, repo.Name, repo.Exists, repo.IsValid, repo.IsAccessible)
        }

        // Test error handling
        fmt.Println("\n🚫 Error Handling:")

        // Try invalid path
        _, err = repository.GetAndValidateRepoPath(testConfig, "../invalid", "repo")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("✅ CORRECTLY BLOCKED invalid path: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: Invalid path was allowed!\n")
        }

        // Try non-existent repository access
        _, err = repository.VerifyRepositoryAccess(testConfig, "missing", "repo")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("✅ CORRECTLY BLOCKED missing repo access: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: Missing repo access was allowed!\n")
        }
}

func main() {
        fmt.Println("🧪 Manual Testing: Repository Path Management")
        fmt.Println(strings.Repeat("=", 50))

        // Test 1: Path Configuration
        fmt.Println("\n📁 Test 1: Path Configuration")
        config, err := repository.NewPathConfig("/var/lib/git/repos")
        if err != nil {
                log.Fatalf("❌ Failed to create path config: %v", err)
        }
        fmt.Printf("✅ Created config with root: %s\n", config.GetRepoRoot())

        // Test 2: Valid Path Generation
        fmt.Println("\n🛣️  Test 2: Valid Path Generation")
        testCases := []struct {
                owner, repo string
                description string
        }{
                {"jaemin", "collabops", "Standard repository"},
                {"user-name", "project-123", "Hyphens and numbers"},
                {"org_name", "complex_project", "Underscores"},
        }

        for _, tc := range testCases {
                path, err := repository.GetRepoPath(config, tc.owner, tc.repo)
                if err != nil {
                        fmt.Printf("❌ %s: %v\n", tc.description, err)
                } else {
                        fmt.Printf("✅ %s: %s\n", tc.description, path)
                }
        }

        // Test 3: Path Validation
        fmt.Println("\n🔒 Test 3: Path Validation (Security)")
        validPaths := []string{
                "/var/lib/git/repos/user/project.git",
                "/var/lib/git/repos/organization/complex-name.git",
        }

        invalidPaths := []string{
                "/tmp/malicious/repo.git",                // Outside root
                "/var/lib/git/repos/../../../etc/passwd", // Path traversal
                "/var/lib/git/repos",                     // Repository root
                "/var/lib/git/repos/user",                // Missing structure
                "/var/lib/git/repos/user/project",        // Missing .git
        }

        fmt.Println("\n✅ Valid paths:")
        for _, path := range validPaths {
                err := repository.ValidateRepoPath(config, path)
                if err != nil {
                        fmt.Printf("❌ UNEXPECTED: %s -> %v\n", path, err)
                } else {
                        fmt.Printf("✅ %s\n", path)
                }
        }

        fmt.Println("\n🚫 Invalid paths (should be blocked):")
        for _, path := range invalidPaths {
                err := repository.ValidateRepoPath(config, path)
                if err != nil {
                        fmt.Printf("✅ BLOCKED: %s -> %v\n", path, err)
                } else {
                        fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: %s was allowed!\n", path)
                }
        }

        // Test 4: Attack Prevention
        fmt.Println("\n🛡️  Test 4: Security Attack Prevention")
        attackVectors := []struct {
                owner, repo string
                description string
        }{
                {"../malicious", "repo", "Path traversal in owner"},
                {"user", "project/../hack", "Path traversal in repo"},
                {"/root", "project", "Absolute path in owner"},
                {"user", "/etc/passwd", "Absolute path in repo"},
                {"user*", "project", "Invalid character (asterisk)"},
                {"user", "project?", "Invalid character (question mark)"},
                {"CON", "project", "Windows reserved name"},
                {"user", "aux", "Windows reserved name (lowercase)"},
        }

        for _, attack := range attackVectors {
                _, err := repository.GetRepoPath(config, attack.owner, attack.repo)
                if err != nil {
                        fmt.Printf("✅ BLOCKED: %s -> %v\n", attack.description, err)
                } else {
                        fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: %s was allowed!\n", attack.description)
                }
        }

        // Test 5: Default Configuration
        fmt.Println("\n⚙️  Test 5: Default Configuration")
        defaultPath, err := repository.GetRepoPathWithDefault("example", "project")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Default config failed: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("✅ Default config path: %s\n", defaultPath)
        }

        // Test 6: Repository Existence Checking
        fmt.Println("\n📁 Test 6: Repository Existence Checking")

        // Create temporary directory for testing
        tempDir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "git-repo-test-")
        if err != nil {
                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create temp dir: %v\n", err)
        } else {
                defer func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(tempDir) }()

                // Create test config
                testConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(tempDir)
                if err != nil {
                        fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create test config: %v\n", err)
                } else {
                        // Test non-existent repository
                        nonExistentPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "user", "missing.git")
                        err = repository.EnsureRepoExists(testConfig, nonExistentPath)
                        if err != nil {
                                fmt.Printf("✅ CORRECTLY BLOCKED non-existent repo: %v\n", err)
                        } else {
                                fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: Non-existent repo was allowed!\n")
                        }

                        // Create a mock Git repository structure (bare)
                        bareRepoPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "user", "bare-repo.git")
                        err = createMockBareRepo(bareRepoPath)
                        if err != nil {
                                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create mock repo: %v\n", err)
                        } else {
                                err = repository.EnsureRepoExists(testConfig, bareRepoPath)
                                if err != nil {
                                        fmt.Printf("❌ UNEXPECTED: Valid bare repo rejected: %v\n", err)
                                } else {
                                        fmt.Printf("✅ Valid bare repository accepted: %s\n", bareRepoPath)
                                }
                        }

                        // Create a mock non-bare repository
                        nonBareRepoPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "user", "regular-repo.git")
                        err = createMockNonBareRepo(nonBareRepoPath)
                        if err != nil {
                                fmt.Printf("❌ Failed to create mock non-bare repo: %v\n", err)
                        } else {
                                err = repository.EnsureRepoExists(testConfig, nonBareRepoPath)
                                if err != nil {
                                        fmt.Printf("❌ UNEXPECTED: Valid non-bare repo rejected: %v\n", err)
                                } else {
                                        fmt.Printf("✅ Valid non-bare repository accepted: %s\n", nonBareRepoPath)
                                }
                        }

                        // Test invalid repository (empty directory)
                        invalidRepoPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "user", "invalid.git")
                        _ = os.MkdirAll(invalidRepoPath, 0755)
                        err = repository.EnsureRepoExists(testConfig, invalidRepoPath)
                        if err != nil {
                                fmt.Printf("✅ CORRECTLY BLOCKED invalid repo: %v\n", err)
                        } else {
                                fmt.Printf("❌ SECURITY ISSUE: Invalid repo was allowed!\n")
                        }
                }
        }

        // Test 7: Package Integration Features
        testPackageIntegration()

        fmt.Println("\n🎉 Complete package integration testing finished!")
}

// Helper functions to create mock Git repositories for testing

func createMockBareRepo(repoPath string) error {
        // Create directory structure
        if err := os.MkdirAll(repoPath, 0755); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Create required directories
        dirs := []string{"refs", "refs/heads", "refs/tags", "objects", "objects/info", "objects/pack"}
        for _, dir := range dirs {
                if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(repoPath, dir), 0755); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // Create required files
        files := map[string]string{
                "HEAD":        "ref: refs/heads/main\n",
                "config":      "[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = true\n",
                "description": "Unnamed repository; edit this file 'description' to name the repository.\n",
        }

        for filename, content := range files {
                if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(repoPath, filename), []byte(content), 0644); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        return nil
}

func createMockNonBareRepo(repoPath string) error {
        // Create directory structure
        if err := os.MkdirAll(repoPath, 0755); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Create .git directory
        gitDir := filepath.Join(repoPath, ".git")
        if err := os.MkdirAll(gitDir, 0755); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Create required directories inside .git
        dirs := []string{"refs", "refs/heads", "refs/tags", "objects", "objects/info", "objects/pack"}
        for _, dir := range dirs {
                if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(gitDir, dir), 0755); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // Create required files inside .git
        files := map[string]string{
                "HEAD":        "ref: refs/heads/main\n",
                "config":      "[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = false\n",
                "description": "Unnamed repository; edit this file 'description' to name the repository.\n",
        }

        for filename, content := range files {
                if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(gitDir, filename), []byte(content), 0644); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// Package api provides error mapping functionality to convert go-git errors into standardized API errors.
// This file handles the mapping of various go-git and related library errors to GitAPIError instances.
package api

import (
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "strings"

        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
)

// GitErrorMapper provides functionality to map go-git errors to API errors
type GitErrorMapper struct{}

// NewGitErrorMapper creates a new Git error mapper instance
func NewGitErrorMapper() *GitErrorMapper {
        return &GitErrorMapper{}
}

// MapError converts a go-git error into a GitAPIError
func (m *GitErrorMapper) MapError(err error, operation string) *GitAPIError {
        if err == nil {
                return nil
        }

        var apiErr *GitAPIError

        // Try to map specific go-git errors first
        if apiErr = m.mapGoGitErrors(err); apiErr != nil {
                apiErr.Operation = operation
                return apiErr
        }

        // Try to map plumbing errors
        if apiErr = m.mapPlumbingErrors(err); apiErr != nil {
                apiErr.Operation = operation
                return apiErr
        }

        // Try to map object errors
        if apiErr = m.mapObjectErrors(err); apiErr != nil {
                apiErr.Operation = operation
                return apiErr
        }

        // Try to map filesystem errors
        if apiErr = m.mapFilesystemErrors(err); apiErr != nil {
                apiErr.Operation = operation
                return apiErr
        }

        // Try to map by error message patterns
        if apiErr = m.mapByErrorMessage(err); apiErr != nil {
                apiErr.Operation = operation
                return apiErr
        }

        // Fallback to generic internal error
        apiErr = NewInternalError(fmt.Sprintf("Unexpected error: %v", err))
        apiErr.Operation = operation
        apiErr.Cause = err
        return apiErr
}

// mapGoGitErrors maps errors from the main git package
func (m *GitErrorMapper) mapGoGitErrors(err error) *GitAPIError {
        switch err {
        case git.ErrRepositoryNotExists:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound, "Repository does not exist", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrRepositoryAlreadyExists:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Repository already exists", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrRemoteNotFound:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeNotFound, "Remote not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrBranchExists:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBranchExists, "Branch already exists", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrBranchNotFound:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBranchNotFound, "Branch not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrTagExists:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Tag already exists", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrTagNotFound:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeNotFound, "Tag not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrInvalidReference:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeInvalidReference, "Invalid reference", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrForceNeeded:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Force push required", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrEmptyCommit:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBadRequest, "Empty commit not allowed", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrWorktreeNotClean:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Working tree is not clean", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrUnstagedChanges:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Unstaged changes present", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrNonFastForwardUpdate:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeConflict, "Non-fast-forward update", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case git.ErrDeleteRefNotSupported:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeOperationNotSupported, "Delete reference not supported", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        default:
                return nil // Not a recognized go-git error
        }
}

// mapPlumbingErrors maps errors from the plumbing package
func (m *GitErrorMapper) mapPlumbingErrors(err error) *GitAPIError {
        switch err {
        case plumbing.ErrObjectNotFound:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeNotFound, "Git object not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        case plumbing.ErrInvalidType:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBadRequest, "Invalid object type", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        default:
                return nil // Not a recognized plumbing error
        }
}

// mapObjectErrors maps errors from the object package
func (m *GitErrorMapper) mapObjectErrors(err error) *GitAPIError {
        switch err {
        case object.ErrFileNotFound:
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeFileNotFound, "File not found in tree", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        default:
                return nil // Not a recognized object error
        }
}

// mapFilesystemErrors maps filesystem-related errors
func (m *GitErrorMapper) mapFilesystemErrors(err error) *GitAPIError {
        if os.IsNotExist(err) {
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound, "Repository or path not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }
        if os.IsPermission(err) {
                apiErr := NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodePermissionDenied, "Permission denied", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }
        return nil // Not a recognized filesystem error
}

// mapByErrorMessage maps errors based on error message patterns
func (m *GitErrorMapper) mapByErrorMessage(err error) *GitAPIError {
        errMsg := err.Error()
        lowerMsg := strings.ToLower(errMsg)

        var apiErr *GitAPIError

        // Repository-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "repository not found") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "no such file or directory") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "repository does not exist") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound, "Repository not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Reference-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "reference not found") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "ref not found") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeReferenceNotFound, "Reference not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Branch-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "branch") && strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "not found") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBranchNotFound, "Branch not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Commit-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "commit") && strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "not found") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeCommitNotFound, "Commit not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // File-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "file not found") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "path not found") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeFileNotFound, "File not found", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Permission-related errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "permission denied") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "access denied") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodePermissionDenied, "Permission denied", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Path traversal and security
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "path traversal") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "invalid path") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodePathTraversal, "Invalid or unsafe path", ErrorSeverityCritical)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Merge conflicts
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "merge conflict") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "conflict") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeMergeConflict, "Merge conflict detected", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Corruption and integrity
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "corrupt") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "integrity") ||
                strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "checksum") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeRepositoryCorrupted, "Repository corruption detected", ErrorSeverityHigh)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Size and limits
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "too large") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "too big") ||
                strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "size limit") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeFileTooBig, "File or object too large", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Invalid format or content
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "invalid format") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "malformed") ||
                strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "bad format") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBadRequest, "Invalid format or content", ErrorSeverityLow)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        // Network and timeout errors
        if strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "timeout") || strings.Contains(lowerMsg, "connection") {
                apiErr = NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeInternalError, "Network or timeout error", ErrorSeverityMedium)
                apiErr.Cause = err
                return apiErr
        }

        return nil // No pattern matched
}

// MapErrorWithContext is a convenience method that includes additional context
func (m *GitErrorMapper) MapErrorWithContext(err error, operation, resource string) *GitAPIError {
        if err == nil {
                return nil
        }

        apiErr := m.MapError(err, operation)
        if resource != "" {
                apiErr.Resource = resource
        }

        return apiErr
}

// MapErrorWithDetails is a convenience method that includes additional details
func (m *GitErrorMapper) MapErrorWithDetails(err error, operation string, details map[string]interface{}) *GitAPIError {
        if err == nil {
                return nil
        }

        apiErr := m.MapError(err, operation)

        // Add each detail
        if apiErr.Details == nil {
                apiErr.Details = make(map[string]interface{})
        }
        for key, value := range details {
                apiErr.Details[key] = value
        }

        return apiErr
}

// GetDefaultMapper returns a default instance of GitErrorMapper
func GetDefaultMapper() *GitErrorMapper {
        return &GitErrorMapper{}
}

// Package api provides error handling and response framework for Git REST API operations.
// This package defines standardized error structures, response formats, and error mapping utilities.
package api

import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "time"
)

// ErrorCode represents standardized error codes for Git API operations
type ErrorCode string

const (
        // Generic error codes
        ErrorCodeInternalError    ErrorCode = "internal_error"
        ErrorCodeBadRequest       ErrorCode = "bad_request"
        ErrorCodeUnauthorized     ErrorCode = "unauthorized"
        ErrorCodeForbidden        ErrorCode = "forbidden"
        ErrorCodeNotFound         ErrorCode = "not_found"
        ErrorCodeConflict         ErrorCode = "conflict"
        ErrorCodeValidationFailed ErrorCode = "validation_failed"
        ErrorCodeRateLimited      ErrorCode = "rate_limited"

        // Git-specific error codes
        ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound    ErrorCode = "repository_not_found"
        ErrorCodeBranchNotFound        ErrorCode = "branch_not_found"
        ErrorCodeCommitNotFound        ErrorCode = "commit_not_found"
        ErrorCodeFileNotFound          ErrorCode = "file_not_found"
        ErrorCodeReferenceNotFound     ErrorCode = "reference_not_found"
        ErrorCodeInvalidReference      ErrorCode = "invalid_reference"
        ErrorCodeInvalidCommit         ErrorCode = "invalid_commit"
        ErrorCodeMergeConflict         ErrorCode = "merge_conflict"
        ErrorCodeBranchExists          ErrorCode = "branch_exists"
        ErrorCodeFileExists            ErrorCode = "file_exists"
        ErrorCodeInvalidPath           ErrorCode = "invalid_path"
        ErrorCodePathTraversal         ErrorCode = "path_traversal"
        ErrorCodeFileTooBig            ErrorCode = "file_too_big"
        ErrorCodeInvalidFileContent    ErrorCode = "invalid_file_content"
        ErrorCodeRepositoryCorrupted   ErrorCode = "repository_corrupted"
        ErrorCodeOperationNotSupported ErrorCode = "operation_not_supported"

        // Permission and security error codes
        ErrorCodePermissionDenied   ErrorCode = "permission_denied"
        ErrorCodeInsufficientAccess ErrorCode = "insufficient_access"
        ErrorCodeSecurityViolation  ErrorCode = "security_violation"
)

// ErrorSeverity represents the severity level of an error
type ErrorSeverity string

const (
        ErrorSeverityLow      ErrorSeverity = "low"
        ErrorSeverityMedium   ErrorSeverity = "medium"
        ErrorSeverityHigh     ErrorSeverity = "high"
        ErrorSeverityCritical ErrorSeverity = "critical"
)

// GitAPIError represents a standardized error for Git API operations
type GitAPIError struct {
        // Code is the standardized error code
        Code ErrorCode `json:"code"`
        // Message is the human-readable error message
        Message string `json:"message"`
        // Details provides additional context about the error
        Details map[string]interface{} `json:"details,omitempty"`
        // Severity indicates the severity level of the error
        Severity ErrorSeverity `json:"severity"`
        // Timestamp when the error occurred
        Timestamp time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
        // TraceID for correlation across services
        TraceID string `json:"trace_id,omitempty"`
        // RequestID for tracking specific requests
        RequestID string `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
        // Operation that caused the error
        Operation string `json:"operation,omitempty"`
        // Resource that was being accessed
        Resource string `json:"resource,omitempty"`
        // Underlying error (not serialized)
        Cause error `json:"-"`
}

// Error implements the error interface
func (e *GitAPIError) Error() string {
        if e.Operation != "" && e.Resource != "" {
                return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (operation: %s, resource: %s)", e.Code, e.Message, e.Operation, e.Resource)
        }
        if e.Operation != "" {
                return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (operation: %s)", e.Code, e.Message, e.Operation)
        }
        return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", e.Code, e.Message)
}

// Unwrap returns the underlying error for error chain compatibility
func (e *GitAPIError) Unwrap() error {
        return e.Cause
}

// Is implements error identity checking
func (e *GitAPIError) Is(target error) bool {
        var gitErr *GitAPIError
        if errors.As(target, &gitErr) {
                return e.Code == gitErr.Code
        }
        return false
}

// WithDetails adds additional context details to the error
func (e *GitAPIError) WithDetails(key string, value interface{}) GitAPIErrorInterface {
        if e.Details == nil {
                e.Details = make(map[string]interface{})
        }
        e.Details[key] = value
        return e
}

// WithTrace adds trace and request IDs for correlation
func (e *GitAPIError) WithTrace(traceID, requestID string) GitAPIErrorInterface {
        e.TraceID = traceID
        e.RequestID = requestID
        return e
}

// WithOperation sets the operation context
func (e *GitAPIError) WithOperation(operation string) GitAPIErrorInterface {
        e.Operation = operation
        return e
}

// WithResource sets the resource context
func (e *GitAPIError) WithResource(resource string) GitAPIErrorInterface {
        e.Resource = resource
        return e
}

// WithCause sets the underlying error cause
func (e *GitAPIError) WithCause(cause error) GitAPIErrorInterface {
        e.Cause = cause
        return e
}

// HTTPStatusCode returns the appropriate HTTP status code for the error
func (e *GitAPIError) HTTPStatusCode() int {
        switch e.Code {
        case ErrorCodeBadRequest, ErrorCodeValidationFailed, ErrorCodeInvalidPath,
                ErrorCodeInvalidReference, ErrorCodeInvalidCommit, ErrorCodePathTraversal,
                ErrorCodeInvalidFileContent:
                return http.StatusBadRequest
        case ErrorCodeUnauthorized:
                return http.StatusUnauthorized
        case ErrorCodeForbidden, ErrorCodePermissionDenied, ErrorCodeInsufficientAccess,
                ErrorCodeSecurityViolation:
                return http.StatusForbidden
        case ErrorCodeNotFound, ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound, ErrorCodeBranchNotFound,
                ErrorCodeCommitNotFound, ErrorCodeFileNotFound, ErrorCodeReferenceNotFound:
                return http.StatusNotFound
        case ErrorCodeConflict, ErrorCodeMergeConflict, ErrorCodeBranchExists, ErrorCodeFileExists:
                return http.StatusConflict
        case ErrorCodeFileTooBig:
                return http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge
        case ErrorCodeRateLimited:
                return http.StatusTooManyRequests
        case ErrorCodeOperationNotSupported:
                return http.StatusNotImplemented
        default:
                return http.StatusInternalServerError
        }
}

// GitAPIErrorInterface defines the interface for Git API errors
type GitAPIErrorInterface interface {
        error
        // GetCode returns the error code
        GetCode() ErrorCode
        // GetMessage returns the error message
        GetMessage() string
        // GetDetails returns additional error details
        GetDetails() map[string]interface{}
        // GetSeverity returns the error severity
        GetSeverity() ErrorSeverity
        // HTTPStatusCode returns the appropriate HTTP status code
        HTTPStatusCode() int
        // WithDetails adds additional context
        WithDetails(key string, value interface{}) GitAPIErrorInterface
        // WithTrace adds correlation IDs
        WithTrace(traceID, requestID string) GitAPIErrorInterface
        // WithOperation sets operation context
        WithOperation(operation string) GitAPIErrorInterface
        // WithResource sets resource context
        WithResource(resource string) GitAPIErrorInterface
        // WithCause sets underlying error
        WithCause(cause error) GitAPIErrorInterface
}

// Ensure GitAPIError implements GitAPIErrorInterface
var _ GitAPIErrorInterface = (*GitAPIError)(nil)

// Interface implementation methods
func (e *GitAPIError) GetCode() ErrorCode {
        return e.Code
}

func (e *GitAPIError) GetMessage() string {
        return e.Message
}

func (e *GitAPIError) GetDetails() map[string]interface{} {
        return e.Details
}

func (e *GitAPIError) GetSeverity() ErrorSeverity {
        return e.Severity
}

// NewGitAPIError creates a new GitAPIError with the specified code and message
func NewGitAPIError(code ErrorCode, message string, severity ErrorSeverity) *GitAPIError {
        return &GitAPIError{
                Code:      code,
                Message:   message,
                Severity:  severity,
                Timestamp: time.Now(),
                Details:   make(map[string]interface{}),
        }
}

// Predefined error constructors for common scenarios

// NewInternalError creates an internal server error
func NewInternalError(message string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeInternalError, message, ErrorSeverityHigh)
}

// NewBadRequestError creates a bad request error
func NewBadRequestError(message string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBadRequest, message, ErrorSeverityLow)
}

// NewNotFoundError creates a not found error
func NewNotFoundError(resource, message string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeNotFound, message, ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(resource).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewValidationError creates a validation error
func NewValidationError(message string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeValidationFailed, message, ErrorSeverityLow)
}

// NewPermissionError creates a permission denied error
func NewPermissionError(operation, resource string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodePermissionDenied,
                fmt.Sprintf("Permission denied for %s on %s", operation, resource),
                ErrorSeverityMedium).
                WithOperation(operation).
                WithResource(resource).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewRepositoryNotFoundError creates a repository not found error
func NewRepositoryNotFoundError(owner, repo string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeRepositoryNotFound,
                fmt.Sprintf("Repository %s/%s not found", owner, repo),
                ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo)).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewBranchNotFoundError creates a branch not found error
func NewBranchNotFoundError(branch string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeBranchNotFound,
                fmt.Sprintf("Branch '%s' not found", branch),
                ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(branch).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewCommitNotFoundError creates a commit not found error
func NewCommitNotFoundError(commit string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeCommitNotFound,
                fmt.Sprintf("Commit '%s' not found", commit),
                ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(commit).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewFileNotFoundError creates a file not found error
func NewFileNotFoundError(path string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeFileNotFound,
                fmt.Sprintf("File '%s' not found", path),
                ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(path).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewMergeConflictError creates a merge conflict error
func NewMergeConflictError(source, target string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeMergeConflict,
                fmt.Sprintf("Merge conflict between '%s' and '%s'", source, target),
                ErrorSeverityMedium).
                WithDetails("source", source).
                WithDetails("target", target).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewPathTraversalError creates a path traversal security error
func NewPathTraversalError(path string) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodePathTraversal,
                fmt.Sprintf("Path traversal detected: %s", path),
                ErrorSeverityCritical).
                WithResource(path).(*GitAPIError)
}

// NewFileTooBigError creates a file too big error
func NewFileTooBigError(path string, size, maxSize int64) *GitAPIError {
        return NewGitAPIError(ErrorCodeFileTooBig,
                fmt.Sprintf("File '%s' is too big (%d bytes), maximum allowed: %d bytes", path, size, maxSize),
                ErrorSeverityLow).
                WithResource(path).
                WithDetails("size", size).
                WithDetails("max_size", maxSize).(*GitAPIError)
}

// Package api provides HTTP response handling utilities and middleware for standardized API responses.
// This file contains response formatting, JSON error middleware, and helper functions for consistent output.
package api

import (
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// APIResponse represents a standardized API response structure
type APIResponse struct {
        // Success indicates if the operation was successful
        Success bool `json:"success"`
        // Message provides a human-readable description
        Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
        // Data contains the response payload (only for successful responses)
        Data interface{} `json:"data,omitempty"`
        // Error contains error information (only for error responses)
        Error *ErrorResponse `json:"error,omitempty"`
        // Meta contains metadata about the response
        Meta *ResponseMeta `json:"meta,omitempty"`
        // Timestamp when the response was generated
        Timestamp time.Time `json:"timestamp"`
}

// ErrorResponse represents error information in API responses
type ErrorResponse struct {
        // Code is the standardized error code
        Code string `json:"code"`
        // Message is the human-readable error message
        Message string `json:"message"`
        // Details provides additional context about the error
        Details map[string]interface{} `json:"details,omitempty"`
        // Severity indicates the severity level of the error
        Severity string `json:"severity,omitempty"`
        // TraceID for correlation across services
        TraceID string `json:"trace_id,omitempty"`
        // RequestID for tracking specific requests
        RequestID string `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
        // Operation that caused the error
        Operation string `json:"operation,omitempty"`
        // Resource that was being accessed
        Resource string `json:"resource,omitempty"`
}

// ResponseMeta contains metadata about the API response
type ResponseMeta struct {
        // RequestID for correlation
        RequestID string `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
        // Duration of the operation in milliseconds
        Duration int64 `json:"duration_ms,omitempty"`
        // Version of the API
        Version string `json:"version,omitempty"`
        // Pagination information for paginated responses
        Pagination *PaginationMeta `json:"pagination,omitempty"`
}

// PaginationMeta contains pagination information
type PaginationMeta struct {
        // Page is the current page number (1-based)
        Page int `json:"page"`
        // PageSize is the number of items per page
        PageSize int `json:"page_size"`
        // Total is the total number of items
        Total int `json:"total"`
        // TotalPages is the total number of pages
        TotalPages int `json:"total_pages"`
        // HasNext indicates if there are more pages
        HasNext bool `json:"has_next"`
        // HasPrev indicates if there are previous pages
        HasPrev bool `json:"has_prev"`
}

// JSONResponseMiddleware provides standardized JSON response handling
type JSONResponseMiddleware struct {
        logger  *logging.Logger
        version string
}

// NewJSONResponseMiddleware creates a new JSON response middleware instance
func NewJSONResponseMiddleware(logger *logging.Logger, version string) *JSONResponseMiddleware {
        if logger == nil {
                // Use a default logger if none provided
                cfg := config.LoggingConfig{Level: "info", Format: "text", Output: "stderr"}
                logger, _ = logging.NewLogger(cfg)
        }
        if version == "" {
                version = "1.0"
        }

        return &JSONResponseMiddleware{
                logger:  logger,
                version: version,
        }
}

// ErrorHandler is the main middleware function for handling errors
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) ErrorHandler() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                c.Next()

                // Process any errors that occurred during the request
                if len(c.Errors) > 0 {
                        err := c.Errors.Last()

                        // Get request start time for duration calculation
                        startTime, exists := c.Get("start_time")
                        var duration int64
                        if exists {
                                if start, ok := startTime.(time.Time); ok {
                                        duration = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
                                }
                        }

                        // Extract request ID if available
                        requestID, _ := c.Get("request_id")
                        requestIDStr, _ := requestID.(string)

                        // Handle different error types
                        switch err.Type {
                        case gin.ErrorTypePublic:
                                m.handlePublicError(c, err, requestIDStr, duration)
                        case gin.ErrorTypeBind:
                                m.handleBindError(c, err, requestIDStr, duration)
                        default:
                                m.handleInternalError(c, err, requestIDStr, duration)
                        }
                }
        }
}

// handlePublicError handles publicly safe errors
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) handlePublicError(c *gin.Context, ginErr *gin.Error, requestID string, duration int64) {
        // Check if the error is a GitAPIError
        if apiErr, ok := ginErr.Err.(*GitAPIError); ok {
                m.SendErrorResponse(c, apiErr, requestID, duration)
                return
        }

        // For other public errors, create a generic API error
        apiErr := NewBadRequestError(ginErr.Error())
        apiErr.RequestID = requestID
        m.SendErrorResponse(c, apiErr, requestID, duration)
}

// handleBindError handles request binding errors
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) handleBindError(c *gin.Context, ginErr *gin.Error, requestID string, duration int64) {
        apiErr := NewValidationError("Invalid request format or missing required fields")
        apiErr.RequestID = requestID
        apiErr.Details = map[string]interface{}{
                "bind_error": ginErr.Error(),
        }
        m.SendErrorResponse(c, apiErr, requestID, duration)
}

// handleInternalError handles internal server errors
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) handleInternalError(c *gin.Context, ginErr *gin.Error, requestID string, duration int64) {
        // Log the full error for internal tracking
        m.logger.Error("Internal server error",
                zap.String("error", ginErr.Error()),
                zap.String("request_id", requestID),
                zap.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
                zap.String("method", c.Request.Method),
        )

        // Send a generic internal error response (don't expose internal details)
        apiErr := NewInternalError("An internal server error occurred")
        apiErr.RequestID = requestID
        m.SendErrorResponse(c, apiErr, requestID, duration)
}

// SendSuccessResponse sends a standardized success response
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) SendSuccessResponse(c *gin.Context, data interface{}, message string) {
        // Get request metadata
        requestID, _ := c.Get("request_id")
        requestIDStr, _ := requestID.(string)

        startTime, exists := c.Get("start_time")
        var duration int64
        if exists {
                if start, ok := startTime.(time.Time); ok {
                        duration = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
                }
        }

        response := APIResponse{
                Success:   true,
                Message:   message,
                Data:      data,
                Timestamp: time.Now(),
                Meta: &ResponseMeta{
                        RequestID: requestIDStr,
                        Duration:  duration,
                        Version:   m.version,
                },
        }

        c.JSON(http.StatusOK, response)
}

// SendSuccessResponseWithPagination sends a paginated success response
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) SendSuccessResponseWithPagination(c *gin.Context, data interface{}, pagination *PaginationMeta, message string) {
        // Get request metadata
        requestID, _ := c.Get("request_id")
        requestIDStr, _ := requestID.(string)

        startTime, exists := c.Get("start_time")
        var duration int64
        if exists {
                if start, ok := startTime.(time.Time); ok {
                        duration = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
                }
        }

        response := APIResponse{
                Success:   true,
                Message:   message,
                Data:      data,
                Timestamp: time.Now(),
                Meta: &ResponseMeta{
                        RequestID:  requestIDStr,
                        Duration:   duration,
                        Version:    m.version,
                        Pagination: pagination,
                },
        }

        c.JSON(http.StatusOK, response)
}

// SendErrorResponse sends a standardized error response
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) SendErrorResponse(c *gin.Context, apiErr *GitAPIError, requestID string, duration int64) {
        errorResponse := &ErrorResponse{
                Code:      string(apiErr.Code),
                Message:   apiErr.Message,
                Details:   apiErr.Details,
                Severity:  string(apiErr.Severity),
                TraceID:   apiErr.TraceID,
                RequestID: apiErr.RequestID,
                Operation: apiErr.Operation,
                Resource:  apiErr.Resource,
        }

        // Use provided request ID if the error doesn't have one
        if errorResponse.RequestID == "" {
                errorResponse.RequestID = requestID
        }

        response := APIResponse{
                Success:   false,
                Error:     errorResponse,
                Timestamp: time.Now(),
                Meta: &ResponseMeta{
                        RequestID: requestID,
                        Duration:  duration,
                        Version:   m.version,
                },
        }

        // Log the error for monitoring
        m.logger.Warn("API error response",
                zap.String("code", string(apiErr.Code)),
                zap.String("message", apiErr.Message),
                zap.String("severity", string(apiErr.Severity)),
                zap.String("operation", apiErr.Operation),
                zap.String("resource", apiErr.Resource),
                zap.String("request_id", requestID),
                zap.Int("status_code", apiErr.HTTPStatusCode()),
        )

        c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), response)
}

// RequestMetadataMiddleware adds request metadata to the context
func (m *JSONResponseMiddleware) RequestMetadataMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Set start time for duration calculation
                c.Set("start_time", time.Now())

                // Generate or extract request ID
                requestID := c.GetHeader("X-Request-ID")
                if requestID == "" {
                        // Generate a simple request ID (in production, use UUID or similar)
                        requestID = generateRequestID()
                }
                c.Set("request_id", requestID)

                // Add request ID to response headers
                c.Header("X-Request-ID", requestID)

                c.Next()
        }
}

// Helper Functions

// SendJSON is a utility function to send JSON responses with proper error handling
func SendJSON(c *gin.Context, statusCode int, data interface{}) {
        c.Header("Content-Type", "application/json")

        // Handle potential JSON marshaling errors
        c.JSON(statusCode, data)
}

// SendError is a utility function to send error responses
func SendError(c *gin.Context, apiErr *GitAPIError) {
        // Create a basic response middleware for this utility
        middleware := NewJSONResponseMiddleware(nil, "")

        // Extract request metadata if available
        requestID, _ := c.Get("request_id")
        requestIDStr, _ := requestID.(string)

        startTime, exists := c.Get("start_time")
        var duration int64
        if exists {
                if start, ok := startTime.(time.Time); ok {
                        duration = time.Since(start).Milliseconds()
                }
        }

        middleware.SendErrorResponse(c, apiErr, requestIDStr, duration)
}

// SendSuccess is a utility function to send success responses
func SendSuccess(c *gin.Context, data interface{}, message string) {
        // Create a basic response middleware for this utility
        middleware := NewJSONResponseMiddleware(nil, "")
        middleware.SendSuccessResponse(c, data, message)
}

// CreatePagination creates pagination metadata
func CreatePagination(page, pageSize, total int) *PaginationMeta {
        if page < 1 {
                page = 1
        }
        if pageSize < 1 {
                pageSize = 10
        }

        totalPages := (total + pageSize - 1) / pageSize
        if totalPages < 1 {
                totalPages = 1
        }

        return &PaginationMeta{
                Page:       page,
                PageSize:   pageSize,
                Total:      total,
                TotalPages: totalPages,
                HasNext:    page < totalPages,
                HasPrev:    page > 1,
        }
}

// Helper function to generate a simple request ID
func generateRequestID() string {
        // In production, use UUID or a more robust ID generation
        return fmt.Sprintf("req_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// ErrorMapper converts various error types to GitAPIError
func ErrorMapper(err error, operation string) *GitAPIError {
        mapper := GetDefaultMapper()
        return mapper.MapError(err, operation)
}

// ErrorMapperWithContext converts errors with additional context
func ErrorMapperWithContext(err error, operation, resource string) *GitAPIError {
        mapper := GetDefaultMapper()
        return mapper.MapErrorWithContext(err, operation, resource)
}

// ErrorMapperWithDetails converts errors with additional details
func ErrorMapperWithDetails(err error, operation string, details map[string]interface{}) *GitAPIError {
        mapper := GetDefaultMapper()
        return mapper.MapErrorWithDetails(err, operation, details)
}

// Package cache implements repository caching for improved performance
package cache

import (
        "fmt"
        "time"
)

// CacheConfig defines configuration parameters for the repository cache
type CacheConfig struct {
        // MaxRepositories is the maximum number of repositories to cache
        // Default: 100, Range: 1-10000
        MaxRepositories int `yaml:"max_repositories" json:"max_repositories"`

        // TTL is the time-to-live for cache entries
        // Default: 30 minutes, Range: 1 minute - 24 hours
        TTL time.Duration `yaml:"ttl" json:"ttl"`

        // MaxMemoryMB is the optional maximum memory usage in megabytes
        // Default: 0 (unlimited), Range: 0-4096
        MaxMemoryMB int `yaml:"max_memory_mb" json:"max_memory_mb"`

        // CleanupInterval is how often to run TTL-based cleanup
        // Default: 5 minutes, Range: 1 minute - 1 hour
        CleanupInterval time.Duration `yaml:"cleanup_interval" json:"cleanup_interval"`

        // Enabled determines if caching is enabled
        // Default: true
        Enabled bool `yaml:"enabled" json:"enabled"`
}

// Default configuration values
const (
        DefaultMaxRepositories = 100
        DefaultTTL             = 30 * time.Minute
        DefaultMaxMemoryMB     = 0 // unlimited
        DefaultCleanupInterval = 5 * time.Minute
        DefaultEnabled         = true

        // Validation limits
        MinMaxRepositories = 1
        MaxMaxRepositories = 10000
        MinTTL             = 1 * time.Minute
        MaxTTL             = 24 * time.Hour
        MaxMaxMemoryMB     = 4096
        MinCleanupInterval = 1 * time.Minute
        MaxCleanupInterval = 1 * time.Hour
)

// NewCacheConfig creates a new cache configuration with sensible defaults
func NewCacheConfig() *CacheConfig {
        return &CacheConfig{
                MaxRepositories: DefaultMaxRepositories,
                TTL:             DefaultTTL,
                MaxMemoryMB:     DefaultMaxMemoryMB,
                CleanupInterval: DefaultCleanupInterval,
                Enabled:         DefaultEnabled,
        }
}

// Validate checks the configuration for valid values and applies corrections
func (c *CacheConfig) Validate() error {
        var errors []string

        // Validate MaxRepositories
        if c.MaxRepositories < MinMaxRepositories {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("max_repositories must be at least %d, got %d", MinMaxRepositories, c.MaxRepositories))
        }
        if c.MaxRepositories > MaxMaxRepositories {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("max_repositories must be at most %d, got %d", MaxMaxRepositories, c.MaxRepositories))
        }

        // Validate TTL
        if c.TTL < MinTTL {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("ttl must be at least %v, got %v", MinTTL, c.TTL))
        }
        if c.TTL > MaxTTL {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("ttl must be at most %v, got %v", MaxTTL, c.TTL))
        }

        // Validate MaxMemoryMB (0 means unlimited, so it's valid)
        if c.MaxMemoryMB < 0 {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("max_memory_mb cannot be negative, got %d", c.MaxMemoryMB))
        }
        if c.MaxMemoryMB > MaxMaxMemoryMB {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("max_memory_mb must be at most %d, got %d", MaxMaxMemoryMB, c.MaxMemoryMB))
        }

        // Validate CleanupInterval
        if c.CleanupInterval < MinCleanupInterval {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("cleanup_interval must be at least %v, got %v", MinCleanupInterval, c.CleanupInterval))
        }
        if c.CleanupInterval > MaxCleanupInterval {
                errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("cleanup_interval must be at most %v, got %v", MaxCleanupInterval, c.CleanupInterval))
        }

        // Return validation errors if any
        if len(errors) > 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("cache configuration validation failed: %v", errors)
        }

        return nil
}

// ApplyDefaults sets default values for any zero/unset fields
func (c *CacheConfig) ApplyDefaults() {
        if c.MaxRepositories == 0 {
                c.MaxRepositories = DefaultMaxRepositories
        }
        if c.TTL == 0 {
                c.TTL = DefaultTTL
        }
        // MaxMemoryMB can be 0 (unlimited), so don't apply default
        if c.CleanupInterval == 0 {
                c.CleanupInterval = DefaultCleanupInterval
        }
        // Enabled is bool, false is a valid value, so check explicitly
}

// ValidateAndApplyDefaults applies defaults and then validates the configuration
func (c *CacheConfig) ValidateAndApplyDefaults() error {
        c.ApplyDefaults()
        return c.Validate()
}

// String returns a human-readable representation of the cache configuration
func (c *CacheConfig) String() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("CacheConfig{MaxRepositories: %d, TTL: %v, MaxMemoryMB: %d, CleanupInterval: %v, Enabled: %t}",
                c.MaxRepositories, c.TTL, c.MaxMemoryMB, c.CleanupInterval, c.Enabled)
}

// IsMemoryLimited returns true if memory usage is limited
func (c *CacheConfig) IsMemoryLimited() bool {
        return c.MaxMemoryMB > 0
}

// MemoryLimitBytes returns the memory limit in bytes, or 0 if unlimited
func (c *CacheConfig) MemoryLimitBytes() int64 {
        if c.MaxMemoryMB == 0 {
                return 0
        }
        return int64(c.MaxMemoryMB) * 1024 * 1024
}

package cache

import (
        "fmt"
)

// NewRepositoryCache creates a new repository cache instance with the given configuration
func NewRepositoryCache(config *CacheConfig) (RepositoryCache, error) {
        if config == nil {
                config = NewCacheConfig()
        }

        // Create LRU cache implementation
        lruCache, err := NewLRUCache(config)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create LRU cache: %w", err)
        }

        return lruCache, nil
}

// NewDefaultRepositoryCache creates a repository cache with default configuration
func NewDefaultRepositoryCache() (RepositoryCache, error) {
        config := NewCacheConfig()
        return NewRepositoryCache(config)
}

package cache

import (
        "fmt"
        "sync"
        "time"

        gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        lru "github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru/v2"
        "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
)

// Repository represents a cached Git repository with its metadata
type Repository struct {
        // GitRepo is the actual go-git repository object
        GitRepo *gogit.Repository

        // Path is the filesystem path to the repository
        Path string

        // CreatedAt tracks when this repository was cached
        CreatedAt time.Time

        // LastAccessed tracks when this repository was last accessed
        LastAccessed time.Time

        // AccessCount tracks how many times this repository has been accessed
        AccessCount int64

        // mutex protects concurrent access to LastAccessed and AccessCount
        mutex sync.RWMutex
}

// Close properly closes the repository and releases resources
func (r *Repository) Close() error {
        // go-git repositories don't require explicit closing in most cases.
        // We don't set GitRepo to nil here because there might be active
        // references to this repository that would fail with "repository is closed".
        // The Go garbage collector will clean up when there are no more references.
        return nil
}

// UpdateAccess updates the last accessed time and increments access count
func (r *Repository) UpdateAccess() {
        r.mutex.Lock()
        defer r.mutex.Unlock()
        r.LastAccessed = time.Now()
        r.AccessCount++
}

// GetLastAccessed returns the last accessed time in a thread-safe manner
func (r *Repository) GetLastAccessed() time.Time {
        r.mutex.RLock()
        defer r.mutex.RUnlock()
        return r.LastAccessed
}

// GetAccessCount returns the access count in a thread-safe manner
func (r *Repository) GetAccessCount() int64 {
        r.mutex.RLock()
        defer r.mutex.RUnlock()
        return r.AccessCount
}

// IsExpired checks if the repository has exceeded its TTL
func (r *Repository) IsExpired(ttl time.Duration) bool {
        if ttl <= 0 {
                return false // No expiration if TTL is zero or negative
        }
        return time.Since(r.CreatedAt) > ttl
}

// LRUCache implements a thread-safe LRU cache for Git repositories
type LRUCache struct {
        // cache is the underlying LRU cache
        cache *lru.Cache[string, *Repository]

        // config holds the cache configuration
        config *CacheConfig

        // mutex protects concurrent access to the cache
        mutex sync.RWMutex

        // metrics holds cache statistics
        metrics *CacheMetrics

        // prometheusMetrics holds Prometheus metrics (optional)
        prometheusMetrics *PrometheusMetrics

        // onEvicted is called when a repository is evicted from the cache
        onEvicted func(key string, repository *Repository)

        // TTL cleanup goroutine management
        stopCleanup chan struct{}
        cleanupDone chan struct{}
}

// CacheMetrics tracks cache performance statistics
type CacheMetrics struct {
        Hits      int64 `json:"hits"`
        Misses    int64 `json:"misses"`
        Evictions int64 `json:"evictions"`
        Entries   int64 `json:"entries"`
        mutex     sync.RWMutex
}

// NewLRUCache creates a new LRU cache with the given configuration
func NewLRUCache(config *CacheConfig) (*LRUCache, error) {
        if config == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("cache config cannot be nil")
        }

        if err := config.ValidateAndApplyDefaults(); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cache config: %w", err)
        }

        // Create the LRU cache instance
        cache := &LRUCache{
                config:  config,
                metrics: &CacheMetrics{},
        }

        // Create the underlying LRU cache with eviction callback
        lruCache, err := lru.NewWithEvict(config.MaxRepositories, cache.handleEviction)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create LRU cache: %w", err)
        }

        cache.cache = lruCache

        // Start TTL cleanup goroutine if TTL is enabled
        if config.Enabled && config.TTL > 0 {
                cache.stopCleanup = make(chan struct{})
                cache.cleanupDone = make(chan struct{})
                go cache.cleanupExpiredEntries()
        }

        return cache, nil
}

// NewLRUCacheForTesting creates a new LRU cache with the given configuration without validation
// This is intended for testing purposes only and bypasses configuration validation
func NewLRUCacheForTesting(config *CacheConfig) (*LRUCache, error) {
        if config == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("cache config cannot be nil")
        }

        // Apply defaults but skip validation for testing
        config.ApplyDefaults()

        // Create the LRU cache instance
        cache := &LRUCache{
                config:  config,
                metrics: &CacheMetrics{},
        }

        // Create the underlying LRU cache with eviction callback
        lruCache, err := lru.NewWithEvict(config.MaxRepositories, cache.handleEviction)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create LRU cache: %w", err)
        }

        cache.cache = lruCache

        // Start TTL cleanup goroutine if TTL is enabled
        if config.Enabled && config.TTL > 0 {
                cache.stopCleanup = make(chan struct{})
                cache.cleanupDone = make(chan struct{})
                go cache.cleanupExpiredEntries()
        }

        return cache, nil
}

// Get retrieves a repository from the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Get(path string) (*Repository, bool) {
        if !c.config.Enabled {
                c.recordMiss()
                return nil, false
        }

        c.mutex.RLock()
        repo, found := c.cache.Get(path)
        c.mutex.RUnlock()

        if !found {
                c.recordMiss()
                return nil, false
        }

        // Check if the repository has expired
        if repo.IsExpired(c.config.TTL) {
                // Remove expired entry and return miss
                c.mutex.Lock()
                c.cache.Remove(path)
                c.decrementEntries()
                c.mutex.Unlock()
                c.recordMiss()
                return nil, false
        }

        // Update access information
        repo.UpdateAccess()
        c.recordHit()
        return repo, true
}

// Set stores a repository in the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Set(path string, gitRepo *gogit.Repository) error {
        if !c.config.Enabled {
                return nil // Cache disabled, silently ignore
        }

        if path == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("repository path cannot be empty")
        }

        if gitRepo == nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("git repository cannot be nil")
        }

        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        // Create repository wrapper
        repo := &Repository{
                GitRepo:      gitRepo,
                Path:         path,
                CreatedAt:    time.Now(),
                LastAccessed: time.Now(),
                AccessCount:  1,
        }

        // Check if key already exists to avoid double counting
        exists := c.cache.Contains(path)

        // Store in cache (this may trigger eviction)
        c.cache.Add(path, repo)

        // Only increment entries if this is a new entry (not updating existing)
        if !exists {
                c.incrementEntries()
        }

        // Record Prometheus metrics if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.RecordSet()
                // Update current entry count and memory usage
                c.updatePrometheusMetrics()
        }

        return nil
}

// Remove removes a repository from the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Remove(path string) bool {
        if !c.config.Enabled {
                return false
        }

        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        existed := c.cache.Remove(path)
        if existed {
                c.decrementEntries()
        }
        return existed
}

// Contains checks if a repository exists in the cache without updating LRU order
func (c *LRUCache) Contains(path string) bool {
        if !c.config.Enabled {
                return false
        }

        c.mutex.RLock()
        defer c.mutex.RUnlock()

        return c.cache.Contains(path)
}

// Len returns the current number of items in the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Len() int {
        c.mutex.RLock()
        defer c.mutex.RUnlock()

        return c.cache.Len()
}

// Keys returns a copy of all keys in the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Keys() []string {
        c.mutex.RLock()
        defer c.mutex.RUnlock()

        return c.cache.Keys()
}

// Purge removes all items from the cache
func (c *LRUCache) Purge() {
        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        c.cache.Purge()
        c.resetEntries()
}

// cleanupExpiredEntries runs in a background goroutine to periodically remove expired entries
func (c *LRUCache) cleanupExpiredEntries() {
        defer close(c.cleanupDone)

        ticker := time.NewTicker(c.config.CleanupInterval)
        defer ticker.Stop()

        for {
                select {
                case <-c.stopCleanup:
                        return
                case <-ticker.C:
                        c.removeExpiredEntries()
                }
        }
}

// removeExpiredEntries scans and removes all expired entries from the cache
func (c *LRUCache) removeExpiredEntries() {
        if !c.config.Enabled || c.config.TTL <= 0 {
                return
        }

        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        // Get all keys to check for expiration
        keys := c.cache.Keys()
        expiredKeys := make([]string, 0)

        // Check each entry for expiration
        for _, key := range keys {
                if repo, found := c.cache.Peek(key); found && repo.IsExpired(c.config.TTL) {
                        expiredKeys = append(expiredKeys, key)
                }
        }

        // Remove expired entries
        cleanupCount := len(expiredKeys)
        for _, key := range expiredKeys {
                c.cache.Remove(key)
                c.decrementEntries()
        }

        // Record cleanup metrics if enabled and entries were cleaned up
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil && cleanupCount > 0 {
                c.prometheusMetrics.RecordCleanup()
        }
}

// Close shuts down the cache and cleans up all resources
func (c *LRUCache) Close() error {
        // Signal cleanup goroutine to stop
        if c.stopCleanup != nil {
                close(c.stopCleanup)
                // Wait for cleanup goroutine to finish
                if c.cleanupDone != nil {
                        <-c.cleanupDone
                }
        }

        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        // Purge will trigger eviction callbacks for cleanup
        c.cache.Purge()
        return nil
}

// GetMetrics returns a copy of the current cache metrics
func (c *LRUCache) GetMetrics() CacheMetrics {
        c.metrics.mutex.RLock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.RUnlock()

        return CacheMetrics{
                Hits:      c.metrics.Hits,
                Misses:    c.metrics.Misses,
                Evictions: c.metrics.Evictions,
                Entries:   c.metrics.Entries,
        }
}

// ResetMetrics resets all cache metrics to zero
func (c *LRUCache) ResetMetrics() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()

        c.metrics.Hits = 0
        c.metrics.Misses = 0
        c.metrics.Evictions = 0
        c.metrics.Entries = 0
}

// GetHitRatio returns the cache hit ratio as a percentage (0.0 - 1.0)
func (c *LRUCache) GetHitRatio() float64 {
        metrics := c.GetMetrics()
        total := metrics.Hits + metrics.Misses
        if total == 0 {
                return 0.0
        }
        return float64(metrics.Hits) / float64(total)
}

// handleEviction is called when an item is evicted from the cache
func (c *LRUCache) handleEviction(key string, repo *Repository) {
        // Clean up the repository
        if repo != nil {
                _ = repo.Close() // Ignore error as we're already evicting
        }

        // Call custom eviction handler if set
        if c.onEvicted != nil {
                c.onEvicted(key, repo)
        }

        // Update metrics
        c.recordEviction()
        c.decrementEntries()
}

// SetEvictionCallback sets a custom callback for when repositories are evicted
func (c *LRUCache) SetEvictionCallback(callback func(string, *Repository)) {
        c.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.mutex.Unlock()

        c.onEvicted = callback
}

// Private metrics methods

func (c *LRUCache) recordHit() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        c.metrics.Hits++

        // Record Prometheus metric if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.RecordHit()
        }
}

func (c *LRUCache) recordMiss() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        c.metrics.Misses++

        // Record Prometheus metric if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.RecordMiss()
        }
}

func (c *LRUCache) recordEviction() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        c.metrics.Evictions++

        // Record Prometheus metric if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.RecordEviction()
        }
}

func (c *LRUCache) incrementEntries() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        c.metrics.Entries++

        // Update Prometheus metrics if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateEntries(c.metrics.Entries)
                // Update memory usage estimate using the internal version to avoid recursive locking
                memoryBytes := c.estimateMemoryUsageWithEntries(c.metrics.Entries)
                c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateMemoryUsage(memoryBytes)
        }
}

func (c *LRUCache) decrementEntries() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        if c.metrics.Entries > 0 {
                c.metrics.Entries--
        }

        // Update Prometheus metrics if enabled
        if c.prometheusMetrics != nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateEntries(c.metrics.Entries)
                // Update memory usage estimate using the internal version to avoid recursive locking
                memoryBytes := c.estimateMemoryUsageWithEntries(c.metrics.Entries)
                c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateMemoryUsage(memoryBytes)
        }
}

func (c *LRUCache) resetEntries() {
        c.metrics.mutex.Lock()
        defer c.metrics.mutex.Unlock()
        c.metrics.Entries = 0
}

// EnablePrometheusMetrics enables Prometheus metrics collection for this cache
// This uses the default Prometheus registry via promauto
func (c *LRUCache) EnablePrometheusMetrics() {
        if c.prometheusMetrics == nil {
                // NewPrometheusMetrics uses promauto which automatically registers with default registry
                c.prometheusMetrics = NewPrometheusMetrics()
                // Update current state
                c.updatePrometheusMetrics()
        }
}

// EnablePrometheusMetricsWithRegistry enables Prometheus metrics with a custom registry
func (c *LRUCache) EnablePrometheusMetricsWithRegistry(registry prometheus.Registerer) error {
        if c.prometheusMetrics == nil {
                c.prometheusMetrics = NewPrometheusMetricsWithRegistry(registry)
                if err := c.prometheusMetrics.RegisterMetrics(registry); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to register metrics: %w", err)
                }
                // Update current state
                c.updatePrometheusMetrics()
        }
        return nil
}

// updatePrometheusMetrics synchronizes current cache state with Prometheus metrics
func (c *LRUCache) updatePrometheusMetrics() {
        if c.prometheusMetrics == nil {
                return
        }

        metrics := c.GetMetrics()

        // Update all current metrics
        c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateEntries(metrics.Entries)

        // Calculate estimated memory usage
        memoryBytes := c.estimateMemoryUsage()
        c.prometheusMetrics.UpdateMemoryUsage(memoryBytes)
}

// estimateMemoryUsage provides a rough estimate of cache memory usage
