                zap.String("branch", operation.Branch))

        // Use the same logic as CreateSingleFile but with delete operation
        return gom.executeSingleFileOperation(ctx, operation, FileOperationDelete)
}

// executeSingleFileOperation is a helper method to execute single file operations
func (gom *GitObjectManager) executeSingleFileOperation(ctx context.Context, operation SingleFileOperation, fileOp FileOperation) (*FileOperationResult, error) {
        // Open repository
        repo, err := gom.OpenRepository(ctx, operation.Owner, operation.Repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        // Get current HEAD or branch
        var baseCommitHash plumbing.Hash
        if operation.Branch != "" {
                baseCommitHash, err = gom.ResolveReference(ctx, repo, "refs/heads/"+operation.Branch)
                if err != nil {
                        // Branch doesn't exist, get HEAD
                        headRef, headErr := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repo)
                        if headErr != nil {
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve branch %s and HEAD: %w", operation.Branch, headErr)
                        }
                        baseCommitHash = headRef.Hash()
                }
        } else {
                headRef, err := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repo)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository HEAD: %w", err)
                }
                baseCommitHash = headRef.Hash()
        }

        // Get base tree from current commit
        var baseTree *object.Tree
        if !baseCommitHash.IsZero() {
                baseCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(baseCommitHash)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base commit: %w", err)
                }
                baseTree, err = baseCommit.Tree()
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Create file change based on operation type
        change := FileChange{
                Path:      operation.Path,
                Operation: fileOp,
        }

        // Add content for create/update operations
        if fileOp == FileOperationCreate || fileOp == FileOperationUpdate {
                change.Content = operation.Content
        }

        changes := []FileChange{change}

        // Validate changes
        if err := gom.ValidateFileChanges(ctx, changes); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("file validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Create new tree
        treeResult, err := gom.CreateTreeFromChanges(ctx, repo, baseTree, changes)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create tree: %w", err)
        }

        // Prepare commit info
        commitInfo := CommitInfo{
                Message: operation.Message,
                Author: object.Signature{
                        Name:  operation.AuthorName,
                        Email: operation.AuthorEmail,
                        When:  time.Now(),
                },
        }

        // Set committer if provided
        if operation.CommitterName != "" && operation.CommitterEmail != "" {
                commitInfo.Committer = &object.Signature{
                        Name:  operation.CommitterName,
                        Email: operation.CommitterEmail,
                        When:  time.Now(),
                }
        }

        // Add parent if we have a base commit
        if !baseCommitHash.IsZero() {
                commitInfo.Parents = []plumbing.Hash{baseCommitHash}
        }

        // Create commit
        commitResult, err := gom.CreateCommit(ctx, repo, treeResult.TreeHash, commitInfo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
        }

        // Update branch reference if specified
        if operation.Branch != "" {
                refName := plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/" + operation.Branch)
                ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commitResult.Hash)
                if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(ref); err != nil {
                        gom.logger.Warn("Failed to update branch reference",
                                zap.String("branch", operation.Branch),
                                zap.Error(err))
                }
        }

        return &FileOperationResult{
                CommitHash:   commitResult.Hash.String(),
                TreeHash:     commitResult.TreeHash.String(),
                CreatedFiles: treeResult.CreatedFiles,
                ChangedFiles: treeResult.ChangedFiles,
                DeletedFiles: treeResult.DeletedFiles,
                Message:      commitResult.Message,
                Author:       commitResult.Author.Name,
                Timestamp:    commitResult.Author.When,
        }, nil
}

// ExecuteMultiFileOperationWithTransaction executes a multi-file operation using transaction management for atomicity
func (gom *GitObjectManager) ExecuteMultiFileOperationWithTransaction(ctx context.Context, operation MultiFileOperation, transactionManager *TransactionManager) (*FileOperationResult, error) {
        gom.logger.Info("Executing multi-file operation with transaction",
                zap.String("owner", operation.Owner),
                zap.String("repo", operation.Repo),
                zap.Int("change_count", len(operation.Changes)),
                zap.String("branch", operation.Branch))

        // Open repository
        repo, err := gom.OpenRepository(ctx, operation.Owner, operation.Repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        // Get current HEAD or branch
        var baseCommitHash plumbing.Hash
        if operation.Branch != "" {
                baseCommitHash, err = gom.ResolveReference(ctx, repo, "refs/heads/"+operation.Branch)
                if err != nil {
                        // Branch doesn't exist, get HEAD
                        headRef, headErr := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repo)
                        if headErr != nil {
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve branch %s and HEAD: %w", operation.Branch, headErr)
                        }
                        baseCommitHash = headRef.Hash()
                }
        } else {
                headRef, err := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repo)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository HEAD: %w", err)
                }
                baseCommitHash = headRef.Hash()
        }

        // Prepare commit info
        commitInfo := CommitInfo{
                Message: operation.Message,
                Author: object.Signature{
                        Name:  operation.AuthorName,
                        Email: operation.AuthorEmail,
                        When:  time.Now(),
                },
        }

        if operation.CommitterName != "" && operation.CommitterEmail != "" {
                commitInfo.Committer = &object.Signature{
                        Name:  operation.CommitterName,
                        Email: operation.CommitterEmail,
                        When:  time.Now(),
                }
        }

        // Begin transaction
        txnOptions := TransactionOptions{
                Timeout:            5 * time.Minute, // Default timeout
                ValidateOnly:       false,
                AllowPartialCommit: false,
                MaxRetries:         3,
        }

        txn, err := transactionManager.BeginTransaction(ctx, repo, baseCommitHash, commitInfo, txnOptions)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to begin transaction: %w", err)
        }

        // Ensure cleanup
        defer func() {
                if txn.State == TransactionStateActive || txn.State == TransactionStateValidating {
                        if rollbackErr := transactionManager.RollbackTransaction(ctx, txn); rollbackErr != nil {
                                // Log rollback error but don't return it since we're in cleanup
                                fmt.Printf("Warning: Failed to rollback transaction %s: %v\n", txn.ID, rollbackErr)
                        }
                }
                transactionManager.CleanupTransaction(txn.ID)
        }()

        // Add all operations to transaction
        for _, change := range operation.Changes {
                operation := TransactionOperation{
                        Type:       change.Operation,
                        FileChange: change,
                }

                if err := transactionManager.AddOperation(ctx, txn, operation); err != nil {
                        gom.logger.Error("Failed to add operation to transaction",
                                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                                zap.String("file_path", change.Path),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add operation for %s: %w", change.Path, err)
                }
        }

        // Validate transaction
        if err := transactionManager.ValidateTransaction(ctx, txn); err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Transaction validation failed",
                        zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("transaction validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Commit transaction
        result, err := transactionManager.CommitTransaction(ctx, txn)
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Transaction commit failed",
                        zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("transaction commit failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Update branch reference if specified
        if operation.Branch != "" && result.CommitResult != nil {
                refName := plumbing.ReferenceName(fmt.Sprintf("refs/heads/%s", operation.Branch))
                newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, result.CommitResult.Hash)
                if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef); err != nil {
                        // This is a critical error as the commit succeeded but branch update failed
                        gom.logger.Error("Failed to update branch reference after successful commit",
                                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                                zap.String("branch", operation.Branch),
                                zap.String("commit_hash", result.CommitResult.Hash.String()),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update branch reference: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Convert transaction result to file operation result
        fileResult := &FileOperationResult{
                CommitHash:   result.CommitResult.Hash.String(),
                Message:      operation.Message,
                ChangedFiles: make([]string, len(result.SuccessfulOperations)),
        }

        // Copy the file paths from successful operations
        for i, opID := range result.SuccessfulOperations {
                if op, err := txn.GetOperationByID(opID); err == nil {
                        fileResult.ChangedFiles[i] = op.FileChange.Path
                }
        }

        gom.logger.Info("Multi-file transaction completed successfully",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.String("commit_hash", fileResult.CommitHash),
                zap.Int("files_changed", len(fileResult.ChangedFiles)),
                zap.Duration("duration", result.Duration))

        return fileResult, nil
}

// GetFileContent retrieves the content of a file from a specific commit or branch
func (gom *GitObjectManager) GetFileContent(ctx context.Context, owner, repo, path, ref string) ([]byte, error) {
        gom.logger.Debug("Getting file content",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("path", path),
                zap.String("ref", ref))

        // Open repository
        repository, err := gom.OpenRepository(ctx, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        // Resolve reference to commit hash
        var commitHash plumbing.Hash
        if ref != "" {
                commitHash, err = gom.ResolveReference(ctx, repository, ref)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve reference %s: %w", ref, err)
                }
        } else {
                // Get HEAD
                headRef, err := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repository)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository HEAD: %w", err)
                }
                commitHash = headRef.Hash()
        }

        // Get commit
        commit, err := repository.CommitObject(commitHash)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
        }

        // Get tree
        tree, err := commit.Tree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
        }

        // Get file from tree
        file, err := gom.GetFileFromTree(ctx, tree, path)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get file from tree: %w", err)
        }
        if file == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("file not found")
        }

        // Read file content
        reader, err := file.Reader()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get file reader: %w", err)
        }
        defer func() {
                if err := reader.Close(); err != nil {
                        // Log close error during cleanup - not critical
                        fmt.Printf("Warning: failed to close reader during cleanup: %v\n", err)
                }
        }()

        content := make([]byte, file.Size)
        _, err = reader.Read(content)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read file content: %w", err)
        }

        return content, nil
}

// FileExists checks if a file exists in the repository at a specific commit or branch
func (gom *GitObjectManager) FileExists(ctx context.Context, owner, repo, path, ref string) (bool, error) {
        _, err := gom.GetFileContent(ctx, owner, repo, path, ref)
        if err != nil {
                // Check if it's a "file not found" error vs other errors
                if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "file not found") {
                        return false, nil
                }
                return false, err
        }
        return true, nil
}

// GetDirectoryListing gets a list of files and directories at a specific path
func (gom *GitObjectManager) GetDirectoryListing(ctx context.Context, owner, repo, path, ref string) ([]DirectoryEntry, error) {
        gom.logger.Debug("Getting directory listing",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("path", path),
                zap.String("ref", ref))

        // Open repository
        repository, err := gom.OpenRepository(ctx, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        // Resolve reference to commit hash
        var commitHash plumbing.Hash
        if ref != "" {
                commitHash, err = gom.ResolveReference(ctx, repository, ref)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve reference %s: %w", ref, err)
                }
        } else {
                // Get HEAD
                headRef, err := gom.GetRepositoryHead(ctx, repository)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository HEAD: %w", err)
                }
                commitHash = headRef.Hash()
        }

        // Get commit
        commit, err := repository.CommitObject(commitHash)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
        }

        // Get tree
        tree, err := commit.Tree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
        }

        // Navigate to subdirectory if path is provided
        if path != "" && path != "/" {
                cleanPath := filepath.Clean(path)
                subTree, err := tree.Tree(cleanPath)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get subdirectory tree: %w", err)
                }
                tree = subTree
        }

        // Get directory entries
        var entries []DirectoryEntry
        for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
                entryType := "file"
                if entry.Mode == filemode.Dir {
                        entryType = "directory"
                }

                entries = append(entries, DirectoryEntry{
                        Name: entry.Name,
                        Type: entryType,
                        Mode: entry.Mode.String(),
                        Hash: entry.Hash.String(),
                })
        }

        return entries, nil
}

// DirectoryEntry represents an entry in a directory listing
type DirectoryEntry struct {
        Name string `json:"name"`
        Type string `json:"type"` // "file" or "directory"
        Mode string `json:"mode"`
        Hash string `json:"hash"`
}

package git

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "os"
        "strings"
        "sync"

        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/filemode"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
)

// GoGitRepository implements the Repository interface using go-git
type GoGitRepository struct {
        path string
        repo *git.Repository
        mu   sync.RWMutex // Protects concurrent access to repo
}

// OpenRepository opens a Git repository at the specified path
func OpenRepository(path string) (Repository, error) {
        return openRepositoryInternal(path, false)
}

// OpenRepositoryWithCache opens a Git repository at the specified path using the global cache
func OpenRepositoryWithCache(path string) (Repository, error) {
        return openRepositoryInternal(path, true)
}

// openRepositoryInternal is the internal implementation that optionally uses caching
func openRepositoryInternal(path string, useCache bool) (Repository, error) {
        // If caching is enabled, try to get from cache first
        if useCache {
                if cached, found := globalCache.Get(path); found {
                        return cached, nil
                }
        }

        // Check if the path exists
        if _, err := os.Stat(path); os.IsNotExist(err) {
                return nil, &RepositoryNotFoundError{Path: path}
        }

        // Try to open the repository
        repo, err := git.PlainOpen(path)
        if err != nil {
                // Check if it's because the directory is not a git repository
                if err == git.ErrRepositoryNotExists {
                        return nil, &InvalidRepositoryError{
                                Path:   path,
                                Reason: "directory is not a Git repository",
                        }
                }

                return nil, NewGitError("open", path, "", "failed to open repository", err)
        }

        // Create our repository wrapper
        gitRepo := &GoGitRepository{
                path: path,
                repo: repo,
        }

        // If caching is enabled, store in cache
        if useCache {
                globalCache.Put(path, gitRepo)
        }

        return gitRepo, nil
}

// Path returns the filesystem path of the repository
func (r *GoGitRepository) Path() string {
        return r.path
}

// GetTree retrieves the directory structure at a given reference
func (r *GoGitRepository) GetTree(ctx context.Context, ref string) ([]TreeEntry, error) {
        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        // Resolve the reference to a commit
        commit, err := r.resolveCommit(ref)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Get the tree from the commit
        tree, err := commit.Tree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_tree", r.path, ref, "failed to get tree from commit", err)
        }

        // Convert tree entries to our format
        var entries []TreeEntry
        for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
                // Check for context cancellation during iteration
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done():
                        return nil, ctx.Err()
                default:
                }

                entryType := convertFileMode(entry.Mode)
                size := int64(0)

                // For blobs, try to get the size
                if entryType == EntryTypeBlob {
                        if blob, err := r.repo.BlobObject(entry.Hash); err == nil {
                                size = blob.Size
                        }
                }

                entries = append(entries, TreeEntry{
                        Path: entry.Name,
                        Mode: entry.Mode.String(),
                        Type: entryType,
                        Hash: entry.Hash.String(),
                        Size: size,
                })
        }

        return entries, nil
}

// GetBlob retrieves the contents of a file at a specific path and reference
func (r *GoGitRepository) GetBlob(ctx context.Context, path, ref string) ([]byte, error) {
        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        // Resolve the reference to a commit
        commit, err := r.resolveCommit(ref)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Get the file from the commit
        file, err := commit.File(path)
        if err != nil {
                if err == object.ErrFileNotFound {
                        return nil, &PathNotFoundError{Path: path, Ref: ref, Repo: r.path}
                }
                return nil, NewGitError("get_blob", r.path, ref, fmt.Sprintf("failed to get file %s", path), err)
        }

        // Read the file contents
        reader, err := file.Reader()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_blob", r.path, ref, fmt.Sprintf("failed to get reader for file %s", path), err)
        }
        defer func() { _ = reader.Close() }()

        // Check for context cancellation before reading
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        // Read all content
        content, err := io.ReadAll(reader)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_blob", r.path, ref, fmt.Sprintf("failed to read file %s", path), err)
        }

        return content, nil
}

// GetCommits retrieves commit history with pagination
func (r *GoGitRepository) GetCommits(ctx context.Context, ref string, limit, skip int) ([]Commit, error) {
        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        r.mu.RLock()
        defer r.mu.RUnlock()

        if r.repo == nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_commits", r.path, ref, "repository is closed", nil)
        }

        // Resolve the reference to a commit hash (using unsafe version since we already hold the lock)
        hash, err := r.resolveReferenceUnsafe(ref)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Get commit iterator starting from the resolved hash
        commitIter, err := r.repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
                From: hash,
        })
        if err != nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_commits", r.path, ref, "failed to get commit log", err)
        }
        defer commitIter.Close()

        var commits []Commit
        current := 0

        err = commitIter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
                // Check for context cancellation during iteration
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done():
                        return ctx.Err()
                default:
                }

                // Skip commits if needed
                if current < skip {
                        current++
                        return nil
                }

                // Check if we've reached the limit
                if limit > 0 && len(commits) >= limit {
                        return io.EOF
                }

                commits = append(commits, convertCommit(c))
                current++

                return nil
        })

        if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
                return nil, NewGitError("get_commits", r.path, ref, "failed to iterate commits", err)
        }

        return commits, nil
}

// Close releases any resources held by the repository
func (r *GoGitRepository) Close() error {
        r.mu.Lock()
        defer r.mu.Unlock()

        // go-git repositories don't need explicit closing
        // but we can set the repo to nil to help with garbage collection
        r.repo = nil
        return nil
}

// Helper methods

// resolveCommit resolves a reference string to a commit object
func (r *GoGitRepository) resolveCommit(ref string) (*object.Commit, error) {
        r.mu.RLock()
        defer r.mu.RUnlock()

        if r.repo == nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("resolve_commit", r.path, ref, "repository is closed", nil)
        }

        hash, err := r.resolveReferenceUnsafe(ref) // Use unsafe version since we already have the lock
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        commit, err := r.repo.CommitObject(hash)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, NewGitError("resolve_commit", r.path, ref, "failed to get commit object", err)
        }

        return commit, nil
}

// resolveReferenceUnsafe is the same as resolveReference but without locking (for internal use)
func (r *GoGitRepository) resolveReferenceUnsafe(ref string) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
        if r.repo == nil {
                return plumbing.ZeroHash, NewGitError("resolve_reference", r.path, ref, "repository is closed", nil)
        }

        // Try to parse as a direct hash first
        if hash := plumbing.NewHash(ref); !hash.IsZero() && len(ref) >= 4 {
                // Verify the object exists
                if _, err := r.repo.Object(plumbing.AnyObject, hash); err == nil {
                        return hash, nil
                }
        }

        // Try to resolve as a reference (branch, tag, etc.)
        reference, err := r.repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(ref), true)
        if err != nil {
                // Try with refs/heads/ prefix for branches
                if branchRef, branchErr := r.repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(ref), true); branchErr == nil {
                        return branchRef.Hash(), nil
                }

                // Try with refs/tags/ prefix for tags
                if tagRef, tagErr := r.repo.Reference(plumbing.NewTagReferenceName(ref), true); tagErr == nil {
                        return tagRef.Hash(), nil
                }

                // Try HEAD if ref is empty or "HEAD"
                if ref == "" || ref == "HEAD" {
                        if headRef, headErr := r.repo.Head(); headErr == nil {
                                return headRef.Hash(), nil
                        }
                }

                return plumbing.ZeroHash, &ReferenceNotFoundError{Ref: ref, Path: r.path}
        }

        return reference.Hash(), nil
}

// convertFileMode converts go-git file mode to our EntryType
func convertFileMode(mode filemode.FileMode) EntryType {
        switch mode {
        case filemode.Dir: // Directory (040000)
                return EntryTypeTree
        case filemode.Submodule: // Git submodule (160000)
                return EntryTypeCommit
        default: // Regular file, executable, symlink
                return EntryTypeBlob
        }
}

// convertCommit converts a go-git commit to our Commit format
func convertCommit(c *object.Commit) Commit {
        var parentHashes []string
        for _, parent := range c.ParentHashes {
                parentHashes = append(parentHashes, parent.String())
        }

        // Clean commit message by removing trailing newlines and replacing internal newlines with spaces
        message := strings.TrimSpace(c.Message)
        message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, "\n", " ")
        message = strings.ReplaceAll(message, "\r", " ")

        return Commit{
                Hash:    c.Hash.String(),
                Message: message,
                Author: CommitAuthor{
                        Name:  c.Author.Name,
                        Email: c.Author.Email,
                        Date:  c.Author.When,
                },
                Committer: CommitAuthor{
                        Name:  c.Committer.Name,
                        Email: c.Committer.Email,
                        Date:  c.Committer.When,
                },
                ParentHashes: parentHashes,
                TreeHash:     c.TreeHash.String(),
        }
}

// GetGoGitRepo returns the underlying go-git repository instance
// This is useful for operations that need direct access to go-git APIs
func (r *GoGitRepository) GetGoGitRepo() *git.Repository {
        return r.repo
}

package git

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "sync"
)

// MockRepository is a mock implementation of the Repository interface for testing
type MockRepository struct {
        mu sync.RWMutex

        // path is the repository path
        path string

        // trees maps ref -> []TreeEntry
        trees map[string][]TreeEntry

        // blobs maps path:ref -> []byte
        blobs map[string][]byte

        // commits maps ref -> []Commit
        commits map[string][]Commit

        // closed indicates if the repository has been closed
        closed bool

        // Mock control fields
        GetTreeError    error
        GetBlobError    error
        GetCommitsError error
        CloseError      error
}

// NewMockRepository creates a new mock repository
func NewMockRepository(path string) *MockRepository {
        return &MockRepository{
                path:    path,
                trees:   make(map[string][]TreeEntry),
                blobs:   make(map[string][]byte),
                commits: make(map[string][]Commit),
        }
}

// Path returns the filesystem path of the repository
func (m *MockRepository) Path() string {
        m.mu.RLock()
        defer m.mu.RUnlock()
        return m.path
}

// GetTree retrieves the directory structure at a given reference
func (m *MockRepository) GetTree(ctx context.Context, ref string) ([]TreeEntry, error) {
        m.mu.RLock()
        defer m.mu.RUnlock()

        if m.closed {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository is closed")
        }

        if m.GetTreeError != nil {
                return nil, m.GetTreeError
        }

        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        entries, exists := m.trees[ref]
        if !exists {
                return nil, &ReferenceNotFoundError{Ref: ref, Path: m.path}
        }

        // Return a copy to prevent modifications
        result := make([]TreeEntry, len(entries))
        copy(result, entries)
        return result, nil
}

// GetBlob retrieves the contents of a file at a specific path and reference
func (m *MockRepository) GetBlob(ctx context.Context, path, ref string) ([]byte, error) {
        m.mu.RLock()
        defer m.mu.RUnlock()

        if m.closed {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository is closed")
        }

        if m.GetBlobError != nil {
                return nil, m.GetBlobError
        }

        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", path, ref)
        content, exists := m.blobs[key]
        if !exists {
                return nil, &PathNotFoundError{Path: path, Ref: ref, Repo: m.path}
        }

        // Return a copy to prevent modifications
        result := make([]byte, len(content))
        copy(result, content)
        return result, nil
}

// GetCommits retrieves commit history with pagination
func (m *MockRepository) GetCommits(ctx context.Context, ref string, limit, skip int) ([]Commit, error) {
        m.mu.RLock()
        defer m.mu.RUnlock()

        if m.closed {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository is closed")
        }

        if m.GetCommitsError != nil {
                return nil, m.GetCommitsError
        }

        // Check for context cancellation
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return nil, ctx.Err()
        default:
        }

        allCommits, exists := m.commits[ref]
        if !exists {
                return nil, &ReferenceNotFoundError{Ref: ref, Path: m.path}
        }

        // Apply pagination
        if skip >= len(allCommits) {
                return []Commit{}, nil
        }

        end := skip + limit
        if end > len(allCommits) {
                end = len(allCommits)
        }

        // Return a copy to prevent modifications
        result := make([]Commit, end-skip)
        copy(result, allCommits[skip:end])
        return result, nil
}

// Close releases any resources held by the repository
func (m *MockRepository) Close() error {
        m.mu.Lock()
        defer m.mu.Unlock()

        if m.CloseError != nil {
                return m.CloseError
        }

        m.closed = true
        return nil
}

// Mock helper methods for setting up test data

// SetTree sets the tree entries for a given reference
func (m *MockRepository) SetTree(ref string, entries []TreeEntry) {
        m.mu.Lock()
        defer m.mu.Unlock()
        m.trees[ref] = entries
}

// SetBlob sets the blob content for a given path and reference
func (m *MockRepository) SetBlob(path, ref string, content []byte) {
        m.mu.Lock()
        defer m.mu.Unlock()
        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", path, ref)
        m.blobs[key] = content
}

// SetCommits sets the commit history for a given reference
func (m *MockRepository) SetCommits(ref string, commits []Commit) {
        m.mu.Lock()
        defer m.mu.Unlock()
        m.commits[ref] = commits
}

// IsClosed returns whether the repository has been closed
func (m *MockRepository) IsClosed() bool {
        m.mu.RLock()
        defer m.mu.RUnlock()
        return m.closed
}

// Package git provides Git object manipulation functionality for REST API operations.
// This package extends the existing git package with object management capabilities.
package git

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "strings"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/filemode"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/storage"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// TreeBuilder helps build hierarchical Git tree structures
type TreeBuilder struct {
        storer storage.Storer
        logger *logging.Logger
        files  map[string]TreeFileEntry
}

// TreeFileEntry represents a file entry in the tree
type TreeFileEntry struct {
        Hash plumbing.Hash
        Mode filemode.FileMode
}

// NewTreeBuilder creates a new tree builder
func NewTreeBuilder(storer storage.Storer, logger *logging.Logger) *TreeBuilder {
        return &TreeBuilder{
                storer: storer,
                logger: logger,
                files:  make(map[string]TreeFileEntry),
        }
}

// LoadBaseTree loads an existing tree as the base
func (tb *TreeBuilder) LoadBaseTree(baseTree *object.Tree) error {
        return tb.loadTreeRecursive("", baseTree)
}

// loadTreeRecursive loads tree entries recursively
func (tb *TreeBuilder) loadTreeRecursive(prefix string, tree *object.Tree) error {
        for _, entry := range tree.Entries {
                fullPath := entry.Name
                if prefix != "" {
                        fullPath = prefix + "/" + entry.Name
                }

                if entry.Mode == filemode.Dir {
                        // Load subdirectory
                        subTree, err := tree.Tree(entry.Name)
                        if err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("failed to load subtree %s: %w", entry.Name, err)
                        }
                        if err := tb.loadTreeRecursive(fullPath, subTree); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                } else {
                        // Add file entry
                        tb.files[fullPath] = TreeFileEntry{
                                Hash: entry.Hash,
                                Mode: entry.Mode,
                        }
                }
        }
        return nil
}

// HasFile checks if a file exists in the tree
func (tb *TreeBuilder) HasFile(path string) bool {
        _, exists := tb.files[path]
        return exists
}

// AddFile adds a file to the tree
func (tb *TreeBuilder) AddFile(path string, hash plumbing.Hash, mode filemode.FileMode) error {
        tb.files[path] = TreeFileEntry{
                Hash: hash,
                Mode: mode,
        }
        return nil
}

// RemoveFile removes a file from the tree
func (tb *TreeBuilder) RemoveFile(path string) error {
        delete(tb.files, path)
        return nil
}

// BuildTree builds the final tree structure
func (tb *TreeBuilder) BuildTree() (plumbing.Hash, error) {
        return tb.buildTreeRecursive("")
}

// buildTreeRecursive builds a tree for a specific directory path
func (tb *TreeBuilder) buildTreeRecursive(dirPath string) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
        var entries []object.TreeEntry
        subdirs := make(map[string]bool)

        // Find all files and subdirectories in this directory
        for filePath, fileEntry := range tb.files {
                var relativePath string
                if dirPath == "" {
                        relativePath = filePath
                } else {
                        if !strings.HasPrefix(filePath, dirPath+"/") {
                                continue
                        }
                        relativePath = strings.TrimPrefix(filePath, dirPath+"/")
                }

                // Skip if this file is in a subdirectory
                parts := strings.Split(relativePath, "/")
                if len(parts) > 1 {
                        subdirs[parts[0]] = true
                        continue
                }

                // Add file entry
                entries = append(entries, object.TreeEntry{
                        Name: parts[0],
                        Mode: fileEntry.Mode,
                        Hash: fileEntry.Hash,
                })
        }

        // Add subdirectory entries
        for subdirName := range subdirs {
                var subdirPath string
                if dirPath == "" {
                        subdirPath = subdirName
                } else {
                        subdirPath = dirPath + "/" + subdirName
                }

                subdirTreeHash, err := tb.buildTreeRecursive(subdirPath)
                if err != nil {
                        return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to build subtree for %s: %w", subdirPath, err)
                }

                entries = append(entries, object.TreeEntry{
                        Name: subdirName,
                        Mode: filemode.Dir,
                        Hash: subdirTreeHash,
                })
        }

        // Sort entries (Git requirement)
        for i := 0; i < len(entries); i++ {
                for j := i + 1; j < len(entries); j++ {
                        if entries[i].Name > entries[j].Name {
                                entries[i], entries[j] = entries[j], entries[i]
                        }
                }
        }

        // Create tree object
        tree := &object.Tree{Entries: entries}

        // Encode and store the tree
        encodedTree := tb.storer.NewEncodedObject()
        if err := tree.Encode(encodedTree); err != nil {
                return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode tree: %w", err)
        }

        treeHash, err := tb.storer.SetEncodedObject(encodedTree)
        if err != nil {
                return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to store tree: %w", err)
        }

        return treeHash, nil
}

// GitObjectManager provides Git object manipulation capabilities for REST API operations
type GitObjectManager struct {
        pathConfig *repository.PathConfig
        logger     *logging.Logger
}

// FileOperation represents a file operation type
type FileOperation string

const (
        // FileOperationCreate represents creating a new file
        FileOperationCreate FileOperation = "create"
        // FileOperationUpdate represents updating an existing file
        FileOperationUpdate FileOperation = "update"
        // FileOperationDelete represents deleting a file
        FileOperationDelete FileOperation = "delete"
)

// FileChange represents a change to be made to a file
type FileChange struct {
        // Path is the file path relative to repository root
        Path string `json:"path"`
        // Operation is the type of operation to perform
        Operation FileOperation `json:"operation"`
        // Content is the new file content (for create/update operations)
        Content []byte `json:"content,omitempty"`
        // Mode is the file mode (optional, defaults to 0644 for files)
        Mode *filemode.FileMode `json:"mode,omitempty"`
        // OriginalPath is the original path for rename operations
        OriginalPath string `json:"original_path,omitempty"`
}

// CommitInfo represents commit metadata
type CommitInfo struct {
        // Message is the commit message
        Message string `json:"message"`
        // Author information
        Author object.Signature `json:"author"`
        // Committer information (optional, defaults to Author)
        Committer *object.Signature `json:"committer,omitempty"`
        // Parents are the parent commit hashes
        Parents []plumbing.Hash `json:"parents,omitempty"`
}

// TreeManipulationResult represents the result of tree manipulation operations
type TreeManipulationResult struct {
        // TreeHash is the resulting tree hash
        TreeHash plumbing.Hash
        // ChangedFiles lists all files that were modified
        ChangedFiles []string
        // CreatedFiles lists all files that were created
        CreatedFiles []string
        // DeletedFiles lists all files that were deleted
        DeletedFiles []string
}

// CommitResult represents the result of a commit operation
type CommitResult struct {
        // Hash is the new commit hash
        Hash plumbing.Hash
        // TreeHash is the tree hash
        TreeHash plumbing.Hash
        // Message is the commit message
        Message string
        // Author is the commit author
        Author object.Signature
        // Committer is the commit committer
        Committer object.Signature
        // Parents are the parent commit hashes
        Parents []plumbing.Hash
}

// GitObjectManagerInterface defines the interface for Git object manipulation
type GitObjectManagerInterface interface {
        // OpenRepository opens a Git repository for manipulation
        OpenRepository(ctx context.Context, owner, repo string) (*git.Repository, error)

        // GetRepositoryHead gets the current HEAD reference
        GetRepositoryHead(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository) (*plumbing.Reference, error)

        // CreateTreeFromChanges creates a new tree from a list of file changes
        CreateTreeFromChanges(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, baseTree *object.Tree, changes []FileChange) (*TreeManipulationResult, error)

        // CreateCommit creates a new commit with the specified tree and metadata
        CreateCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, treeHash plumbing.Hash, commitInfo CommitInfo) (*CommitResult, error)

        // ValidateFileChanges validates a list of file changes
        ValidateFileChanges(ctx context.Context, changes []FileChange) error

        // GetFileFromTree gets a file from a tree by path
        GetFileFromTree(ctx context.Context, tree *object.Tree, path string) (*object.File, error)

        // ResolveReference resolves a Git reference to a commit hash
        ResolveReference(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, ref string) (plumbing.Hash, error)
}

// NewGitObjectManager creates a new Git object manager
func NewGitObjectManager(pathConfig *repository.PathConfig, logger *logging.Logger) (*GitObjectManager, error) {
        if pathConfig == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("path configuration is required")
        }
        if logger == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("logger is required")
        }

        return &GitObjectManager{
                pathConfig: pathConfig,
                logger:     logger,
        }, nil
}

// OpenRepository opens a Git repository for manipulation
func (gom *GitObjectManager) OpenRepository(ctx context.Context, owner, repo string) (*git.Repository, error) {
        // Get the repository path using existing path validation
        repoPath, err := repository.GetRepoPath(gom.pathConfig, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to get repository path",
                        zap.String("owner", owner),
                        zap.String("repo", repo),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid repository path: %w", err)
        }

        // Validate repository exists and is accessible
        if err := repository.ValidateRepoPath(gom.pathConfig, repoPath); err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Repository path validation failed",
                        zap.String("path", repoPath),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("repository validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Open the repository using go-git
        gitRepo, err := git.PlainOpen(repoPath)
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to open Git repository",
                        zap.String("path", repoPath),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        gom.logger.Debug("Successfully opened Git repository",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("path", repoPath))

        return gitRepo, nil
}

// GetRepositoryHead gets the current HEAD reference
func (gom *GitObjectManager) GetRepositoryHead(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository) (*plumbing.Reference, error) {
        headRef, err := repo.Head()
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to get repository HEAD", zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD reference: %w", err)
        }

        gom.logger.Debug("Retrieved repository HEAD",
                zap.String("ref", headRef.Name().String()),
                zap.String("hash", headRef.Hash().String()))

        return headRef, nil
}

// ResolveReference resolves a Git reference to a commit hash
func (gom *GitObjectManager) ResolveReference(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, ref string) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
        // Try to parse as direct hash first
        if hash := plumbing.NewHash(ref); !hash.IsZero() {
                // Validate that the hash exists in the repository
                _, err := repo.CommitObject(hash)
                if err == nil {
                        gom.logger.Debug("Resolved reference as direct hash",
                                zap.String("ref", ref),
                                zap.String("hash", hash.String()))
                        return hash, nil
                }
        }

        // Try to resolve as a reference name
        reference, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(ref), true)
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to resolve reference",
                        zap.String("ref", ref),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve reference %s: %w", ref, err)
        }

        hash := reference.Hash()
        gom.logger.Debug("Resolved reference",
                zap.String("ref", ref),
                zap.String("resolved_hash", hash.String()))

        return hash, nil
}

// ValidateFileChanges validates a list of file changes
func (gom *GitObjectManager) ValidateFileChanges(ctx context.Context, changes []FileChange) error {
        if len(changes) == 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("no file changes provided")
        }

        pathValidator := repository.NewGitAPIPathValidator(gom.pathConfig)
        seenPaths := make(map[string]bool)

        for i, change := range changes {
                // Validate path
                if change.Path == "" {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: path is required", i)
                }

                // Check for duplicate paths
                if seenPaths[change.Path] {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: duplicate path %s", i, change.Path)
                }
                seenPaths[change.Path] = true

                // Validate file path using our API path validator
                if err := pathValidator.ValidateFilePath(change.Path); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: invalid path %s: %w", i, change.Path, err)
                }

                // Validate operation-specific requirements
                switch change.Operation {
                case FileOperationCreate, FileOperationUpdate:
                        // Content is required for create/update operations
                        if change.Content == nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: content is required for %s operation", i, change.Operation)
                        }
                case FileOperationDelete:
                        // Content should not be provided for delete operations
                        if change.Content != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: content should not be provided for delete operation", i)
                        }
                default:
                        return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: invalid operation %s", i, change.Operation)
                }

                // Validate file mode if provided
                if change.Mode != nil {
                        mode := *change.Mode
                        if mode != filemode.Regular && mode != filemode.Executable && mode != filemode.Symlink {
                                return fmt.Errorf("file change %d: invalid file mode %s", i, mode)
                        }
                }
        }

        gom.logger.Debug("File changes validation passed", zap.Int("change_count", len(changes)))
        return nil
}

// GetFileFromTree gets a file from a tree by path
func (gom *GitObjectManager) GetFileFromTree(ctx context.Context, tree *object.Tree, path string) (*object.File, error) {
        file, err := tree.File(path)
        if err != nil {
                // Check if it's a "file not found" error
                if err == object.ErrFileNotFound {
                        gom.logger.Debug("File not found in tree", zap.String("path", path))
                        return nil, nil // Return nil without error for missing files
                }
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to get file from tree",
                        zap.String("path", path),
                        zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get file %s from tree: %w", path, err)
        }

        gom.logger.Debug("Retrieved file from tree",
                zap.String("path", path),
                zap.String("hash", file.Hash.String()))

        return file, nil
}

// CreateTreeFromChanges creates a new tree from a list of file changes
func (gom *GitObjectManager) CreateTreeFromChanges(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, baseTree *object.Tree, changes []FileChange) (*TreeManipulationResult, error) {
        // Validate changes first
        if err := gom.ValidateFileChanges(ctx, changes); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Get the storer to work with objects
        storer := repo.Storer

        // Build a tree structure that handles directories properly
        treeBuilder := NewTreeBuilder(storer, gom.logger)

        // Start with base tree if it exists
        if baseTree != nil {
                if err := treeBuilder.LoadBaseTree(baseTree); err != nil {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load base tree: %w", err)
                }
        }

        // Track changes for result
        result := &TreeManipulationResult{
                ChangedFiles: make([]string, 0),
                CreatedFiles: make([]string, 0),
                DeletedFiles: make([]string, 0),
        }

        // Process each file change
        for _, change := range changes {
                switch change.Operation {
                case FileOperationCreate, FileOperationUpdate:
                        // Create a blob from the content
                        blob := &object.Blob{}
                        blob.Size = int64(len(change.Content))

                        // Create an encoded object for the blob
                        blobReader := strings.NewReader(string(change.Content))
                        encodedBlob := &plumbing.MemoryObject{}
                        encodedBlob.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
                        encodedBlob.SetSize(blob.Size)

                        // Write content to the encoded object
                        writer, err := encodedBlob.Writer()
                        if err != nil {
                                gom.logger.Error("Failed to create blob writer",
                                        zap.String("path", change.Path),
                                        zap.Error(err))
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create blob writer for %s: %w", change.Path, err)
                        }

                        if _, err := io.Copy(writer, blobReader); err != nil {
                                _ = writer.Close()
                                gom.logger.Error("Failed to write blob content",
                                        zap.String("path", change.Path),
                                        zap.Error(err))
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write blob content for %s: %w", change.Path, err)
                        }
                        _ = writer.Close()

                        // Store the blob object
                        blobHash, err := storer.SetEncodedObject(encodedBlob)
                        if err != nil {
                                gom.logger.Error("Failed to store blob",
                                        zap.String("path", change.Path),
                                        zap.Error(err))
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to store blob for %s: %w", change.Path, err)
                        }

                        // Determine file mode
                        mode := filemode.Regular
                        if change.Mode != nil {
                                mode = *change.Mode
                        }

                        // Check if this is an update
                        isUpdate := treeBuilder.HasFile(change.Path)

                        // Add file to tree builder
                        if err := treeBuilder.AddFile(change.Path, blobHash, mode); err != nil {
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to add file to tree: %w", err)
                        }

                        // Track the change
                        if isUpdate {
                                result.ChangedFiles = append(result.ChangedFiles, change.Path)
                        } else {
                                result.CreatedFiles = append(result.CreatedFiles, change.Path)
                        }

                        gom.logger.Debug("Processed file operation",
                                zap.String("operation", string(change.Operation)),
                                zap.String("path", change.Path),
                                zap.String("blob_hash", blobHash.String()),
                                zap.Bool("is_update", isUpdate))

                case FileOperationDelete:
                        // Check if file exists
                        if !treeBuilder.HasFile(change.Path) {
                                gom.logger.Warn("Attempted to delete non-existent file",
                                        zap.String("path", change.Path))
                                continue // Skip non-existent files
                        }

                        // Remove the file from tree builder
                        if err := treeBuilder.RemoveFile(change.Path); err != nil {
                                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to remove file from tree: %w", err)
                        }

                        result.DeletedFiles = append(result.DeletedFiles, change.Path)

                        gom.logger.Debug("Processed file deletion",
                                zap.String("path", change.Path))
                }
        }

        // Build the final tree
        treeHash, err := treeBuilder.BuildTree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", err)
        }

        result.TreeHash = treeHash

        gom.logger.Debug("Created new tree",
                zap.String("tree_hash", treeHash.String()),
                zap.Int("created_files", len(result.CreatedFiles)),
                zap.Int("changed_files", len(result.ChangedFiles)),
                zap.Int("deleted_files", len(result.DeletedFiles)))

        return result, nil
}

// CreateCommit creates a new commit with the specified tree and metadata
func (gom *GitObjectManager) CreateCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, treeHash plumbing.Hash, commitInfo CommitInfo) (*CommitResult, error) {
        // Validate commit info
        if commitInfo.Message == "" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit message is required")
        }

        // Set committer to author if not provided
        committer := commitInfo.Author
        if commitInfo.Committer != nil {
                committer = *commitInfo.Committer
        }

        // Ensure timestamps are set
        now := time.Now()
        if commitInfo.Author.When.IsZero() {
                commitInfo.Author.When = now
        }
        if committer.When.IsZero() {
                committer.When = now
        }

        // Create commit object
        commit := &object.Commit{
                Hash:         plumbing.ZeroHash, // Will be calculated when storing
                Author:       commitInfo.Author,
                Committer:    committer,
                Message:      commitInfo.Message,
                TreeHash:     treeHash,
                ParentHashes: commitInfo.Parents,
        }

        // Create encoded object for the commit using the repository storer
        encodedCommit := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
        if err := commit.Encode(encodedCommit); err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to encode commit", zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode commit: %w", err)
        }

        // Store the commit object
        commitHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(encodedCommit)
        if err != nil {
                gom.logger.Error("Failed to store commit object", zap.Error(err))
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to store commit object: %w", err)
        }

        // Create result
        result := &CommitResult{
                Hash:      commitHash,
                TreeHash:  treeHash,
                Message:   commitInfo.Message,
                Author:    commitInfo.Author,
                Committer: committer,
                Parents:   commitInfo.Parents,
        }

        gom.logger.Info("Created new commit",
                zap.String("commit_hash", commitHash.String()),
                zap.String("tree_hash", treeHash.String()),
                zap.String("author", commitInfo.Author.Name),
                zap.String("message", commitInfo.Message),
                zap.Int("parent_count", len(commitInfo.Parents)))

        return result, nil
}

package git

import (
        "sync"
        "time"

        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
)

// SimpleRepoCache is a thread-safe, simple repository cache
type SimpleRepoCache struct {
        mu    sync.RWMutex
        repos map[string]*cachedRepo
}

type cachedRepo struct {
        repo     *git.Repository
        lastUsed time.Time
        path     string
}

var (
        globalSimpleCache *SimpleRepoCache
        initOnce          sync.Once
)

// GetSimpleCache returns the global simple cache instance
func GetSimpleCache() *SimpleRepoCache {
        initOnce.Do(func() {
                globalSimpleCache = &SimpleRepoCache{
                        repos: make(map[string]*cachedRepo),
                }
                // Start cleanup goroutine
                go globalSimpleCache.cleanup()
        })
        return globalSimpleCache
}

// Get retrieves a repository from cache or opens it if not cached
func (c *SimpleRepoCache) Get(path string) (*git.Repository, error) {
        c.mu.RLock()
        if cached, exists := c.repos[path]; exists {
                repo := cached.repo
                c.mu.RUnlock()

                // Update lastUsed with a write lock
                c.mu.Lock()
                if cached, stillExists := c.repos[path]; stillExists {
                        cached.lastUsed = time.Now()
                }
                c.mu.Unlock()

                return repo, nil
        }
        c.mu.RUnlock()

        // Open repository
        repo, err := git.PlainOpen(path)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        // Cache it
        c.mu.Lock()
        c.repos[path] = &cachedRepo{
                repo:     repo,
                lastUsed: time.Now(),
                path:     path,
        }
        c.mu.Unlock()

        return repo, nil
}

// cleanup removes old entries every 5 minutes
func (c *SimpleRepoCache) cleanup() {
        ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Minute)
        defer ticker.Stop()

        for range ticker.C {
                c.mu.Lock()
                cutoff := time.Now().Add(-10 * time.Minute) // Remove after 10 minutes of inactivity
                for path, cached := range c.repos {
                        if cached.lastUsed.Before(cutoff) {
                                delete(c.repos, path)
                        }
                }
                c.mu.Unlock()
        }
}

// OpenRepositorySimple opens a repository with simple caching
func OpenRepositorySimple(path string) (Repository, error) {
        cache := GetSimpleCache()
        gitRepo, err := cache.Get(path)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }

        return &GoGitRepository{
                path: path,
                repo: gitRepo,
                mu:   sync.RWMutex{},
        }, nil
}

// Package git provides transaction management for atomic multi-file Git operations.
package git

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "sync"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// TransactionState represents the state of a transaction
type TransactionState string

const (
        // TransactionStateActive - transaction is active and can accept operations
        TransactionStateActive TransactionState = "active"
        // TransactionStateValidating - transaction is being validated
        TransactionStateValidating TransactionState = "validating"
        // TransactionStateCommitting - transaction is being committed
        TransactionStateCommitting TransactionState = "committing"
        // TransactionStateCommitted - transaction has been successfully committed
        TransactionStateCommitted TransactionState = "committed"
        // TransactionStateRolledBack - transaction has been rolled back
        TransactionStateRolledBack TransactionState = "rolled_back"
        // TransactionStateFailed - transaction has failed
        TransactionStateFailed TransactionState = "failed"
)

// TransactionOptions configures transaction behavior
type TransactionOptions struct {
        // Timeout is the maximum duration for the transaction
        Timeout time.Duration
        // ValidateOnly performs validation without committing
        ValidateOnly bool
        // AllowPartialCommit allows committing even if some operations fail
        AllowPartialCommit bool
        // MaxRetries is the maximum number of retry attempts
        MaxRetries int
}

// TransactionOperation represents a single operation within a transaction
type TransactionOperation struct {
        // ID is a unique identifier for this operation
        ID string
        // Type is the operation type
        Type FileOperation
        // FileChange contains the file change details
        FileChange FileChange
        // State is the current state of this operation
        State TransactionState
        // Error contains any error that occurred during this operation
        Error error
        // Timestamp is when this operation was added
        Timestamp time.Time
}

// TransactionResult represents the result of a transaction
type TransactionResult struct {
        // TransactionID is the unique identifier for this transaction
        TransactionID string
        // State is the final state of the transaction
        State TransactionState
        // CommitResult contains the commit information if successful
        CommitResult *CommitResult
        // Operations contains details about all operations
        Operations []*TransactionOperation
        // SuccessfulOperations lists IDs of successful operations
        SuccessfulOperations []string
        // FailedOperations lists IDs and errors of failed operations
        FailedOperations map[string]error
        // StartTime is when the transaction started
        StartTime time.Time
        // EndTime is when the transaction completed
        EndTime time.Time
        // Duration is the total transaction duration
        Duration time.Duration
}

// Transaction represents an atomic multi-file operation
type Transaction struct {
        // ID is the unique identifier for this transaction
        ID string
        // State is the current transaction state
        State TransactionState
        // Repository is the target Git repository
        Repository *git.Repository
        // BaseCommitHash is the base commit for this transaction
        BaseCommitHash plumbing.Hash
        // BaseTree is the base tree for this transaction
        BaseTree *object.Tree
        // Operations contains all operations in this transaction
        Operations []*TransactionOperation
        // CommitInfo contains commit metadata
        CommitInfo CommitInfo
        // Options contains transaction configuration
        Options TransactionOptions
        // StartTime is when the transaction was created
        StartTime time.Time
        // TimeoutTimer tracks transaction timeout
        TimeoutTimer *time.Timer
        // mutex protects concurrent access
        mutex sync.RWMutex
        // manager is the transaction manager reference
        manager *TransactionManager
}

// TransactionManager manages Git transactions for atomic multi-file operations
type TransactionManager struct {
        objectManager GitObjectManagerInterface
        logger        *logging.Logger
        // activeTransactions tracks all active transactions
        activeTransactions map[string]*Transaction
        // mutex protects concurrent access to activeTransactions
        mutex sync.RWMutex
        // defaultTimeout is the default transaction timeout
        defaultTimeout time.Duration
}

// TransactionManagerInterface defines the interface for transaction management
type TransactionManagerInterface interface {
        // BeginTransaction starts a new transaction
        BeginTransaction(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, baseCommit plumbing.Hash, commitInfo CommitInfo, options TransactionOptions) (*Transaction, error)

        // AddOperation adds an operation to a transaction
        AddOperation(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction, operation TransactionOperation) error

        // ValidateTransaction validates all operations in a transaction
        ValidateTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) error

        // CommitTransaction commits all operations in a transaction atomically
        CommitTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) (*TransactionResult, error)

        // RollbackTransaction rolls back a transaction
        RollbackTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) error

        // GetTransaction retrieves a transaction by ID
        GetTransaction(txnID string) (*Transaction, error)

        // ListActiveTransactions returns all active transactions
        ListActiveTransactions() []*Transaction

        // CleanupTransaction removes a completed transaction
        CleanupTransaction(txnID string)
}

// NewTransactionManager creates a new transaction manager
func NewTransactionManager(objectManager GitObjectManagerInterface, logger *logging.Logger) *TransactionManager {
        return &TransactionManager{
                objectManager:      objectManager,
                logger:             logger,
                activeTransactions: make(map[string]*Transaction),
                defaultTimeout:     5 * time.Minute, // Default 5-minute timeout
        }
}

// BeginTransaction starts a new transaction
func (tm *TransactionManager) BeginTransaction(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, baseCommit plumbing.Hash, commitInfo CommitInfo, options TransactionOptions) (*Transaction, error) {
        txnID := fmt.Sprintf("txn_%d_%s", time.Now().UnixNano(), generateRandomID(8))

        tm.logger.Info("Beginning new transaction",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txnID),
                zap.String("base_commit", baseCommit.String()),
                zap.Duration("timeout", options.Timeout))

        // Set default timeout if not specified
        if options.Timeout == 0 {
                options.Timeout = tm.defaultTimeout
        }

        // Get base tree from commit
        commitObj, err := repo.CommitObject(baseCommit)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base commit: %w", err)
        }

        baseTree, err := commitObj.Tree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get base tree: %w", err)
        }

        txn := &Transaction{
                ID:             txnID,
                State:          TransactionStateActive,
                Repository:     repo,
                BaseCommitHash: baseCommit,
                BaseTree:       baseTree,
                Operations:     make([]*TransactionOperation, 0),
                CommitInfo:     commitInfo,
                Options:        options,
                StartTime:      time.Now(),
                manager:        tm,
        }

        // Set up timeout timer
        txn.TimeoutTimer = time.AfterFunc(options.Timeout, func() {
                tm.logger.Warn("Transaction timeout",
                        zap.String("transaction_id", txnID),
                        zap.Duration("timeout", options.Timeout))
                if rollbackErr := tm.RollbackTransaction(ctx, txn); rollbackErr != nil {
                        tm.logger.Error("Failed to rollback timed-out transaction",
                                zap.String("transaction_id", txnID),
                                zap.Error(rollbackErr))
                }
        })

        // Store transaction
        tm.mutex.Lock()
        tm.activeTransactions[txnID] = txn
        tm.mutex.Unlock()

        return txn, nil
}

// AddOperation adds an operation to a transaction
func (tm *TransactionManager) AddOperation(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction, operation TransactionOperation) error {
        txn.mutex.Lock()
        defer txn.mutex.Unlock()

        if txn.State != TransactionStateActive {
                return fmt.Errorf("cannot add operation to transaction in state: %s", txn.State)
        }

        // Generate operation ID if not provided
        if operation.ID == "" {
                operation.ID = fmt.Sprintf("op_%d_%s", len(txn.Operations), generateRandomID(6))
        }

        operation.State = TransactionStateActive
        operation.Timestamp = time.Now()

        tm.logger.Debug("Adding operation to transaction",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.String("operation_id", operation.ID),
                zap.String("operation_type", string(operation.Type)),
                zap.String("file_path", operation.FileChange.Path))

        txn.Operations = append(txn.Operations, &operation)
        return nil
}

// ValidateTransaction validates all operations in a transaction
func (tm *TransactionManager) ValidateTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) error {
        txn.mutex.Lock()
        defer txn.mutex.Unlock()

        if txn.State != TransactionStateActive {
                return fmt.Errorf("cannot validate transaction in state: %s", txn.State)
        }

        txn.State = TransactionStateValidating

        tm.logger.Info("Validating transaction",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.Int("operation_count", len(txn.Operations)))

        // Extract file changes for validation
        changes := make([]FileChange, len(txn.Operations))
        for i, op := range txn.Operations {
                changes[i] = op.FileChange
        }

        // Validate all file changes
        if err := tm.objectManager.ValidateFileChanges(ctx, changes); err != nil {
                txn.State = TransactionStateFailed
                return fmt.Errorf("transaction validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Validate individual operations
        for _, op := range txn.Operations {
                op.State = TransactionStateValidating

                // Check for file existence if needed
                if op.Type == FileOperationUpdate || op.Type == FileOperationDelete {
                        _, err := tm.objectManager.GetFileFromTree(ctx, txn.BaseTree, op.FileChange.Path)
                        if err != nil {
                                op.State = TransactionStateFailed
                                op.Error = fmt.Errorf("file not found for %s operation: %s", op.Type, op.FileChange.Path)
                                if !txn.Options.AllowPartialCommit {
                                        txn.State = TransactionStateFailed
                                        return op.Error
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        // If we get here, validation passed
        txn.State = TransactionStateActive

        tm.logger.Info("Transaction validation successful",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID))

        return nil
}

// CommitTransaction commits all operations in a transaction atomically
func (tm *TransactionManager) CommitTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) (*TransactionResult, error) {
        txn.mutex.Lock()
        defer txn.mutex.Unlock()

        if txn.State != TransactionStateActive {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot commit transaction in state: %s", txn.State)
        }

        txn.State = TransactionStateCommitting

        tm.logger.Info("Committing transaction",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.Int("operation_count", len(txn.Operations)))

        result := &TransactionResult{
                TransactionID:        txn.ID,
                Operations:           txn.Operations,
                SuccessfulOperations: make([]string, 0),
                FailedOperations:     make(map[string]error),
                StartTime:            txn.StartTime,
        }

        // Stop timeout timer
        if txn.TimeoutTimer != nil {
                txn.TimeoutTimer.Stop()
        }

        // If this is a validation-only transaction, return success without committing
        if txn.Options.ValidateOnly {
                result.State = TransactionStateCommitted
                result.EndTime = time.Now()
                result.Duration = result.EndTime.Sub(result.StartTime)
                txn.State = TransactionStateCommitted

                tm.logger.Info("Validation-only transaction completed",
                        zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID))

                return result, nil
        }

        // Prepare file changes for atomic commit
        validChanges := make([]FileChange, 0, len(txn.Operations))
        for _, op := range txn.Operations {
                if op.State != TransactionStateFailed {
                        validChanges = append(validChanges, op.FileChange)
                        result.SuccessfulOperations = append(result.SuccessfulOperations, op.ID)
                } else {
                        result.FailedOperations[op.ID] = op.Error
                }
        }

        // If no valid changes and not allowing partial commits, fail
        if len(validChanges) == 0 && !txn.Options.AllowPartialCommit {
                txn.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.EndTime = time.Now()
                result.Duration = result.EndTime.Sub(result.StartTime)
                return result, fmt.Errorf("no valid operations to commit")
        }

        // Create tree from changes
