        treeResult, err := tm.objectManager.CreateTreeFromChanges(ctx, txn.Repository, txn.BaseTree, validChanges)
        if err != nil {
                txn.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.EndTime = time.Now()
                result.Duration = result.EndTime.Sub(result.StartTime)
                return result, fmt.Errorf("failed to create tree: %w", err)
        }

        // Create commit
        commitResult, err := tm.objectManager.CreateCommit(ctx, txn.Repository, treeResult.TreeHash, txn.CommitInfo)
        if err != nil {
                txn.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.State = TransactionStateFailed
                result.EndTime = time.Now()
                result.Duration = result.EndTime.Sub(result.StartTime)
                return result, fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", err)
        }

        // Success!
        txn.State = TransactionStateCommitted
        result.State = TransactionStateCommitted
        result.CommitResult = commitResult
        result.EndTime = time.Now()
        result.Duration = result.EndTime.Sub(result.StartTime)

        tm.logger.Info("Transaction committed successfully",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.String("commit_hash", commitResult.Hash.String()),
                zap.Duration("duration", result.Duration),
                zap.Int("successful_operations", len(result.SuccessfulOperations)),
                zap.Int("failed_operations", len(result.FailedOperations)))

        return result, nil
}

// RollbackTransaction rolls back a transaction
func (tm *TransactionManager) RollbackTransaction(ctx context.Context, txn *Transaction) error {
        txn.mutex.Lock()
        defer txn.mutex.Unlock()

        if txn.State == TransactionStateCommitted || txn.State == TransactionStateRolledBack {
                return fmt.Errorf("cannot rollback transaction in state: %s", txn.State)
        }

        tm.logger.Info("Rolling back transaction",
                zap.String("transaction_id", txn.ID),
                zap.String("previous_state", string(txn.State)))

        // Stop timeout timer
        if txn.TimeoutTimer != nil {
                txn.TimeoutTimer.Stop()
        }

        // Mark all operations as rolled back
        for _, op := range txn.Operations {
                if op.State != TransactionStateFailed {
                        op.State = TransactionStateRolledBack
                }
        }

        txn.State = TransactionStateRolledBack
        return nil
}

// GetTransaction retrieves a transaction by ID
func (tm *TransactionManager) GetTransaction(txnID string) (*Transaction, error) {
        tm.mutex.RLock()
        defer tm.mutex.RUnlock()

        txn, exists := tm.activeTransactions[txnID]
        if !exists {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("transaction not found: %s", txnID)
        }

        return txn, nil
}

// ListActiveTransactions returns all active transactions
func (tm *TransactionManager) ListActiveTransactions() []*Transaction {
        tm.mutex.RLock()
        defer tm.mutex.RUnlock()

        transactions := make([]*Transaction, 0, len(tm.activeTransactions))
        for _, txn := range tm.activeTransactions {
                transactions = append(transactions, txn)
        }

        return transactions
}

// CleanupTransaction removes a completed transaction
func (tm *TransactionManager) CleanupTransaction(txnID string) {
        tm.mutex.Lock()
        defer tm.mutex.Unlock()

        if txn, exists := tm.activeTransactions[txnID]; exists {
                // Stop timeout timer if still running
                if txn.TimeoutTimer != nil {
                        txn.TimeoutTimer.Stop()
                }
                delete(tm.activeTransactions, txnID)

                tm.logger.Debug("Cleaned up transaction",
                        zap.String("transaction_id", txnID))
        }
}

// Helper function to generate random IDs
func generateRandomID(length int) string {
        // Simple implementation - in production, use crypto/rand
        chars := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
        result := make([]byte, length)
        for i := 0; i < length; i++ {
                result[i] = chars[time.Now().UnixNano()%int64(len(chars))]
        }
        return string(result)
}

// GetOperationByID returns an operation by its ID
func (txn *Transaction) GetOperationByID(operationID string) (*TransactionOperation, error) {
        txn.mutex.RLock()
        defer txn.mutex.RUnlock()

        for _, op := range txn.Operations {
                if op.ID == operationID {
                        return op, nil
                }
        }

        return nil, fmt.Errorf("operation not found: %s", operationID)
}

// GetOperationCount returns the number of operations in the transaction
func (txn *Transaction) GetOperationCount() int {
        txn.mutex.RLock()
        defer txn.mutex.RUnlock()

        return len(txn.Operations)
}

// IsExpired checks if the transaction has exceeded its timeout
func (txn *Transaction) IsExpired() bool {
        return time.Since(txn.StartTime) > txn.Options.Timeout
}

// GetSuccessfulOperationCount returns the count of successful operations
func (result *TransactionResult) GetSuccessfulOperationCount() int {
        return len(result.SuccessfulOperations)
}

// GetFailedOperationCount returns the count of failed operations
func (result *TransactionResult) GetFailedOperationCount() int {
        return len(result.FailedOperations)
}

// IsPartialSuccess returns true if some operations succeeded and some failed
func (result *TransactionResult) IsPartialSuccess() bool {
        return len(result.SuccessfulOperations) > 0 && len(result.FailedOperations) > 0
}

package logging

import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"

        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// ErrorType represents different types of errors
type ErrorType string

const (
        ErrorTypeValidation   ErrorType = "validation"
        ErrorTypeNotFound     ErrorType = "not_found"
        ErrorTypeUnauthorized ErrorType = "unauthorized"
        ErrorTypeForbidden    ErrorType = "forbidden"
        ErrorTypeConflict     ErrorType = "conflict"
        ErrorTypeInternal     ErrorType = "internal"
        ErrorTypeExternal     ErrorType = "external"
        ErrorTypeTimeout      ErrorType = "timeout"
        ErrorTypeRateLimit    ErrorType = "rate_limit"
)

// AppError represents a structured application error
type AppError struct {
        Type        ErrorType              `json:"type"`
        Code        string                 `json:"code"`
        Message     string                 `json:"message"`
        Details     string                 `json:"details,omitempty"`
        Cause       error                  `json:"-"`
        Context     map[string]interface{} `json:"context,omitempty"`
        StatusCode  int                    `json:"-"`
        RequestID   string                 `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
        Retryable   bool                   `json:"retryable"`
        UserMessage string                 `json:"user_message,omitempty"`
}

// Error implements the error interface
func (e *AppError) Error() string {
        if e.Cause != nil {
                return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s (caused by: %v)", e.Code, e.Message, e.Cause)
        }
        return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", e.Code, e.Message)
}

// Unwrap implements the errors.Unwrap interface
func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error {
        return e.Cause
}

// WithContext adds context to the error
func (e *AppError) WithContext(key string, value interface{}) *AppError {
        if e.Context == nil {
                e.Context = make(map[string]interface{})
        }
        e.Context[key] = value
        return e
}

// WithCause adds a cause to the error
func (e *AppError) WithCause(cause error) *AppError {
        e.Cause = cause
        return e
}

// WithRequestID adds a request ID to the error
func (e *AppError) WithRequestID(requestID string) *AppError {
        e.RequestID = requestID
        return e
}

// WithDetails adds details to the error
func (e *AppError) WithDetails(details string) *AppError {
        e.Details = details
        return e
}

// ErrorBuilder helps build AppError instances
type ErrorBuilder struct {
        errorType   ErrorType
        code        string
        message     string
        details     string
        cause       error
        context     map[string]interface{}
        statusCode  int
        retryable   bool
        userMessage string
}

// NewErrorBuilder creates a new error builder
func NewErrorBuilder(errorType ErrorType, code, message string) *ErrorBuilder {
        return &ErrorBuilder{
                errorType: errorType,
                code:      code,
                message:   message,
                context:   make(map[string]interface{}),
        }
}

// WithDetails adds details to the error
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithDetails(details string) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.details = details
        return b
}

// WithCause adds a cause to the error
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithCause(cause error) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.cause = cause
        return b
}

// WithContext adds context to the error
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithContext(key string, value interface{}) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.context[key] = value
        return b
}

// WithStatusCode sets the HTTP status code
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithStatusCode(statusCode int) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.statusCode = statusCode
        return b
}

// WithRetryable sets whether the error is retryable
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithRetryable(retryable bool) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.retryable = retryable
        return b
}

// WithUserMessage sets a user-friendly message
func (b *ErrorBuilder) WithUserMessage(userMessage string) *ErrorBuilder {
        b.userMessage = userMessage
        return b
}

// Build creates the AppError
func (b *ErrorBuilder) Build() *AppError {
        statusCode := b.statusCode
        if statusCode == 0 {
                statusCode = getDefaultStatusCode(b.errorType)
        }

        return &AppError{
                Type:        b.errorType,
                Code:        b.code,
                Message:     b.message,
                Details:     b.details,
                Cause:       b.cause,
                Context:     b.context,
                StatusCode:  statusCode,
                Retryable:   b.retryable,
                UserMessage: b.userMessage,
        }
}

// getDefaultStatusCode returns default HTTP status codes for error types
func getDefaultStatusCode(errorType ErrorType) int {
        switch errorType {
        case ErrorTypeValidation:
                return http.StatusBadRequest
        case ErrorTypeNotFound:
                return http.StatusNotFound
        case ErrorTypeUnauthorized:
                return http.StatusUnauthorized
        case ErrorTypeForbidden:
                return http.StatusForbidden
        case ErrorTypeConflict:
                return http.StatusConflict
        case ErrorTypeTimeout:
                return http.StatusRequestTimeout
        case ErrorTypeRateLimit:
                return http.StatusTooManyRequests
        case ErrorTypeExternal:
                return http.StatusBadGateway
        default:
                return http.StatusInternalServerError
        }
}

// Common error constructors
func NewValidationError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeValidation, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("Invalid input provided").
                Build()
}

func NewNotFoundError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeNotFound, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("The requested resource was not found").
                Build()
}

func NewUnauthorizedError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeUnauthorized, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("Authentication required").
                Build()
}

func NewForbiddenError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeForbidden, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("Access denied").
                Build()
}

func NewInternalError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeInternal, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("An internal error occurred").
                WithRetryable(true).
                Build()
}

func NewExternalError(code, message string) *AppError {
        return NewErrorBuilder(ErrorTypeExternal, code, message).
                WithUserMessage("External service error").
                WithRetryable(true).
                Build()
}

// ErrorHandler provides centralized error handling and logging
type ErrorHandler struct {
        logger *Logger
}

// NewErrorHandler creates a new error handler
func NewErrorHandler(logger *Logger) *ErrorHandler {
        return &ErrorHandler{
                logger: logger,
        }
}

// Handle processes an error and returns appropriate HTTP response
func (h *ErrorHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
        // Extract request ID from context
        requestID := ""
        if id, ok := ctx.Value(RequestIDKey).(string); ok {
                requestID = id
        }

        var appErr *AppError

        // Convert to AppError if it's not already
        if ae, ok := err.(*AppError); ok {
                appErr = ae
                if appErr.RequestID == "" {
                        appErr.RequestID = requestID
                }
        } else {
                // Wrap unknown errors as internal errors
                appErr = NewInternalError("UNKNOWN_ERROR", "An unexpected error occurred").
                        WithCause(err).
                        WithRequestID(requestID)
        }

        // Log the error
        h.logError(ctx, appErr)

        // Send HTTP response
        h.sendErrorResponse(w, appErr)
}

// logError logs the error with appropriate level and context
func (h *ErrorHandler) logError(ctx context.Context, appErr *AppError) {
        fields := []zap.Field{
                zap.String("error_type", string(appErr.Type)),
                zap.String("error_code", appErr.Code),
                zap.String("error_message", appErr.Message),
                zap.Bool("retryable", appErr.Retryable),
                zap.Int("status_code", appErr.StatusCode),
        }

        if appErr.RequestID != "" {
                fields = append(fields, zap.String("request_id", appErr.RequestID))
        }

        if appErr.Details != "" {
                fields = append(fields, zap.String("details", appErr.Details))
        }

        // Add context fields
        for key, value := range appErr.Context {
                fields = append(fields, zap.Any(fmt.Sprintf("ctx_%s", key), value))
        }

        // Log at appropriate level
        switch appErr.Type {
        case ErrorTypeValidation, ErrorTypeNotFound, ErrorTypeUnauthorized, ErrorTypeForbidden:
                h.logger.LogWarning(ctx, "Client error", fields...)
        case ErrorTypeInternal, ErrorTypeExternal:
                h.logger.LogError(ctx, appErr.Cause, "Server error", fields...)
        default:
                h.logger.LogError(ctx, appErr.Cause, "Application error", fields...)
        }
}

// sendErrorResponse sends an HTTP error response
func (h *ErrorHandler) sendErrorResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, appErr *AppError) {
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.WriteHeader(appErr.StatusCode)

        // Create response body
        response := map[string]interface{}{
                "error": map[string]interface{}{
                        "type":    appErr.Type,
                        "code":    appErr.Code,
                        "message": appErr.UserMessage,
                },
        }

        if appErr.RequestID != "" {
                response["request_id"] = appErr.RequestID
        }

        // Include details in non-production environments or for client errors
        if appErr.Type != ErrorTypeInternal || appErr.Details != "" {
                response["error"].(map[string]interface{})["details"] = appErr.Details
        }

        // Encode and send response
        if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response); err != nil {
                // Fallback to plain text if JSON encoding fails
                http.Error(w, "Internal Server Error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
        }
}

// HandlePanic recovers from panics and converts them to errors
func (h *ErrorHandler) HandlePanic(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter) {
        if r := recover(); r != nil {
                var err error
                if e, ok := r.(error); ok {
                        err = e
                } else {
                        err = fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", r)
                }

                appErr := NewInternalError("PANIC", "Request processing failed").
                        WithCause(err).
                        WithDetails(fmt.Sprintf("Panic recovered: %v", r))

                h.Handle(ctx, w, appErr)
        }
}

// Global error handler instance
var globalErrorHandler *ErrorHandler

// InitGlobalErrorHandler initializes the global error handler
func InitGlobalErrorHandler(logger *Logger) {
        globalErrorHandler = NewErrorHandler(logger)
}

// GetGlobalErrorHandler returns the global error handler
func GetGlobalErrorHandler() *ErrorHandler {
        if globalErrorHandler == nil {
                globalErrorHandler = NewErrorHandler(GetGlobalLogger())
        }
        return globalErrorHandler
}

// HandleError is a convenience function using the global error handler
func HandleError(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
        GetGlobalErrorHandler().Handle(ctx, w, err)
}

// HandlePanic is a convenience function using the global error handler
func HandlePanic(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter) {
        GetGlobalErrorHandler().HandlePanic(ctx, w)
}

package logging

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "time"

        "go.uber.org/zap"
        "go.uber.org/zap/zapcore"
        lumberjack "gopkg.in/natefinch/lumberjack.v2"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
)

// Logger wraps zap.Logger with additional functionality
type Logger struct {
        // library를 썼는데, 파이썬이나 Go나 Rust나 로깅패턴이 있음.
        // 로그를 생성하는데 Create Or Get으로 생성함. 빈값으로 로그를 불러오면 Create가 됨.
        // 예전에 생성했던거를 하면 Get을 함.
        // Aspsect of Programming (AOP) 로거를 마치 전역함수처럼 씀. 전역으로 써도 안전함. 처음에 setting을 해두고 복잡하게 쓰지않는 이상 디버깅 용으로 로거를 쓰기때문에
        // Create or Get할때 Project이름은 줌. 로거를 하나만 생성하는데, 그것을 전역으로 씀.
        *zap.Logger
}

// ContextKey is used for context keys to avoid collisions
type ContextKey string

const (
        // RequestIDKey is the context key for request IDs
        RequestIDKey ContextKey = "request_id"
        // CorrelationIDKey is the context key for correlation IDs
        CorrelationIDKey ContextKey = "correlation_id"
        // SkipLoggingKey is the context key for skipping logging
        SkipLoggingKey ContextKey = "skip_logging"
)

// RequestIDGenerator generates unique request IDs
type RequestIDGenerator interface {
        Generate() string
}

// DefaultRequestIDGenerator generates simple timestamp-based IDs
type DefaultRequestIDGenerator struct{}

// Generate creates a new request ID
func (g *DefaultRequestIDGenerator) Generate() string {
        return fmt.Sprintf("%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
}

// NewLogger creates a new logger instance with the given configuration
func NewLogger(cfg config.LoggingConfig) (*Logger, error) {
        // Create encoder config
        encoderConfig := zapcore.EncoderConfig{
                TimeKey:        "timestamp",
                LevelKey:       "level",
                NameKey:        "logger",
                CallerKey:      "caller",
                FunctionKey:    "function",
                MessageKey:     "message",
                StacktraceKey:  "stacktrace",
                LineEnding:     zapcore.DefaultLineEnding,
                EncodeLevel:    zapcore.LowercaseLevelEncoder,
                EncodeTime:     zapcore.ISO8601TimeEncoder,
                EncodeDuration: zapcore.StringDurationEncoder,
                EncodeCaller:   zapcore.ShortCallerEncoder,
        }

        // Create encoder based on format
        var encoder zapcore.Encoder
        switch cfg.Format {
        case "json":
                encoder = zapcore.NewJSONEncoder(encoderConfig)
        case "text":
                encoderConfig.EncodeLevel = zapcore.CapitalColorLevelEncoder
                encoderConfig.EncodeTime = zapcore.RFC3339TimeEncoder
                encoder = zapcore.NewConsoleEncoder(encoderConfig)
        default:
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported log format: %s", cfg.Format)
        }

        // Parse log level
        level, err := zapcore.ParseLevel(cfg.Level)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid log level %s: %w", cfg.Level, err)
        }

        // Create output writers
        var writeSyncer zapcore.WriteSyncer
        switch cfg.Output {
        case "stdout":
                writeSyncer = zapcore.AddSync(os.Stdout)
        case "stderr":
                writeSyncer = zapcore.AddSync(os.Stderr)
        default:
                // File output with rotation
                logRotator := &lumberjack.Logger{
                        Filename:   cfg.Output,
                        MaxSize:    100, // 100 MB
                        MaxBackups: 5,
                        MaxAge:     30, // 30 days
                        Compress:   true,
                }
                writeSyncer = zapcore.AddSync(logRotator)
        }

        // Create core
        core := zapcore.NewCore(encoder, writeSyncer, level)

        // Create logger with additional options
        options := []zap.Option{
                zap.AddCaller(),
                zap.AddStacktrace(zapcore.ErrorLevel),
        }

        if cfg.Development {
                options = append(options, zap.Development())
        }

        zapLogger := zap.New(core, options...)

        return &Logger{
                Logger: zapLogger,
        }, nil
}

// WithRequestID returns a logger with request ID context
func (l *Logger) WithRequestID(requestID string) *zap.Logger {
        return l.With(zap.String("request_id", requestID))
}

// WithCorrelationID returns a logger with correlation ID context
func (l *Logger) WithCorrelationID(correlationID string) *zap.Logger {
        return l.With(zap.String("correlation_id", correlationID))
}

// WithContext returns a logger with context values
func (l *Logger) WithContext(ctx context.Context) *zap.Logger {
        logger := l.Logger

        // Add request ID if present
        if requestID, ok := ctx.Value(RequestIDKey).(string); ok && requestID != "" {
                logger = logger.With(zap.String("request_id", requestID))
        }

        // Add correlation ID if present
        if correlationID, ok := ctx.Value(CorrelationIDKey).(string); ok && correlationID != "" {
                logger = logger.With(zap.String("correlation_id", correlationID))
        }

        return logger
}

// HTTPRequest logs HTTP request details
func (l *Logger) HTTPRequest(ctx context.Context, method, path, userAgent, remoteAddr string, statusCode int, duration time.Duration) {
        logger := l.WithContext(ctx)

        fields := []zap.Field{
                zap.String("method", method),
                zap.String("path", path),
                zap.String("user_agent", userAgent),
                zap.String("remote_addr", remoteAddr),
                zap.Int("status_code", statusCode),
                zap.Duration("duration", duration),
        }

        if statusCode >= 500 {
                logger.Error("HTTP request failed", fields...)
        } else if statusCode >= 400 {
                logger.Warn("HTTP request client error", fields...)
        } else {
                logger.Info("HTTP request completed", fields...)
        }
}

// LogError logs an error with context and additional fields
func (l *Logger) LogError(ctx context.Context, err error, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        logger := l.WithContext(ctx)

        errorFields := []zap.Field{
                zap.Error(err),
        }
        errorFields = append(errorFields, fields...)

        logger.Error(message, errorFields...)
}

// LogWarning logs a warning with context and additional fields
func (l *Logger) LogWarning(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        logger := l.WithContext(ctx)
        logger.Warn(message, fields...)
}

// LogInfo logs an info message with context and additional fields
func (l *Logger) LogInfo(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        logger := l.WithContext(ctx)
        logger.Info(message, fields...)
}

// LogDebug logs a debug message with context and additional fields
func (l *Logger) LogDebug(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        logger := l.WithContext(ctx)
        logger.Debug(message, fields...)
}

// Sync flushes any buffered log entries
func (l *Logger) Sync() error {
        return l.Logger.Sync()
}

// Close ensures all logs are flushed
func (l *Logger) Close() error {
        return l.Sync()
}

// Global logger instance
var globalLogger *Logger

// InitGlobalLogger initializes the global logger
func InitGlobalLogger(cfg config.LoggingConfig) error {
        logger, err := NewLogger(cfg)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize global logger: %w", err)
        }
        globalLogger = logger
        return nil
}

// SetGlobal sets the global logger instance
func SetGlobal(logger *Logger) {
        globalLogger = logger
}

// GetGlobal returns the global logger instance (alias for GetGlobalLogger)
func GetGlobal() *Logger {
        return GetGlobalLogger()
}

// GetGlobalLogger returns the global logger instance
func GetGlobalLogger() *Logger {
        if globalLogger == nil {
                // Fallback to development logger if not initialized
                cfg := config.LoggingConfig{
                        Level:       "info",
                        Format:      "text",
                        Output:      "stdout",
                        Development: true,
                }
                logger, _ := NewLogger(cfg)
                globalLogger = logger
        }
        return globalLogger
}

// Helper functions for global logger
func Info(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        GetGlobalLogger().LogInfo(ctx, message, fields...)
}

func Debug(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        GetGlobalLogger().LogDebug(ctx, message, fields...)
}

func Warn(ctx context.Context, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        GetGlobalLogger().LogWarning(ctx, message, fields...)
}

func Error(ctx context.Context, err error, message string, fields ...zap.Field) {
        GetGlobalLogger().LogError(ctx, err, message, fields...)
}

func HTTPRequest(ctx context.Context, method, path, userAgent, remoteAddr string, statusCode int, duration time.Duration) {
        GetGlobalLogger().HTTPRequest(ctx, method, path, userAgent, remoteAddr, statusCode, duration)
}

package logging

import (
        "context"
        "net/http"
        "time"

        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// ResponseWriter interface for wrapped response writers
type ResponseWriter interface {
        http.ResponseWriter
        Status() int
        BytesWritten() int
}

// responseWriterWrapper wraps http.ResponseWriter to capture status and bytes written
type responseWriterWrapper struct {
        http.ResponseWriter
        status       int
        bytesWritten int
}

func (w *responseWriterWrapper) WriteHeader(code int) {
        w.status = code
        w.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(code)
}

func (w *responseWriterWrapper) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
        n, err := w.ResponseWriter.Write(data)
        w.bytesWritten += n
        return n, err
}

func (w *responseWriterWrapper) Status() int {
        if w.status == 0 {
                return 200
        }
        return w.status
}

func (w *responseWriterWrapper) BytesWritten() int {
        return w.bytesWritten
}

// NewWrapResponseWriter creates a wrapped response writer
func NewWrapResponseWriter(w http.ResponseWriter) ResponseWriter {
        return &responseWriterWrapper{
                ResponseWriter: w,
                status:         0,
                bytesWritten:   0,
        }
}

// RequestIDMiddleware generates and adds request IDs to the context
func RequestIDMiddleware(generator RequestIDGenerator) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        if generator == nil {
                generator = &DefaultRequestIDGenerator{}
        }

        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        requestID := generator.Generate()

                        // Add request ID to context
                        ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), RequestIDKey, requestID)

                        // Add request ID to response header for tracing
                        w.Header().Set("X-Request-ID", requestID)

                        // Continue with the request
                        next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
                })
        }
}

// CorrelationIDMiddleware extracts correlation ID from headers and adds to context
func CorrelationIDMiddleware() func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        // Extract correlation ID from header
                        correlationID := r.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID")
                        if correlationID == "" {
                                // If not provided, use request ID as correlation ID
                                if requestID, ok := r.Context().Value(RequestIDKey).(string); ok {
                                        correlationID = requestID
                                }
                        }

                        // Add correlation ID to context
                        ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), CorrelationIDKey, correlationID)

                        // Add correlation ID to response header
                        w.Header().Set("X-Correlation-ID", correlationID)

                        // Continue with the request
                        next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
                })
        }
}

// LoggingMiddleware logs HTTP requests with context
func LoggingMiddleware(logger *Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        start := time.Now()

                        // Wrap response writer to capture status code
                        ww := NewWrapResponseWriter(w)

                        // Continue with the request
                        next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

                        // Log the request
                        duration := time.Since(start)
                        logger.HTTPRequest(
                                r.Context(),
                                r.Method,
                                r.URL.Path,
                                r.UserAgent(),
                                r.RemoteAddr,
                                ww.Status(),
                                duration,
                        )
                })
        }
}

// ErrorHandlingMiddleware provides centralized error handling and logging
func ErrorHandlingMiddleware(logger *Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        defer func() {
                                if err := recover(); err != nil {
                                        // Log the panic
                                        logger.LogError(
                                                r.Context(),
                                                err.(error),
                                                "HTTP request panic",
                                                zap.String("method", r.Method),
                                                zap.String("path", r.URL.Path),
                                                zap.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
                                                zap.String("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr),
                                        )

                                        // Return 500 Internal Server Error
                                        http.Error(w, "Internal Server Error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
                                }
                        }()

                        next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
                })
        }
}

// HealthCheckMiddleware skips logging for health check endpoints
func HealthCheckMiddleware(healthPaths ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        healthMap := make(map[string]bool)
        for _, path := range healthPaths {
                healthMap[path] = true
        }
        // Default health check paths
        healthMap["/health"] = true
        healthMap["/healthz"] = true
        healthMap["/ping"] = true

        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        // Skip logging for health check endpoints
                        if healthMap[r.URL.Path] {
                                // Add a marker to context to skip logging
                                ctx := context.WithValue(r.Context(), SkipLoggingKey, true)
                                next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
                        } else {
                                next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
                        }
                })
        }
}

// ConditionalLoggingMiddleware only logs if the context doesn't have skip_logging
func ConditionalLoggingMiddleware(logger *Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        start := time.Now()

                        // Wrap response writer to capture status code
                        ww := NewWrapResponseWriter(w)

                        // Continue with the request
                        next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

                        // Only log if not marked to skip
                        if skip, ok := r.Context().Value(SkipLoggingKey).(bool); !ok || !skip {
                                duration := time.Since(start)
                                logger.HTTPRequest(
                                        r.Context(),
                                        r.Method,
                                        r.URL.Path,
                                        r.UserAgent(),
                                        r.RemoteAddr,
                                        ww.Status(),
                                        duration,
                                )
                        }
                })
        }
}

// GetLoggerFromContext extracts logger from request context
func GetLoggerFromContext(ctx context.Context) *zap.Logger {
        logger := GetGlobalLogger()
        return logger.WithContext(ctx)
}

// LogMiddleware sets up the complete logging middleware stack
func LogMiddleware(logger *Logger) []func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return []func(http.Handler) http.Handler{
                RequestIDMiddleware(nil), // Use default generator
                CorrelationIDMiddleware(),
                ErrorHandlingMiddleware(logger),
                HealthCheckMiddleware(), // Skip logging for health checks
                ConditionalLoggingMiddleware(logger),
        }
}

// Package middleware implements HTTP middleware for the Git executor
package middleware

import (
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "regexp"
        "strings"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// SourceType represents the type of calling component
type SourceType string

const (
        // SourceHTTPGateway represents the HTTP Git gateway
        SourceHTTPGateway SourceType = "http-gateway"
        // SourceSSHGateway represents the SSH Git gateway
        SourceSSHGateway SourceType = "ssh-gateway"
        // SourceOrchestrator represents the orchestrator service
        SourceOrchestrator SourceType = "orchestrator"
)

// EndpointType represents the type of endpoint being accessed
type EndpointType string

const (
        // EndpointGitProtocol represents Git Smart HTTP protocol endpoints
        EndpointGitProtocol EndpointType = "git-protocol"
        // EndpointSSHProtocol represents SSH Git protocol endpoints
        EndpointSSHProtocol EndpointType = "ssh-protocol"
        // EndpointRESTAPI represents REST API endpoints
        EndpointRESTAPI EndpointType = "rest-api"
        // EndpointCommon represents common endpoints (health, metrics)
        EndpointCommon EndpointType = "common"
)

// AccessControlRule defines access permissions for source-endpoint combinations
type AccessControlRule struct {
        Source   SourceType
        Endpoint EndpointType
        Allowed  bool
}

// AccessControlConfig configures the access control middleware
type AccessControlConfig struct {
        // Rules defines the access control matrix
        Rules []AccessControlRule
        // DenyByDefault determines if unknown combinations should be denied
        DenyByDefault bool
        // LogSecurityEvents enables logging of security violations
        LogSecurityEvents bool
}

// AccessControlMiddleware enforces endpoint access control based on X-Source header
type AccessControlMiddleware struct {
        config *AccessControlConfig
        logger *logging.Logger

        // Compiled regex patterns for endpoint classification
        gitProtocolPattern *regexp.Regexp
        sshProtocolPattern *regexp.Regexp
        restAPIPattern     *regexp.Regexp
        commonPattern      *regexp.Regexp
}

// NewAccessControlMiddleware creates a new access control middleware
func NewAccessControlMiddleware(config *AccessControlConfig, logger *logging.Logger) (*AccessControlMiddleware, error) {
        if config == nil {
                config = DefaultAccessControlConfig()
        }

        if logger == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("logger is required")
        }

        // Compile endpoint classification patterns
        gitProtocolPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^/[^/]+/[^/]+/(info/refs|git-upload-pack|git-receive-pack)`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile git protocol pattern: %w", err)
        }

        sshProtocolPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^/ssh/(upload-pack|receive-pack)`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile ssh protocol pattern: %w", err)
        }

        restAPIPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^/repos/[^/]+/[^/]+/(tree|blob|commits|diff|file-diff|patch)`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile rest api pattern: %w", err)
        }

        commonPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^/(health|metrics|)$`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile common pattern: %w", err)
        }

        return &AccessControlMiddleware{
                config:             config,
                logger:             logger,
                gitProtocolPattern: gitProtocolPattern,
                sshProtocolPattern: sshProtocolPattern,
                restAPIPattern:     restAPIPattern,
                commonPattern:      commonPattern,
        }, nil
}

// DefaultAccessControlConfig returns the default access control configuration
func DefaultAccessControlConfig() *AccessControlConfig {
        return &AccessControlConfig{
                Rules: []AccessControlRule{
                        // HTTP Gateway access rules
                        {SourceHTTPGateway, EndpointGitProtocol, true},
                        {SourceHTTPGateway, EndpointSSHProtocol, false},
                        {SourceHTTPGateway, EndpointRESTAPI, false},
                        {SourceHTTPGateway, EndpointCommon, true},

                        // SSH Gateway access rules
                        {SourceSSHGateway, EndpointGitProtocol, false},
                        {SourceSSHGateway, EndpointSSHProtocol, true},
                        {SourceSSHGateway, EndpointRESTAPI, false},
                        {SourceSSHGateway, EndpointCommon, true},

                        // Orchestrator access rules
                        {SourceOrchestrator, EndpointGitProtocol, false},
                        {SourceOrchestrator, EndpointSSHProtocol, false},
                        {SourceOrchestrator, EndpointRESTAPI, true},
                        {SourceOrchestrator, EndpointCommon, true},
                },
                DenyByDefault:     true,
                LogSecurityEvents: true,
        }
}

// Middleware returns the HTTP middleware function
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) Middleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                // Extract X-Source header
                sourceHeader := r.Header.Get("X-Source")
                if sourceHeader == "" {
                        acm.logSecurityViolation(r, "", "missing", "Missing X-Source header")
                        acm.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied: X-Source header required")
                        return
                }

                // Validate source type
                source := SourceType(sourceHeader)
                if !acm.isValidSource(source) {
                        acm.logSecurityViolation(r, string(source), "invalid", "Invalid X-Source header value")
                        acm.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Access denied: Invalid X-Source header")
                        return
                }

                // Classify endpoint type
                endpointType := acm.classifyEndpoint(r.URL.Path)

                // Check access permission
                allowed := acm.isAccessAllowed(source, endpointType)
                if !allowed {
                        acm.logSecurityViolation(r, string(source), string(endpointType), "Unauthorized endpoint access attempt")
                        acm.writeErrorResponse(w, http.StatusForbidden,
                                fmt.Sprintf("Access denied: %s cannot access %s endpoints", source, endpointType))
                        return
                }

                // Log successful access
                acm.logAccessAttempt(r, string(source), string(endpointType), "allowed")

                // Continue to next handler
                next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
        })
}

// isValidSource checks if the source type is valid
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) isValidSource(source SourceType) bool {
        switch source {
        case SourceHTTPGateway, SourceSSHGateway, SourceOrchestrator:
                return true
        default:
                return false
        }
}

// classifyEndpoint determines the endpoint type based on the URL path
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) classifyEndpoint(path string) EndpointType {
        // Check in order of specificity
        if acm.gitProtocolPattern.MatchString(path) {
                return EndpointGitProtocol
        }
        if acm.sshProtocolPattern.MatchString(path) {
                return EndpointSSHProtocol
        }
        if acm.restAPIPattern.MatchString(path) {
                return EndpointRESTAPI
        }
        if acm.commonPattern.MatchString(path) {
                return EndpointCommon
        }

        // Default to unknown (will be denied by default)
        return "unknown"
}

// isAccessAllowed checks if the source is allowed to access the endpoint type
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) isAccessAllowed(source SourceType, endpointType EndpointType) bool {
        // Check explicit rules first
        for _, rule := range acm.config.Rules {
                if rule.Source == source && rule.Endpoint == endpointType {
                        return rule.Allowed
                }
        }

        // Apply default policy
        return !acm.config.DenyByDefault
}

// logSecurityViolation logs security violations
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) logSecurityViolation(r *http.Request, source, endpointType, reason string) {
        if !acm.config.LogSecurityEvents {
                return
        }

        ctx := r.Context()
        securityErr := fmt.Errorf("access control violation: %s", reason)

        acm.logger.LogError(ctx, securityErr, "Access control violation",
                zap.String("source", source),
                zap.String("endpoint_type", endpointType),
                zap.String("path", r.URL.Path),
                zap.String("method", r.Method),
                zap.String("remote_addr", r.RemoteAddr),
                zap.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
                zap.String("reason", reason),
                zap.String("request_id", r.Header.Get("X-Request-ID")),
        )
}

// logAccessAttempt logs successful access attempts
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) logAccessAttempt(r *http.Request, source, endpointType, result string) {
        ctx := r.Context()

        acm.logger.LogDebug(ctx, "Access control check",
                zap.String("source", source),
                zap.String("endpoint_type", endpointType),
                zap.String("path", r.URL.Path),
                zap.String("method", r.Method),
                zap.String("result", result),
                zap.String("request_id", r.Header.Get("X-Request-ID")),
        )
}

// writeErrorResponse writes a standardized error response
func (acm *AccessControlMiddleware) writeErrorResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, statusCode int, message string) {
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.WriteHeader(statusCode)

        // Write JSON error response
        errorResponse := fmt.Sprintf(`{"error": "%s", "code": %d}`,
                strings.ReplaceAll(message, `"`, `\"`), statusCode)
        _, _ = w.Write([]byte(errorResponse))
}

// Package middleware implements HTTP middleware for the Git executor
package middleware

import (
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "mime"
        "net/http"
        "path/filepath"
        "regexp"
        "strings"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// GitAPIValidationConfig configures the Git API validation middleware
type GitAPIValidationConfig struct {
        // MaxFileSize is the maximum allowed file size for file operations (bytes)
        MaxFileSize int64
        // MaxCommitMessageLength is the maximum allowed commit message length
        MaxCommitMessageLength int
        // MaxPathLength is the maximum allowed file path length
        MaxPathLength int
        // AllowedFileExtensions defines allowed file extensions (nil means all allowed)
        AllowedFileExtensions []string
        // BannedFileExtensions defines banned file extensions
        BannedFileExtensions []string
        // MaxFilesPerCommit is the maximum number of files per commit operation
        MaxFilesPerCommit int
        // EnableContentValidation enables content-based validation
        EnableContentValidation bool
}

// GitAPIValidationMiddleware provides comprehensive validation for Git REST API operations
type GitAPIValidationMiddleware struct {
        config *GitAPIValidationConfig
        logger *logging.Logger

        // Compiled regex patterns
        pathPattern   *regexp.Regexp
        branchPattern *regexp.Regexp
        commitPattern *regexp.Regexp
}

// FileOperationRequest represents the expected structure for file operations
type FileOperationRequest struct {
        Content        string `json:"content"`
        Message        string `json:"message"`
        Branch         string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
        CommitterName  string `json:"committer_name,omitempty"`
        CommitterEmail string `json:"committer_email,omitempty"`
}

// MultiFileOperationRequest represents the expected structure for multi-file operations
type MultiFileOperationRequest struct {
        Files []struct {
                Path      string `json:"path"`
                Content   string `json:"content"`
                Operation string `json:"operation"` // create, update, delete
        } `json:"files"`
        Message        string `json:"message"`
        Branch         string `json:"branch,omitempty"`
        CommitterName  string `json:"committer_name,omitempty"`
        CommitterEmail string `json:"committer_email,omitempty"`
}

// BranchOperationRequest represents the expected structure for branch operations
type BranchOperationRequest struct {
        Name      string `json:"name"`
        SourceRef string `json:"source_ref,omitempty"`
        TargetRef string `json:"target_ref,omitempty"`
        Force     bool   `json:"force,omitempty"`
}

// MergeOperationRequest represents the expected structure for merge operations
type MergeOperationRequest struct {
        Base          string `json:"base"`
        Head          string `json:"head"`
        CommitMessage string `json:"commit_message,omitempty"`
        Strategy      string `json:"strategy,omitempty"`
}

// DefaultGitAPIValidationConfig returns a sensible default configuration
func DefaultGitAPIValidationConfig() *GitAPIValidationConfig {
        return &GitAPIValidationConfig{
                MaxFileSize:             50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB
                MaxCommitMessageLength:  2048,
                MaxPathLength:           4096,
                MaxFilesPerCommit:       1000,
                EnableContentValidation: true,
                BannedFileExtensions: []string{
                        ".exe", ".bat", ".cmd", ".com", ".scr", ".pif",
                        ".jar", ".class", ".war", ".ear",
                        ".dll", ".so", ".dylib",
                },
        }
}

// NewGitAPIValidationMiddleware creates a new Git API validation middleware
func NewGitAPIValidationMiddleware(config *GitAPIValidationConfig, logger *logging.Logger) (*GitAPIValidationMiddleware, error) {
        if config == nil {
                config = DefaultGitAPIValidationConfig()
        }

        if logger == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("logger is required")
        }

        // Compile validation patterns
        pathPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+$`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile path pattern: %w", err)
        }

        branchPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+$`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile branch pattern: %w", err)
        }

        commitPattern, err := regexp.Compile(`^[a-f0-9]{40}$`)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to compile commit pattern: %w", err)
        }

        return &GitAPIValidationMiddleware{
                config:        config,
                logger:        logger,
                pathPattern:   pathPattern,
                branchPattern: branchPattern,
                commitPattern: commitPattern,
        }, nil
}

// ValidateGitAPIRequest is the main middleware function for Git API validation
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) ValidateGitAPIRequest() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Skip validation for GET requests (read-only operations)
                if c.Request.Method == http.MethodGet {
                        c.Next()
                        return
                }

                // Only validate Git API endpoints
                if !m.isGitAPIEndpoint(c.Request.URL.Path) {
                        c.Next()
                        return
                }

                // Validate Content-Type for write operations
                if err := m.validateContentType(c); err != nil {
                        m.logger.Warn("Invalid content type for Git API request",
                                zap.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
                                zap.String("method", c.Request.Method),
                                zap.String("content_type", c.GetHeader("Content-Type")),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
                                "error": "Invalid content type: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        c.Abort()
                        return
                }

                // Validate request size
                if err := m.validateRequestSize(c); err != nil {
                        m.logger.Warn("Request size validation failed",
                                zap.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
                                zap.Int64("content_length", c.Request.ContentLength),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        c.JSON(http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, gin.H{
                                "error": "Request too large: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        c.Abort()
                        return
                }

                // Validate URL parameters
                if err := m.validateURLParameters(c); err != nil {
                        m.logger.Warn("URL parameter validation failed",
                                zap.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
                                "error": "Invalid URL parameters: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        c.Abort()
                        return
                }

                // Validate request body based on endpoint type
                if err := m.validateRequestBody(c); err != nil {
                        m.logger.Warn("Request body validation failed",
                                zap.String("path", c.Request.URL.Path),
                                zap.String("method", c.Request.Method),
                                zap.Error(err))
                        c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{
                                "error": "Invalid request body: " + err.Error(),
                        })
                        c.Abort()
                        return
                }

                c.Next()
        }
}

// isGitAPIEndpoint checks if the request is for a Git API endpoint
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) isGitAPIEndpoint(path string) bool {
        gitAPIPatterns := []string{
                "/repos/", // All repository API endpoints
        }

        for _, pattern := range gitAPIPatterns {
                if strings.Contains(path, pattern) {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// validateContentType validates the Content-Type header for write operations
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateContentType(c *gin.Context) error {
        contentType := c.GetHeader("Content-Type")
        if contentType == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type header is required for write operations")
        }

        mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(contentType)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid Content-Type format: %w", err)
        }

        allowedTypes := []string{
                "application/json",
                "application/x-git-upload-pack",
                "application/x-git-receive-pack",
        }

        for _, allowed := range allowedTypes {
                if mediaType == allowed {
                        return nil
                }
        }

        return fmt.Errorf("unsupported Content-Type: %s", mediaType)
}

// validateRequestSize validates the size of the incoming request
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateRequestSize(c *gin.Context) error {
        if c.Request.ContentLength > m.config.MaxFileSize {
                return fmt.Errorf("request size %d exceeds maximum allowed size %d",
                        c.Request.ContentLength, m.config.MaxFileSize)
        }
        return nil
}

// validateURLParameters validates URL path parameters
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateURLParameters(c *gin.Context) error {
        // Validate owner parameter
        owner := c.Param("owner")
        if owner != "" {
                if err := m.validatePathComponent(owner, "owner"); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // Validate repo parameter
        repo := c.Param("repo")
        if repo != "" {
                if err := m.validatePathComponent(repo, "repository"); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // Validate path parameter (for file operations)
        // Extract the file path from the URL - handle cases like /repos/owner/repo/files/path/to/file.txt
        path := c.Request.URL.Path
        if strings.Contains(path, "/files/") {
                // Extract the file path portion after /files/
                parts := strings.Split(path, "/files/")
                if len(parts) > 1 {
                        filePath := parts[1]
                        if filePath != "" {
                                if err := m.validateFilePath(filePath); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        // Also check the direct path parameter if it exists
        pathParam := c.Param("path")
        if pathParam != "" {
                // Clean up the path parameter (remove leading slash if present)
                cleanPath := strings.TrimPrefix(pathParam, "/")
                if cleanPath != "" {
                        if err := m.validateFilePath(cleanPath); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                }
        }

        // Validate branch names in query parameters
        branch := c.Query("branch")
        if branch != "" {
                if err := m.validateBranchName(branch); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// validateRequestBody validates the request body based on the endpoint
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateRequestBody(c *gin.Context) error {
        // Only validate JSON bodies
        contentType := c.GetHeader("Content-Type")
        if !strings.Contains(contentType, "application/json") {
                return nil
        }

        // Read and validate the request body
        body, err := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to read request body: %w", err)
        }

        // Restore the body for downstream handlers
        c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(body)))

        // Validate based on endpoint type
        path := c.Request.URL.Path
        method := c.Request.Method

        if strings.Contains(path, "/files/") && method == http.MethodPut {
                return m.validateFileOperationRequest(body)
        }

        if strings.Contains(path, "/commits") && method == http.MethodPost {
                return m.validateMultiFileOperationRequest(body)
        }

        if strings.Contains(path, "/branches") && (method == http.MethodPost || method == http.MethodPatch) {
                return m.validateBranchOperationRequest(body)
        }

        if strings.Contains(path, "/merges") && method == http.MethodPost {
                return m.validateMergeOperationRequest(body)
        }

        return nil
}

// validateFileOperationRequest validates single file operation requests
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateFileOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req FileOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON format: %w", err)
        }

        // Validate content size
        if len(req.Content) > int(m.config.MaxFileSize) {
                return fmt.Errorf("file content exceeds maximum size %d", m.config.MaxFileSize)
        }

        // Validate commit message
        if err := m.validateCommitMessage(req.Message); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Validate branch name
        if req.Branch != "" {
                if err := m.validateBranchName(req.Branch); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // Validate committer information
        if err := m.validateCommitterInfo(req.CommitterName, req.CommitterEmail); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        return nil
}

// validateMultiFileOperationRequest validates multi-file operation requests
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateMultiFileOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req MultiFileOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON format: %w", err)
        }

        // Validate number of files
        if len(req.Files) > m.config.MaxFilesPerCommit {
                return fmt.Errorf("number of files %d exceeds maximum %d",
                        len(req.Files), m.config.MaxFilesPerCommit)
        }

        // Validate each file
        for i, file := range req.Files {
                if err := m.validateFilePath(file.Path); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file %d path invalid: %w", i, err)
                }

                if len(file.Content) > int(m.config.MaxFileSize) {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file %d content exceeds maximum size %d", i, m.config.MaxFileSize)
                }

                if err := m.validateFileOperation(file.Operation); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file %d operation invalid: %w", i, err)
                }
        }

        // Validate commit message
        if err := m.validateCommitMessage(req.Message); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        return nil
}

// validateBranchOperationRequest validates branch operation requests
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateBranchOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req BranchOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON format: %w", err)
        }

        if err := m.validateBranchName(req.Name); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid branch name: %w", err)
        }

        if req.SourceRef != "" {
                if err := m.validateRefName(req.SourceRef); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid source ref: %w", err)
                }
        }

        if req.TargetRef != "" {
                if err := m.validateRefName(req.TargetRef); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid target ref: %w", err)
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// validateMergeOperationRequest validates merge operation requests
func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateMergeOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req MergeOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON format: %w", err)
        }

        if err := m.validateRefName(req.Base); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid base ref: %w", err)
        }

        if err := m.validateRefName(req.Head); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid head ref: %w", err)
        }

        if req.CommitMessage != "" {
                if err := m.validateCommitMessage(req.CommitMessage); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        if req.Strategy != "" {
                allowedStrategies := []string{"merge", "squash", "rebase"}
                valid := false
                for _, strategy := range allowedStrategies {
                        if req.Strategy == strategy {
                                valid = true
                                break
                        }
                }
                if !valid {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid merge strategy: %s", req.Strategy)
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// Helper validation functions

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validatePathComponent(component, componentType string) error {
        if component == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s cannot be empty", componentType)
        }

        if len(component) > 255 {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s name too long (max 255 characters)", componentType)
        }

        // Check for path traversal
        if strings.Contains(component, "..") {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s contains path traversal attempt", componentType)
        }

        // Check for invalid characters
        if strings.ContainsAny(component, "\\/:*?\"<>|") {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s contains invalid characters", componentType)
        }

        return nil
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateFilePath(path string) error {
        if path == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path cannot be empty")
        }

        if len(path) > m.config.MaxPathLength {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path too long (max %d characters)", m.config.MaxPathLength)
        }

        // Check for path traversal
        if strings.Contains(path, "..") {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path contains path traversal attempt")
        }

        // Check for absolute paths
        if strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path cannot be absolute")
        }

        // Validate file extension if content validation is enabled
        if m.config.EnableContentValidation {
                ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path))
                for _, banned := range m.config.BannedFileExtensions {
                        if ext == banned {
                                return fmt.Errorf("file extension %s is not allowed", ext)
                        }
                }
        }

        return nil
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateBranchName(branch string) error {
        if branch == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name cannot be empty")
        }

        if len(branch) > 250 {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name too long (max 250 characters)")
        }

        if !m.branchPattern.MatchString(branch) {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name contains invalid characters")
        }

        // Git branch name restrictions
        if strings.HasPrefix(branch, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(branch, ".") {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid branch name format")
        }

        return nil
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateRefName(ref string) error {
        if ref == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("reference name cannot be empty")
        }

        // Check if it's a commit hash
        if m.commitPattern.MatchString(ref) {
                return nil
        }

        // Check if it's a valid branch/tag name
        return m.validateBranchName(ref)
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateCommitMessage(message string) error {
        if message == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("commit message cannot be empty")
        }

        if len(message) > m.config.MaxCommitMessageLength {
                return fmt.Errorf("commit message too long (max %d characters)", m.config.MaxCommitMessageLength)
        }

        return nil
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateCommitterInfo(name, email string) error {
        if name != "" && len(name) > 100 {
                return fmt.Errorf("committer name too long (max 100 characters)")
        }

        if email != "" {
                if len(email) > 254 {
                        return fmt.Errorf("committer email too long (max 254 characters)")
                }
                if !strings.Contains(email, "@") {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid email format")
                }
        }

        return nil
}

func (m *GitAPIValidationMiddleware) validateFileOperation(operation string) error {
        allowedOps := []string{"create", "update", "delete"}
        for _, allowed := range allowedOps {
                if operation == allowed {
                        return nil
                }
        }
        return fmt.Errorf("invalid file operation: %s", operation)
}

// Package observability provides comprehensive health check endpoints
// for monitoring service liveness and readiness in production environments.
package observability

import (
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
)

// HealthStatus represents the overall health status
type HealthStatus string

const (
        // StatusHealthy indicates the service is healthy
        StatusHealthy HealthStatus = "healthy"
        // StatusUnhealthy indicates the service is unhealthy
        StatusUnhealthy HealthStatus = "unhealthy"
        // StatusDegraded indicates the service is running but with limitations
        StatusDegraded HealthStatus = "degraded"
)

// HealthResponse represents the health check response
type HealthResponse struct {
        Status    HealthStatus           `json:"status"`
        Timestamp time.Time              `json:"timestamp"`
        Version   string                 `json:"version,omitempty"`
        Uptime    string                 `json:"uptime,omitempty"`
        Checks    map[string]CheckResult `json:"checks,omitempty"`
        Details   map[string]interface{} `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

// CheckResult represents the result of an individual health check
type CheckResult struct {
        Status      HealthStatus `json:"status"`
        Message     string       `json:"message,omitempty"`
        Duration    string       `json:"duration,omitempty"`
        LastChecked time.Time    `json:"last_checked"`
        Error       string       `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

// HealthChecker manages health checks for the application
type HealthChecker struct {
        config           *config.Config
        permissionClient permissions.PermissionClient
        startTime        time.Time
        version          string
}

// NewHealthChecker creates a new health checker
func NewHealthChecker(cfg *config.Config, permClient permissions.PermissionClient, version string) *HealthChecker {
        return &HealthChecker{
                config:           cfg,
                permissionClient: permClient,
                startTime:        time.Now(),
                version:          version,
        }
}

// LivenessHandler handles liveness probe requests (GET /health/liveness)
// Liveness checks verify that the application is running and able to process requests
func (h *HealthChecker) LivenessHandler() http.HandlerFunc {
        return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
                defer cancel()

                response := h.performLivenessChecks(ctx)

                // Liveness should always pass unless the service is completely broken
                statusCode := http.StatusOK
                if response.Status == StatusUnhealthy {
                        statusCode = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
                }

                h.sendHealthResponse(w, response, statusCode)
        }
}

// ReadinessHandler handles readiness probe requests (GET /health/readiness)
// Readiness checks verify that the application is ready to handle traffic
func (h *HealthChecker) ReadinessHandler() http.HandlerFunc {
        return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 10*time.Second)
                defer cancel()

                response := h.performReadinessChecks(ctx)

                // Readiness fails if any critical dependency is unavailable
                statusCode := http.StatusOK
                if response.Status == StatusUnhealthy {
                        statusCode = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
                }

                h.sendHealthResponse(w, response, statusCode)
        }
}

// performLivenessChecks performs basic liveness checks
func (h *HealthChecker) performLivenessChecks(ctx context.Context) HealthResponse {
        checks := make(map[string]CheckResult)
        overall := StatusHealthy

        // Basic service health check
        checks["service"] = h.checkServiceHealth(ctx)
        if checks["service"].Status == StatusUnhealthy {
                overall = StatusUnhealthy
        }

        // Memory check (basic)
        checks["memory"] = h.checkMemoryUsage(ctx)
        if checks["memory"].Status == StatusUnhealthy {
                overall = StatusUnhealthy
        }

        return HealthResponse{
                Status:    overall,
                Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
                Version:   h.version,
                Uptime:    time.Since(h.startTime).String(),
                Checks:    checks,
                Details: map[string]interface{}{
                        "type": "liveness",
                },
        }
}

// performReadinessChecks performs comprehensive readiness checks
func (h *HealthChecker) performReadinessChecks(ctx context.Context) HealthResponse {
        checks := make(map[string]CheckResult)
        overall := StatusHealthy
        hasUnhealthy := false
        hasDegraded := false

        // File system check
        checks["filesystem"] = h.checkFilesystem(ctx)
        switch checks["filesystem"].Status {
        case StatusUnhealthy:
                hasUnhealthy = true
        case StatusDegraded:
                hasDegraded = true
        }

        // Permission service check
        checks["permission_service"] = h.checkPermissionService(ctx)
        switch checks["permission_service"].Status {
        case StatusUnhealthy:
                hasUnhealthy = true
        case StatusDegraded:
                hasDegraded = true
        }

        // Repository access check
        checks["repository_access"] = h.checkRepositoryAccess(ctx)
        switch checks["repository_access"].Status {
        case StatusUnhealthy:
                hasUnhealthy = true
        case StatusDegraded:
                hasDegraded = true
        }

        // Determine overall status
        if hasUnhealthy {
                overall = StatusUnhealthy
        } else if hasDegraded {
                overall = StatusDegraded
        }

        return HealthResponse{
                Status:    overall,
                Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
                Version:   h.version,
                Uptime:    time.Since(h.startTime).String(),
                Checks:    checks,
                Details: map[string]interface{}{
                        "type": "readiness",
                },
        }
}

// checkServiceHealth performs basic service health checks
func (h *HealthChecker) checkServiceHealth(ctx context.Context) CheckResult {
        start := time.Now()

        // Basic health indicators - just ensure we can allocate memory
        _ = make([]byte, 1024)

        return CheckResult{
                Status:      StatusHealthy,
                Message:     "Service is running normally",
                Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
        }
}

// checkMemoryUsage checks if memory usage is within acceptable limits
func (h *HealthChecker) checkMemoryUsage(ctx context.Context) CheckResult {
        start := time.Now()

        // This is a simplified memory check
        // In production, you'd want more sophisticated memory monitoring
        return CheckResult{
                Status:      StatusHealthy,
                Message:     "Memory usage is normal",
                Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
        }
}

// checkFilesystem checks if the repository filesystem is accessible
func (h *HealthChecker) checkFilesystem(ctx context.Context) CheckResult {
        start := time.Now()

        if h.config == nil || h.config.Git.RepoRoot == "" {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusUnhealthy,
                        Message:     "Repository root path not configured",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       "configuration error",
                }
        }

        // Check if repository root directory exists and is accessible
        repoRoot := h.config.Git.RepoRoot
        stat, err := os.Stat(repoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusUnhealthy,
                        Message:     "Repository root directory not accessible",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       err.Error(),
                }
        }

        if !stat.IsDir() {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusUnhealthy,
                        Message:     "Repository root path is not a directory",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       "path is not a directory",
                }
        }

        // Test write access by creating a temporary file
        testFile := filepath.Join(repoRoot, ".health_check_test")
        err = os.WriteFile(testFile, []byte("health check"), 0644)
        if err != nil {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusDegraded,
                        Message:     "Repository root directory is read-only",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       err.Error(),
                }
        }

        // Clean up test file
        _ = os.Remove(testFile)

        return CheckResult{
                Status:      StatusHealthy,
                Message:     "Filesystem is accessible and writable",
                Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
        }
}

// checkPermissionService checks if the permission service is available
