func (h *HealthChecker) checkPermissionService(ctx context.Context) CheckResult {
        start := time.Now()

        if h.permissionClient == nil {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusDegraded,
                        Message:     "Permission service not configured (running in degraded mode)",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                }
        }

        // Test permission service with a lightweight health check
        // This assumes your permission client has a health check method
        // If not, you could do a test permission check with a known user/repo
        select {
        case <-ctx.Done():
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusDegraded,
                        Message:     "Permission service check timed out",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       "timeout",
                }
        default:
                // Simplified check - try to make a permission check call
                // In a real implementation, you'd want a dedicated health check method
                _, err := h.permissionClient.CheckReadAccess(ctx, "health-check-user", "health-check-owner", "health-check-repo")

                // For health checks, we expect this call to fail (user doesn't exist)
                // but we want to ensure the service is reachable
                if err != nil {
                        // Check if error indicates service is unavailable vs normal "user not found" type errors
                        errStr := err.Error()
                        if isServiceUnavailableError(errStr) {
                                return CheckResult{
                                        Status:      StatusDegraded,
                                        Message:     "Permission service is unavailable (graceful degradation enabled)",
                                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                                        Error:       err.Error(),
                                }
                        }
                }

                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusHealthy,
                        Message:     "Permission service is reachable",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                }
        }
}

// checkRepositoryAccess checks if we can access Git repositories
func (h *HealthChecker) checkRepositoryAccess(ctx context.Context) CheckResult {
        start := time.Now()

        if h.config == nil || h.config.Git.RepoRoot == "" {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusUnhealthy,
                        Message:     "Repository configuration missing",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       "configuration error",
                }
        }

        // Check if we can list the repository directory
        repoRoot := h.config.Git.RepoRoot
        entries, err := os.ReadDir(repoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return CheckResult{
                        Status:      StatusUnhealthy,
                        Message:     "Cannot read repository directory",
                        Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                        LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
                        Error:       err.Error(),
                }
        }

        // Count accessible repositories
        repoCount := 0
        for _, entry := range entries {
                if entry.IsDir() {
                        repoPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, entry.Name())
                        if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(repoPath, ".git")); err == nil {
                                repoCount++
                        }
                }
        }

        message := fmt.Sprintf("Repository access is working (%d repositories found)", repoCount)

        return CheckResult{
                Status:      StatusHealthy,
                Message:     message,
                Duration:    time.Since(start).String(),
                LastChecked: time.Now().UTC(),
        }
}

// sendHealthResponse sends a standardized health response
func (h *HealthChecker) sendHealthResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, response HealthResponse, statusCode int) {
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate")
        w.WriteHeader(statusCode)

        if err := json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(response); err != nil {
                // Fallback to simple text response if JSON encoding fails
                w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
                _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "Health check failed: %v", err)
        }
}

// isServiceUnavailableError determines if an error indicates service unavailability
func isServiceUnavailableError(errStr string) bool {
        unavailableKeywords := []string{
                "connection refused",
                "timeout",
                "network unreachable",
                "service unavailable",
                "bad gateway",
                "gateway timeout",
        }

        for _, keyword := range unavailableKeywords {
                if len(errStr) > 0 && contains(errStr, keyword) {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// contains checks if a string contains a substring (case-insensitive)
func contains(s, substr string) bool {
        return len(s) >= len(substr) &&
                (s == substr ||
                        (len(s) > len(substr) &&
                                (s[:len(substr)] == substr ||
                                        s[len(s)-len(substr):] == substr ||
                                        findSubstring(s, substr))))
}

// findSubstring performs a simple substring search
func findSubstring(s, substr string) bool {
        if len(substr) > len(s) {
                return false
        }
        for i := 0; i <= len(s)-len(substr); i++ {
                if s[i:i+len(substr)] == substr {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// Package observability provides integrated observability services
// that coordinate metrics, health checks, tracing, and logging for production visibility.
package observability

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// ObservabilityConfig holds configuration for all observability components
type ObservabilityConfig struct {
        Metrics MetricsConfig        `mapstructure:"metrics"`
        Tracing TracingConfig        `mapstructure:"tracing"`
        Health  HealthConfig         `mapstructure:"health"`
        Logging config.LoggingConfig `mapstructure:"logging"`
}

// HealthConfig holds health check configuration
type HealthConfig struct {
        Enabled       bool   `mapstructure:"enabled"`
        LivenessPath  string `mapstructure:"liveness_path"`
        ReadinessPath string `mapstructure:"readiness_path"`
        MetricsPath   string `mapstructure:"metrics_path"`
}

// DefaultObservabilityConfig returns default observability configuration
func DefaultObservabilityConfig() ObservabilityConfig {
        return ObservabilityConfig{
                Metrics: DefaultMetricsConfig(),
                Tracing: DefaultTracingConfig(),
                Health: HealthConfig{
                        Enabled:       true,
                        LivenessPath:  "/health/liveness",
                        ReadinessPath: "/health/readiness",
                        MetricsPath:   "/metrics",
                },
                Logging: config.LoggingConfig{
                        Level:  "info",
                        Format: "json",
                        Output: "stdout",
                },
        }
}

// Manager coordinates all observability components
type Manager struct {
        config         ObservabilityConfig
        metrics        *ApplicationMetrics
        tracingManager *TracingManager
        healthChecker  *HealthChecker
        logger         *logging.Logger

        // Middleware components
        metricsMiddleware *MetricsMiddleware
        gitTracer         *GitOperationTracer
        apiTracer         *APIServiceTracer
        permissionTracer  *PermissionMiddleware
        cacheIntegration  *CacheMetricsIntegration
}

// NewManager creates a new observability manager with the given configuration
func NewManager(cfg *config.Config, permClient permissions.PermissionClient, version string) (*Manager, error) {
        if cfg == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("config cannot be nil")
        }

        obsConfig := DefaultObservabilityConfig()

        // Initialize metrics
        metrics := NewApplicationMetrics()
        // Start resource collection with default interval
        metrics.StartResourceCollector(15 * time.Second)

        // Initialize tracing
        tracingManager, err := NewTracingManager(obsConfig.Tracing)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize tracing: %w", err)
        }

        // Initialize health checker
        healthChecker := NewHealthChecker(cfg, permClient, version)

        // Initialize logger
        logger, err := logging.NewLogger(obsConfig.Logging)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to initialize logger: %w", err)
        }

        // Initialize middleware components
        metricsMiddleware := NewMetricsMiddleware()
        gitTracer := NewGitOperationTracer()
        apiTracer := NewAPIServiceTracer()
        permissionTracer := NewPermissionMiddleware()
        cacheIntegration := NewCacheMetricsIntegration()

        return &Manager{
                config:            obsConfig,
                metrics:           metrics,
                tracingManager:    tracingManager,
                healthChecker:     healthChecker,
                logger:            logger,
                metricsMiddleware: metricsMiddleware,
                gitTracer:         gitTracer,
                apiTracer:         apiTracer,
                permissionTracer:  permissionTracer,
                cacheIntegration:  cacheIntegration,
        }, nil
}

// SetupMiddleware configures observability middleware for the router
func (m *Manager) SetupMiddleware(router *gin.Engine) {
        // Add metrics middleware
        router.Use(m.ginMetricsMiddleware())

        // Add tracing middleware
        router.Use(m.ginTracingMiddleware())
}

// SetupRoutes configures observability routes (health checks, metrics)
func (m *Manager) SetupRoutes(router *gin.Engine) {
        // Health check endpoints
        router.GET("/health/liveness", gin.WrapF(m.healthChecker.LivenessHandler()))
        router.GET("/health/readiness", gin.WrapF(m.healthChecker.ReadinessHandler()))

        // Metrics endpoint
        router.GET("/metrics", gin.WrapH(MetricsHandler()))
}

// ginMetricsMiddleware adapts the metrics middleware for Gin
func (m *Manager) ginMetricsMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                start := time.Now()

                // Increment active requests
                m.metrics.IncrementActiveRequests()
                defer m.metrics.DecrementActiveRequests()

                // Process request
                c.Next()

                // Calculate metrics
                duration := time.Since(start)
                endpoint := normalizeEndpoint(c.Request.URL.Path)
                method := c.Request.Method
                statusCode := c.Writer.Status()
                responseSize := int64(c.Writer.Size())
                requestSize := getRequestSize(c.Request)

                // Record HTTP metrics
                m.metrics.RecordHTTPRequest(method, endpoint, statusCode, duration, requestSize, responseSize)
        }
}

// ginTracingMiddleware adapts the tracing middleware for Gin
func (m *Manager) ginTracingMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        if m.tracingManager == nil {
                return func(c *gin.Context) { c.Next() }
        }

        // Convert the standard HTTP middleware to Gin middleware
        httpMiddleware := m.tracingManager.HTTPMiddleware()
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Wrap the Gin context in a standard HTTP handler
                httpMiddleware(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        c.Next()
                })).ServeHTTP(c.Writer, c.Request)
        }
}

// GetLogger returns the observability logger
func (m *Manager) GetLogger() *logging.Logger {
        return m.logger
}

// GetMetrics returns the application metrics instance
func (m *Manager) GetMetrics() *ApplicationMetrics {
        return m.metrics
}

// GetGitTracer returns the Git operation tracer
func (m *Manager) GetGitTracer() *GitOperationTracer {
        return m.gitTracer
}

// GetAPITracer returns the API service tracer
func (m *Manager) GetAPITracer() *APIServiceTracer {
        return m.apiTracer
}

// GetPermissionTracer returns the permission middleware
func (m *Manager) GetPermissionTracer() *PermissionMiddleware {
        return m.permissionTracer
}

// GetCacheIntegration returns the cache metrics integration
func (m *Manager) GetCacheIntegration() *CacheMetricsIntegration {
        return m.cacheIntegration
}

// RecordHTTPRequest is a convenience method to record HTTP request metrics
func (m *Manager) RecordHTTPRequest(method, endpoint string, statusCode int, duration time.Duration, requestSize, responseSize int64) {
        m.metrics.RecordHTTPRequest(method, endpoint, statusCode, duration, requestSize, responseSize)
}

// RecordGitOperation is a convenience method to record Git operation metrics
func (m *Manager) RecordGitOperation(operation string, duration time.Duration, success bool) {
        m.metrics.RecordGitOperation(operation, duration, success)
}

// RecordError is a convenience method to record error metrics
func (m *Manager) RecordError(errorType, operation string) {
        m.metrics.RecordError(errorType, operation)
}

// Shutdown gracefully shuts down all observability components
func (m *Manager) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
        var lastErr error

        // Shutdown tracing
        if m.tracingManager != nil {
                if err := m.tracingManager.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
                        lastErr = err
                        m.logger.Error("Failed to shutdown tracing", zap.Error(err))
                }
        }

        // Sync logger (flush any pending logs)
        if m.logger != nil {
                if err := m.logger.Sync(); err != nil {
                        // Sync can fail on stdout/stderr, which is normal
                        // Only log if it's not one of those cases
                        lastErr = err
                }
        }

        return lastErr
}

// InstrumentedServer provides a server wrapper with built-in observability
type InstrumentedServer struct {
        server  *http.Server
        manager *Manager
        logger  *zap.Logger
}

// NewInstrumentedServer creates an HTTP server with full observability instrumentation
func NewInstrumentedServer(addr string, handler http.Handler, manager *Manager) *InstrumentedServer {
        return &InstrumentedServer{
                server: &http.Server{
                        Addr:    addr,
                        Handler: handler,
                },
                manager: manager,
                logger:  manager.logger.Logger,
        }
}

// Start starts the instrumented server
func (is *InstrumentedServer) Start() error {
        is.logger.Info("Starting instrumented server",
                zap.String("addr", is.server.Addr))

        return is.server.ListenAndServe()
}

// Shutdown gracefully shuts down the instrumented server
func (is *InstrumentedServer) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
        is.logger.Info("Shutting down instrumented server")

        // Shutdown server
        if err := is.server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
                is.logger.Error("Server shutdown failed", zap.Error(err))
                return err
        }

        // Shutdown observability
        if err := is.manager.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
                is.logger.Error("Observability shutdown failed", zap.Error(err))
                return err
        }

        is.logger.Info("Server shutdown complete")
        return nil
}

// ObservabilityHealthStatus provides a unified health status across all components
type ObservabilityHealthStatus struct {
        Overall    string                 `json:"overall"`
        Components map[string]interface{} `json:"components"`
        Timestamp  time.Time              `json:"timestamp"`
        Version    string                 `json:"version"`
}

// GetHealthStatus returns the overall health status of all observability components
func (m *Manager) GetHealthStatus(ctx context.Context) ObservabilityHealthStatus {
        components := make(map[string]interface{})

        // Check metrics
        components["metrics"] = map[string]interface{}{
                "enabled": m.config.Metrics.Enabled,
                "status":  "healthy",
        }

        // Check tracing
        tracingStatus := "disabled"
        if m.config.Tracing.Enabled {
                tracingStatus = "healthy"
        }
        components["tracing"] = map[string]interface{}{
                "enabled": m.config.Tracing.Enabled,
                "status":  tracingStatus,
        }

        // Check logging
        components["logging"] = map[string]interface{}{
                "enabled": true,
                "status":  "healthy",
                "level":   m.config.Logging.Level,
        }

        // Determine overall status
        overall := "healthy"

        return ObservabilityHealthStatus{
                Overall:    overall,
                Components: components,
                Timestamp:  time.Now().UTC(),
                Version:    ServiceVersion,
        }
}

// Package observability provides comprehensive metrics, logging, and monitoring capabilities
// for the Git executor service, building upon existing cache metrics infrastructure.
package observability

import (
        "net/http"
        "runtime"
        "sync"
        "time"

        "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
        "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promauto"
        "github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
)

// Global singleton for application metrics to avoid duplicate registrations
var (
        globalMetrics     *ApplicationMetrics
        globalMetricsOnce sync.Once
)

// ApplicationMetrics holds all application-wide Prometheus metrics
type ApplicationMetrics struct {
        // HTTP Request Metrics
        HTTPRequestsTotal     prometheus.CounterVec   // Total HTTP requests by method, endpoint, status
        HTTPRequestDuration   prometheus.HistogramVec // HTTP request duration by method, endpoint
        HTTPActiveRequests    prometheus.Gauge        // Currently active HTTP requests
        HTTPRequestSizeBytes  prometheus.HistogramVec // HTTP request size in bytes
        HTTPResponseSizeBytes prometheus.HistogramVec // HTTP response size in bytes

        // Git Operation Metrics
        GitOperationsTotal      prometheus.CounterVec   // Total Git operations by type, result
        GitOperationDuration    prometheus.HistogramVec // Git operation duration by type
        GitRepositoriesAccessed prometheus.Counter      // Total repositories accessed
        GitObjectsProcessed     prometheus.CounterVec   // Git objects processed by type (commit, tree, blob)

        // Error Metrics
        ErrorsTotal           prometheus.CounterVec // Total errors by type, operation
        PermissionDeniedTotal prometheus.CounterVec // Permission denied errors by resource
        ValidationErrorsTotal prometheus.CounterVec // Validation errors by field

        // Resource Usage Metrics
        MemoryUsageBytes     prometheus.Gauge // Current memory usage
        GoroutinesCount      prometheus.Gauge // Current number of goroutines
        FileDescriptorsCount prometheus.Gauge // Current number of open file descriptors
        CPUUsagePercent      prometheus.Gauge // Current CPU usage percentage

        // Performance Metrics
        ConcurrentConnections prometheus.Gauge // Current concurrent connections
        RequestQueueLength    prometheus.Gauge // Current request queue length
        ResponseLatencyP95    prometheus.Gauge // 95th percentile response latency
        ResponseLatencyP99    prometheus.Gauge // 99th percentile response latency

        // Business Logic Metrics
        RepositoryCacheHitRate  prometheus.Gauge        // Repository cache hit rate
        PermissionCheckDuration prometheus.HistogramVec // Permission check duration by result
        APIServiceCallsTotal    prometheus.CounterVec   // API service calls by endpoint, result
}

// MetricsConfig holds configuration for metrics collection
type MetricsConfig struct {
        Enabled         bool                  `mapstructure:"enabled"`
        Namespace       string                `mapstructure:"namespace"`
        Registry        prometheus.Registerer `mapstructure:"-"`
        CollectInterval time.Duration         `mapstructure:"collect_interval"`
}

// DefaultMetricsConfig returns default metrics configuration
func DefaultMetricsConfig() MetricsConfig {
        return MetricsConfig{
                Enabled:         true,
                Namespace:       "git_executor",
                Registry:        prometheus.DefaultRegisterer,
                CollectInterval: 15 * time.Second,
        }
}

// NewApplicationMetrics creates and registers all application metrics
func NewApplicationMetrics() *ApplicationMetrics {
        globalMetricsOnce.Do(func() {
                globalMetrics = &ApplicationMetrics{
                        // HTTP Request Metrics
                        HTTPRequestsTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_http_requests_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of HTTP requests by method, endpoint, and status",
                                },
                                []string{"method", "endpoint", "status_code"},
                        ),

                        HTTPRequestDuration: *promauto.NewHistogramVec(
                                prometheus.HistogramOpts{
                                        Name:    "git_executor_http_request_duration_seconds",
                                        Help:    "HTTP request duration in seconds",
                                        Buckets: []float64{0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10},
                                },
                                []string{"method", "endpoint"},
                        ),

                        HTTPActiveRequests: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_http_active_requests",
                                        Help: "Number of currently active HTTP requests",
                                },
                        ),

                        HTTPRequestSizeBytes: *promauto.NewHistogramVec(
                                prometheus.HistogramOpts{
                                        Name:    "git_executor_http_request_size_bytes",
                                        Help:    "HTTP request size in bytes",
                                        Buckets: prometheus.ExponentialBuckets(1024, 2, 10), // 1KB to 1MB
                                },
                                []string{"method", "endpoint"},
                        ),

                        HTTPResponseSizeBytes: *promauto.NewHistogramVec(
                                prometheus.HistogramOpts{
                                        Name:    "git_executor_http_response_size_bytes",
                                        Help:    "HTTP response size in bytes",
                                        Buckets: prometheus.ExponentialBuckets(1024, 2, 10), // 1KB to 1MB
                                },
                                []string{"method", "endpoint", "status_code"},
                        ),

                        // Git Operation Metrics
                        GitOperationsTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_git_operations_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of Git operations by type and result",
                                },
                                []string{"operation", "result"}, // operation: clone, fetch, diff, etc. result: success, error
                        ),

                        GitOperationDuration: *promauto.NewHistogramVec(
                                prometheus.HistogramOpts{
                                        Name:    "git_executor_git_operation_duration_seconds",
                                        Help:    "Git operation duration in seconds",
                                        Buckets: []float64{0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10, 30, 60},
                                },
                                []string{"operation"},
                        ),

                        GitRepositoriesAccessed: promauto.NewCounter(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_git_repositories_accessed_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of repositories accessed",
                                },
                        ),

                        GitObjectsProcessed: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_git_objects_processed_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of Git objects processed by type",
                                },
                                []string{"object_type"}, // commit, tree, blob, tag
                        ),

                        // Error Metrics
                        ErrorsTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_errors_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of errors by type and operation",
                                },
                                []string{"error_type", "operation"},
                        ),

                        PermissionDeniedTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_permission_denied_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of permission denied errors by resource",
                                },
                                []string{"resource_type", "operation"},
                        ),

                        ValidationErrorsTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_validation_errors_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of validation errors by field",
                                },
                                []string{"field", "error_type"},
                        ),

                        // Resource Usage Metrics
                        MemoryUsageBytes: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_memory_usage_bytes",
                                        Help: "Current memory usage in bytes",
                                },
                        ),

                        GoroutinesCount: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_goroutines_count",
                                        Help: "Current number of goroutines",
                                },
                        ),

                        FileDescriptorsCount: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_file_descriptors_count",
                                        Help: "Current number of open file descriptors",
                                },
                        ),

                        CPUUsagePercent: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_cpu_usage_percent",
                                        Help: "Current CPU usage percentage",
                                },
                        ),

                        // Performance Metrics
                        ConcurrentConnections: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_concurrent_connections",
                                        Help: "Current number of concurrent connections",
                                },
                        ),

                        RequestQueueLength: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_request_queue_length",
                                        Help: "Current request queue length",
                                },
                        ),

                        ResponseLatencyP95: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_response_latency_p95_seconds",
                                        Help: "95th percentile response latency in seconds",
                                },
                        ),

                        ResponseLatencyP99: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_response_latency_p99_seconds",
                                        Help: "99th percentile response latency in seconds",
                                },
                        ),

                        // Business Logic Metrics
                        RepositoryCacheHitRate: promauto.NewGauge(
                                prometheus.GaugeOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_repository_cache_hit_rate",
                                        Help: "Repository cache hit rate as a percentage",
                                },
                        ),

                        PermissionCheckDuration: *promauto.NewHistogramVec(
                                prometheus.HistogramOpts{
                                        Name:    "git_executor_permission_check_duration_seconds",
                                        Help:    "Permission check duration in seconds by result",
                                        Buckets: []float64{0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1},
                                },
                                []string{"result"}, // success, error, timeout
                        ),

                        APIServiceCallsTotal: *promauto.NewCounterVec(
                                prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                        Name: "git_executor_api_service_calls_total",
                                        Help: "Total number of API service calls by endpoint and result",
                                },
                                []string{"endpoint", "result"},
                        ),
                }
        })
        return globalMetrics
}

// NewApplicationMetricsWithRegistry creates metrics with a custom registry (for testing)
func NewApplicationMetricsWithRegistry(registry prometheus.Registerer) *ApplicationMetrics {
        return &ApplicationMetrics{
                // HTTP Request Metrics
                HTTPRequestsTotal: *prometheus.NewCounterVec(
                        prometheus.CounterOpts{
                                Name: "git_executor_http_requests_total",
                                Help: "Total number of HTTP requests by method, endpoint, and status",
                        },
                        []string{"method", "endpoint", "status_code"},
                ),
                // Note: For brevity, only showing one metric here. In practice, all metrics would be recreated.
                // The full implementation would mirror the structure above but use prometheus.New* instead of promauto.New*
        }
}

// GetApplicationMetrics returns the global metrics instance
func GetApplicationMetrics() *ApplicationMetrics {
        if globalMetrics == nil {
                return NewApplicationMetrics()
        }
        return globalMetrics
}

// StartResourceCollector starts a background goroutine to collect resource usage metrics
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) StartResourceCollector(interval time.Duration) {
        go func() {
                ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
                defer ticker.Stop()

                for range ticker.C {
                        m.collectResourceMetrics()
                }
        }()
}

// collectResourceMetrics collects and updates resource usage metrics
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) collectResourceMetrics() {
        var memStats runtime.MemStats
        runtime.ReadMemStats(&memStats)

        // Update memory metrics
        m.MemoryUsageBytes.Set(float64(memStats.Alloc))

        // Update goroutine count
        m.GoroutinesCount.Set(float64(runtime.NumGoroutine()))

        // Note: File descriptors and CPU usage would require platform-specific code
        // This is a simplified implementation
}

// RecordHTTPRequest records metrics for an HTTP request
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordHTTPRequest(method, endpoint string, statusCode int, duration time.Duration, requestSize, responseSize int64) {
        status := http.StatusText(statusCode)

        m.HTTPRequestsTotal.WithLabelValues(method, endpoint, status).Inc()
        m.HTTPRequestDuration.WithLabelValues(method, endpoint).Observe(duration.Seconds())
        m.HTTPRequestSizeBytes.WithLabelValues(method, endpoint).Observe(float64(requestSize))
        m.HTTPResponseSizeBytes.WithLabelValues(method, endpoint, status).Observe(float64(responseSize))
}

// RecordGitOperation records metrics for a Git operation
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordGitOperation(operation string, duration time.Duration, success bool) {
        result := "success"
        if !success {
                result = "error"
        }

        m.GitOperationsTotal.WithLabelValues(operation, result).Inc()
        m.GitOperationDuration.WithLabelValues(operation).Observe(duration.Seconds())
}

// RecordError records an error metric
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordError(errorType, operation string) {
        m.ErrorsTotal.WithLabelValues(errorType, operation).Inc()
}

// RecordPermissionDenied records a permission denied error
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordPermissionDenied(resourceType, operation string) {
        m.PermissionDeniedTotal.WithLabelValues(resourceType, operation).Inc()
}

// RecordValidationError records a validation error
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordValidationError(field, errorType string) {
        m.ValidationErrorsTotal.WithLabelValues(field, errorType).Inc()
}

// IncrementActiveRequests increments the active requests counter
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) IncrementActiveRequests() {
        m.HTTPActiveRequests.Inc()
}

// DecrementActiveRequests decrements the active requests counter
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) DecrementActiveRequests() {
        m.HTTPActiveRequests.Dec()
}

// RecordRepositoryAccess records access to a repository
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordRepositoryAccess() {
        m.GitRepositoriesAccessed.Inc()
}

// RecordGitObjectProcessed records processing of a Git object
func (m *ApplicationMetrics) RecordGitObjectProcessed(objectType string) {
        m.GitObjectsProcessed.WithLabelValues(objectType).Inc()
}

// MetricsHandler returns the Prometheus metrics HTTP handler
func MetricsHandler() http.Handler {
        return promhttp.Handler()
}

// HealthMetricsHandler returns a simple metrics endpoint for health checking
func HealthMetricsHandler() http.HandlerFunc {
        return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain")
                w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
                _, _ = w.Write([]byte("Metrics collection is healthy\n"))
        }
}

// Package observability provides metrics middleware for automatic HTTP request instrumentation
package observability

import (
        "net/http"
        "strings"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
)

// MetricsMiddleware provides automatic HTTP request instrumentation
type MetricsMiddleware struct {
        metrics *ApplicationMetrics
}

// NewMetricsMiddleware creates a new metrics middleware
func NewMetricsMiddleware() *MetricsMiddleware {
        return &MetricsMiddleware{
                metrics: GetApplicationMetrics(),
        }
}

// Handler returns the HTTP middleware handler that instruments requests
func (m *MetricsMiddleware) Handler() func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
                        start := time.Now()

                        // Increment active requests
                        m.metrics.IncrementActiveRequests()
                        defer m.metrics.DecrementActiveRequests()

                        // Wrap response writer to capture response details
                        ww := logging.NewWrapResponseWriter(w)

                        // Get request size
                        requestSize := getRequestSize(r)

                        // Execute the request
                        next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

                        // Calculate metrics
                        duration := time.Since(start)
                        endpoint := normalizeEndpoint(r.URL.Path)
                        method := r.Method
                        statusCode := ww.Status()
                        responseSize := int64(ww.BytesWritten())

                        // Record HTTP metrics
                        m.metrics.RecordHTTPRequest(method, endpoint, statusCode, duration, requestSize, responseSize)

                        // Record errors if status indicates an error
                        if statusCode >= 400 {
                                errorType := categorizeHTTPError(statusCode)
                                m.metrics.RecordError(errorType, "http_request")

                                // Record specific error types
                                if statusCode == 403 {
                                        m.metrics.RecordPermissionDenied("http_endpoint", method+" "+endpoint)
                                }
                                if statusCode == 400 {
                                        m.metrics.RecordValidationError("http_request", "bad_request")
                                }
                        }
                })
        }
}

// GitOperationMiddleware wraps Git operations to record metrics
type GitOperationMiddleware struct {
        metrics *ApplicationMetrics
}

// NewGitOperationMiddleware creates a new Git operation middleware
func NewGitOperationMiddleware() *GitOperationMiddleware {
        return &GitOperationMiddleware{
                metrics: GetApplicationMetrics(),
        }
}

// RecordOperation wraps a Git operation and records its metrics
func (g *GitOperationMiddleware) RecordOperation(operation string, fn func() error) error {
        start := time.Now()

        // Record repository access
        g.metrics.RecordRepositoryAccess()

        // Execute operation
        err := fn()

        // Record metrics
        duration := time.Since(start)
        success := err == nil
        g.metrics.RecordGitOperation(operation, duration, success)

        // Record error if operation failed
        if err != nil {
                errorType := categorizeGitError(err)
                g.metrics.RecordError(errorType, operation)
        }

        return err
}

// RecordGitObjectProcessing records processing of Git objects
func (g *GitOperationMiddleware) RecordGitObjectProcessing(objectType string, count int) {
        for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
                g.metrics.RecordGitObjectProcessed(objectType)
        }
}

// PermissionMiddleware wraps permission checks to record metrics
type PermissionMiddleware struct {
        metrics *ApplicationMetrics
}

// NewPermissionMiddleware creates a new permission middleware
func NewPermissionMiddleware() *PermissionMiddleware {
        return &PermissionMiddleware{
                metrics: GetApplicationMetrics(),
        }
}

// RecordPermissionCheck wraps a permission check and records its metrics
func (p *PermissionMiddleware) RecordPermissionCheck(fn func() (bool, error)) (bool, error) {
        start := time.Now()

        // Execute permission check
        hasAccess, err := fn()

        // Record metrics
        duration := time.Since(start)
        result := "success"
        if err != nil {
                result = "error"
        } else if !hasAccess {
                result = "denied"
        }

        p.metrics.PermissionCheckDuration.WithLabelValues(result).Observe(duration.Seconds())

        // Record errors
        if err != nil {
                p.metrics.RecordError("permission_check_error", "permission_service")
        }
        if !hasAccess && err == nil {
                p.metrics.RecordPermissionDenied("repository", "access_check")
        }

        return hasAccess, err
}

// Helper functions

// getRequestSize estimates the size of an HTTP request
func getRequestSize(r *http.Request) int64 {
        size := int64(0)

        // Add URL length
        size += int64(len(r.URL.String()))

        // Add headers size (rough estimate)
        for name, values := range r.Header {
                size += int64(len(name))
                for _, value := range values {
                        size += int64(len(value))
                }
        }

        // Add content length if available
        if r.ContentLength > 0 {
                size += r.ContentLength
        }

        return size
}

// normalizeEndpoint converts URL paths to metric-friendly endpoint names
func normalizeEndpoint(path string) string {
        // Remove query parameters
        if idx := strings.Index(path, "?"); idx != -1 {
                path = path[:idx]
        }

        // Replace path parameters with placeholders
        path = strings.ReplaceAll(path, "/repos/", "/repos/{owner}/")

        // Handle common Git endpoints
        if strings.Contains(path, "/repos/{owner}/") {
                parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
                if len(parts) >= 4 {
                        // Replace owner and repo with placeholders
                        parts[2] = "{owner}"
                        parts[3] = "{repo}"
                        path = strings.Join(parts, "/")
                }
        }

        // Handle SSH protocol endpoints
        if strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ssh/") {
                path = "/ssh/{command}"
        }

        // Limit path length to prevent cardinality explosion
        if len(path) > 100 {
                path = path[:100] + "..."
        }

        return path
}

// categorizeHTTPError categorizes HTTP errors for metrics
func categorizeHTTPError(statusCode int) string {
        switch {
        case statusCode >= 500:
                return "server_error"
        case statusCode == 404:
                return "not_found"
        case statusCode == 403:
                return "permission_denied"
        case statusCode == 401:
                return "unauthorized"
        case statusCode == 400:
                return "bad_request"
        case statusCode >= 400:
                return "client_error"
        default:
                return "unknown_error"
        }
}

// categorizeGitError categorizes Git errors for metrics
func categorizeGitError(err error) string {
        if err == nil {
                return "none"
        }

        errStr := strings.ToLower(err.Error())

        switch {
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "not found"):
                return "not_found"
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "permission"):
                return "permission_denied"
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "timeout"):
                return "timeout"
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "invalid"):
                return "invalid_input"
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "network"):
                return "network_error"
        case strings.Contains(errStr, "repository"):
                return "repository_error"
        default:
                return "git_error"
        }
}

// MetricsConfig holds configuration for the metrics middleware
type MetricsMiddlewareConfig struct {
        // EnableResourceCollection enables automatic resource usage collection
        EnableResourceCollection bool `mapstructure:"enable_resource_collection"`

        // ResourceCollectionInterval defines how often to collect resource metrics
        ResourceCollectionInterval time.Duration `mapstructure:"resource_collection_interval"`

        // EndpointNormalization enables path normalization for metrics
        EndpointNormalization bool `mapstructure:"endpoint_normalization"`

        // MaxPathLength limits the maximum path length in metrics
        MaxPathLength int `mapstructure:"max_path_length"`
}

// DefaultMetricsMiddlewareConfig returns default configuration
func DefaultMetricsMiddlewareConfig() MetricsMiddlewareConfig {
        return MetricsMiddlewareConfig{
                EnableResourceCollection:   true,
                ResourceCollectionInterval: 15 * time.Second,
                EndpointNormalization:      true,
                MaxPathLength:              100,
        }
}

// CacheMetricsIntegration provides integration with existing cache metrics
type CacheMetricsIntegration struct {
        metrics *ApplicationMetrics
}

// NewCacheMetricsIntegration creates cache metrics integration
func NewCacheMetricsIntegration() *CacheMetricsIntegration {
        return &CacheMetricsIntegration{
                metrics: GetApplicationMetrics(),
        }
}

// UpdateCacheHitRate updates the repository cache hit rate metric
func (c *CacheMetricsIntegration) UpdateCacheHitRate(hitRate float64) {
        c.metrics.RepositoryCacheHitRate.Set(hitRate * 100) // Convert to percentage
}

// APIServiceCallsTracker tracks calls to external API services
type APIServiceCallsTracker struct {
        metrics *ApplicationMetrics
}

// NewAPIServiceCallsTracker creates an API service calls tracker
func NewAPIServiceCallsTracker() *APIServiceCallsTracker {
        return &APIServiceCallsTracker{
                metrics: GetApplicationMetrics(),
        }
}

// RecordAPICall records a call to an external API service
func (a *APIServiceCallsTracker) RecordAPICall(endpoint string, success bool) {
        result := "success"
        if !success {
                result = "error"
        }
        a.metrics.APIServiceCallsTotal.WithLabelValues(endpoint, result).Inc()
}

// Package observability provides OpenTelemetry distributed tracing capabilities
// for comprehensive request tracing across HTTP handlers, Git operations, and external API calls.
package observability

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"

        "go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/codes"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/stdout/stdouttrace"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
        "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
        oteltrace "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
)

const (
        // TracerName is the name of the tracer used throughout the application
        TracerName = "github.com/collabops/git-executor"

        // Service attributes
        ServiceName    = "git-executor"
        ServiceVersion = "1.0.0" // This could be injected at build time
)

// TracingConfig holds configuration for OpenTelemetry tracing
type TracingConfig struct {
        Enabled          bool    `mapstructure:"enabled"`
        ServiceName      string  `mapstructure:"service_name"`
        ServiceVersion   string  `mapstructure:"service_version"`
        Environment      string  `mapstructure:"environment"`
        ExporterType     string  `mapstructure:"exporter_type"` // stdout, jaeger, otlp, etc.
        ExporterEndpoint string  `mapstructure:"exporter_endpoint"`
        SamplingRate     float64 `mapstructure:"sampling_rate"`
}

// DefaultTracingConfig returns default tracing configuration
func DefaultTracingConfig() TracingConfig {
        return TracingConfig{
                Enabled:        true,
                ServiceName:    ServiceName,
                ServiceVersion: ServiceVersion,
                Environment:    "development",
                ExporterType:   "stdout",
                SamplingRate:   1.0, // 100% sampling for development
        }
}

// TracingManager manages OpenTelemetry tracing setup and lifecycle
type TracingManager struct {
        config         TracingConfig
        tracerProvider *trace.TracerProvider
        tracer         oteltrace.Tracer
}

// NewTracingManager creates a new tracing manager with the given configuration
func NewTracingManager(config TracingConfig) (*TracingManager, error) {
        if !config.Enabled {
                // Return a no-op manager when tracing is disabled
                return &TracingManager{
                        config: config,
                        tracer: otel.Tracer(TracerName),
                }, nil
        }

        // Create resource with service information
        res, err := resource.Merge(
                resource.Default(),
                resource.NewWithAttributes(
                        "",
                        attribute.String("service.name", config.ServiceName),
                        attribute.String("service.version", config.ServiceVersion),
                        attribute.String("deployment.environment", config.Environment),
                ),
        )
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create resource: %w", err)
        }

        // Create exporter based on configuration
        exporter, err := createExporter(config)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create exporter: %w", err)
        }

        // Create tracer provider
        tp := trace.NewTracerProvider(
                trace.WithBatcher(exporter),
                trace.WithResource(res),
                trace.WithSampler(trace.TraceIDRatioBased(config.SamplingRate)),
        )

        // Set global tracer provider
        otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)

        // Set global propagator to ensure proper context propagation
        otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(
                propagation.TraceContext{},
                propagation.Baggage{},
        ))

        return &TracingManager{
                config:         config,
                tracerProvider: tp,
                tracer:         tp.Tracer(TracerName),
        }, nil
}

// createExporter creates a trace exporter based on configuration
func createExporter(config TracingConfig) (trace.SpanExporter, error) {
        switch config.ExporterType {
        case "stdout":
                return stdouttrace.New(stdouttrace.WithPrettyPrint())
        default:
                // Default to stdout for now
                // In production, you'd want to add support for Jaeger, OTLP, etc.
                return stdouttrace.New(stdouttrace.WithPrettyPrint())
        }
}

// Shutdown gracefully shuts down the tracing manager
func (tm *TracingManager) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
        if tm.tracerProvider != nil {
                return tm.tracerProvider.Shutdown(ctx)
        }
        return nil
}

// HTTPMiddleware returns OpenTelemetry HTTP middleware for automatic request tracing
func (tm *TracingManager) HTTPMiddleware() func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
        if !tm.config.Enabled {
                // Return pass-through middleware when tracing is disabled
                return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                        return next
                }
        }

        return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
                return otelhttp.NewHandler(next, "http-request")
        }
}

// GitOperationTracer provides tracing for Git operations
type GitOperationTracer struct {
        tracer oteltrace.Tracer
}

// NewGitOperationTracer creates a new Git operation tracer
func NewGitOperationTracer() *GitOperationTracer {
        return &GitOperationTracer{
                tracer: otel.Tracer(TracerName),
        }
}

// TraceGitOperation wraps a Git operation with tracing
func (gt *GitOperationTracer) TraceGitOperation(ctx context.Context, operationType string, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
        ctx, span := gt.tracer.Start(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("git.%s", operationType),
                oteltrace.WithAttributes(
                        attribute.String("git.operation", operationType),
                        attribute.String("component", "git"),
                ),
        )
        defer span.End()

        // Execute the operation
        err := fn(ctx)

        // Record the result
        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return err
}

// TraceRepositoryAccess traces repository access operations
func (gt *GitOperationTracer) TraceRepositoryAccess(ctx context.Context, owner, repo, operation string, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
        ctx, span := gt.tracer.Start(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("git.repository.%s", operation),
                oteltrace.WithAttributes(
                        attribute.String("git.repository.owner", owner),
                        attribute.String("git.repository.name", repo),
                        attribute.String("git.operation", operation),
                        attribute.String("component", "git"),
                ),
        )
        defer span.End()

        // Execute the operation
        err := fn(ctx)

        // Record the result
        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return err
}

// APIServiceTracer provides tracing for external API service calls
type APIServiceTracer struct {
        tracer oteltrace.Tracer
}

// NewAPIServiceTracer creates a new API service tracer
func NewAPIServiceTracer() *APIServiceTracer {
        return &APIServiceTracer{
                tracer: otel.Tracer(TracerName),
        }
}

// TraceAPICall wraps an API service call with tracing
func (at *APIServiceTracer) TraceAPICall(ctx context.Context, serviceName, endpoint string, fn func(context.Context) error) error {
        ctx, span := at.tracer.Start(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("api.%s.%s", serviceName, endpoint),
                oteltrace.WithAttributes(
                        attribute.String("api.service", serviceName),
                        attribute.String("api.endpoint", endpoint),
                        attribute.String("component", "api_client"),
                ),
        )
        defer span.End()

        // Execute the API call
        err := fn(ctx)

        // Record the result
        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return err
}

// TracePermissionCheck traces permission check operations
func (at *APIServiceTracer) TracePermissionCheck(ctx context.Context, userID, owner, repo string, fn func(context.Context) (bool, error)) (bool, error) {
        ctx, span := at.tracer.Start(ctx, "permission.check",
                oteltrace.WithAttributes(
                        attribute.String("permission.user_id", userID),
                        attribute.String("permission.owner", owner),
                        attribute.String("permission.repo", repo),
                        attribute.String("component", "permission_client"),
                ),
        )
        defer span.End()

        // Execute the permission check
        hasAccess, err := fn(ctx)

        // Record the result
        span.SetAttributes(
                attribute.Bool("permission.granted", hasAccess),
        )

        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return hasAccess, err
}

// CustomSpanTracer provides utilities for creating custom spans
type CustomSpanTracer struct {
        tracer oteltrace.Tracer
}

// NewCustomSpanTracer creates a new custom span tracer
func NewCustomSpanTracer() *CustomSpanTracer {
        return &CustomSpanTracer{
                tracer: otel.Tracer(TracerName),
        }
}

// StartSpan starts a new span with the given name and attributes
func (ct *CustomSpanTracer) StartSpan(ctx context.Context, name string, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) (context.Context, oteltrace.Span) {
        return ct.tracer.Start(ctx, name, oteltrace.WithAttributes(attrs...))
}

// TraceFunction wraps a function execution with a custom span
func (ct *CustomSpanTracer) TraceFunction(ctx context.Context, functionName string, fn func(context.Context) error, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) error {
        ctx, span := ct.tracer.Start(ctx, functionName, oteltrace.WithAttributes(attrs...))
        defer span.End()

        err := fn(ctx)

        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return err
}

// AddSpanEvent adds an event to the current span
func (ct *CustomSpanTracer) AddSpanEvent(ctx context.Context, name string, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
        span := oteltrace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
        if span != nil {
                span.AddEvent(name, oteltrace.WithAttributes(attrs...))
        }
}

// SetSpanAttributes sets attributes on the current span
func (ct *CustomSpanTracer) SetSpanAttributes(ctx context.Context, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) {
        span := oteltrace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
        if span != nil {
                span.SetAttributes(attrs...)
        }
}

// TraceSpan is a convenience function to trace any operation
func TraceSpan(ctx context.Context, spanName string, fn func(context.Context) error, attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) error {
        tracer := otel.Tracer(TracerName)
        ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, spanName, oteltrace.WithAttributes(attrs...))
        defer span.End()

        err := fn(ctx)

        if err != nil {
                span.RecordError(err)
                span.SetStatus(codes.Error, err.Error())
        } else {
                span.SetStatus(codes.Ok, "")
        }

        return err
}

// ExtractTraceID extracts the trace ID from the current span context
func ExtractTraceID(ctx context.Context) string {
        span := oteltrace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
        if span != nil && span.SpanContext().IsValid() {
                return span.SpanContext().TraceID().String()
        }
        return ""
}

// ExtractSpanID extracts the span ID from the current span context
func ExtractSpanID(ctx context.Context) string {
        span := oteltrace.SpanFromContext(ctx)
        if span != nil && span.SpanContext().IsValid() {
                return span.SpanContext().SpanID().String()
        }
        return ""
}

// InjectTraceIDIntoHeaders injects trace information into HTTP headers
func InjectTraceIDIntoHeaders(ctx context.Context, headers http.Header) {
        traceID := ExtractTraceID(ctx)
        spanID := ExtractSpanID(ctx)

        if traceID != "" {
                headers.Set("X-Trace-ID", traceID)
        }
        if spanID != "" {
                headers.Set("X-Span-ID", spanID)
        }
}

package performance

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "runtime"
        "sync"
        "time"

        "go.uber.org/zap"

        gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
)

// ResourceManager provides comprehensive resource management and performance optimization
type ResourceManager struct {
        config           *ResourceConfig
        logger           *logging.Logger
        repositoryPool   *RepositoryPool
        memoryMonitor    *MemoryMonitor
        connectionPool   *ConnectionPool
        requestTracker   *RequestTracker
        cacheManager     *CacheManager
        metricsCollector *MetricsCollector
}

// ResourceConfig contains configuration for resource management
type ResourceConfig struct {
        // Repository Pool Configuration
        MaxRepositories int           `json:"max_repositories"` // Maximum cached repositories
        RepositoryTTL   time.Duration `json:"repository_ttl"`   // Repository cache TTL
        CleanupInterval time.Duration `json:"cleanup_interval"` // Cache cleanup interval

        // Memory Management
        MaxMemoryUsage      int64         `json:"max_memory_usage"`      // Maximum memory usage (bytes)
        GCThreshold         float64       `json:"gc_threshold"`          // GC trigger threshold (0.0-1.0)
        MemoryCheckInterval time.Duration `json:"memory_check_interval"` // Memory monitoring interval

        // Connection Management
        MaxConnections    int           `json:"max_connections"`    // Maximum concurrent connections
        ConnectionTimeout time.Duration `json:"connection_timeout"` // Connection timeout
        IdleTimeout       time.Duration `json:"idle_timeout"`       // Idle connection timeout

        // Request Management
        MaxRequestDuration time.Duration `json:"max_request_duration"` // Maximum request duration
        RequestQueueSize   int           `json:"request_queue_size"`   // Request queue size
        ConcurrentRequests int           `json:"concurrent_requests"`  // Maximum concurrent requests

        // Cache Management
        EnableRepositoryCache bool `json:"enable_repository_cache"` // Enable repository caching
        EnableObjectCache     bool `json:"enable_object_cache"`     // Enable Git object caching
        CacheCompressionLevel int  `json:"cache_compression_level"` // Cache compression (0-9)

        // Streaming Configuration
        StreamingBufferSize int   `json:"streaming_buffer_size"` // Streaming buffer size
        MaxStreamingFile    int64 `json:"max_streaming_file"`    // Maximum file size for streaming
        EnableStreaming     bool  `json:"enable_streaming"`      // Enable streaming for large files
}

// DefaultResourceConfig returns default resource configuration
func DefaultResourceConfig() *ResourceConfig {
        return &ResourceConfig{
                MaxRepositories:       100,
                RepositoryTTL:         30 * time.Minute,
                CleanupInterval:       5 * time.Minute,
                MaxMemoryUsage:        1024 * 1024 * 1024, // 1GB
                GCThreshold:           0.8,
                MemoryCheckInterval:   30 * time.Second,
                MaxConnections:        1000,
                ConnectionTimeout:     30 * time.Second,
                IdleTimeout:           5 * time.Minute,
                MaxRequestDuration:    10 * time.Minute,
                RequestQueueSize:      10000,
                ConcurrentRequests:    500,
                EnableRepositoryCache: true,
                EnableObjectCache:     true,
                CacheCompressionLevel: 6,
                StreamingBufferSize:   64 * 1024,         // 64KB
                MaxStreamingFile:      100 * 1024 * 1024, // 100MB
                EnableStreaming:       true,
        }
}

// NewResourceManager creates a new resource manager instance
func NewResourceManager(cfg *config.Config) (*ResourceManager, error) {
        if cfg == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("config cannot be nil")
        }

        logger, err := logging.NewLogger(cfg.Logging)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create logger: %w", err)
        }

        // Use default resource config if not specified
        resourceCfg := DefaultResourceConfig()

        pathConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(cfg.Git.RepoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create path config: %w", err)
        }

        // Initialize components
        repositoryPool := NewRepositoryPool(resourceCfg, pathConfig, logger)
        memoryMonitor := NewMemoryMonitor(resourceCfg, logger)
        connectionPool := NewConnectionPool(resourceCfg, logger)
        requestTracker := NewRequestTracker(resourceCfg, logger)
        cacheManager := NewCacheManager(resourceCfg, logger)
        metricsCollector := NewMetricsCollector(logger)

        rm := &ResourceManager{
                config:           resourceCfg,
                logger:           logger,
                repositoryPool:   repositoryPool,
                memoryMonitor:    memoryMonitor,
                connectionPool:   connectionPool,
                requestTracker:   requestTracker,
                cacheManager:     cacheManager,
                metricsCollector: metricsCollector,
        }

        // Start background processes
        if err := rm.start(); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to start resource manager: %w", err)
        }

        return rm, nil
}

// RepositoryPool manages a pool of Git repository instances
type RepositoryPool struct {
        config     *ResourceConfig
        pathConfig *repository.PathConfig
        logger     *logging.Logger
        repos      map[string]*RepositoryCacheEntry
        mu         sync.RWMutex
}

// RepositoryCacheEntry represents a cached repository entry
type RepositoryCacheEntry struct {
        Repository  *gogit.Repository
        LastAccess  time.Time
        AccessCount int64
        MemoryUsage int64
}

// NewRepositoryPool creates a new repository pool
func NewRepositoryPool(config *ResourceConfig, pathConfig *repository.PathConfig, logger *logging.Logger) *RepositoryPool {
        return &RepositoryPool{
                config:     config,
                pathConfig: pathConfig,
                logger:     logger,
                repos:      make(map[string]*RepositoryCacheEntry),
        }
}

// GetRepository retrieves or creates a repository from the pool
func (rp *RepositoryPool) GetRepository(ctx context.Context, owner, repo string) (*gogit.Repository, error) {
        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo)

        rp.mu.RLock()
        if entry, exists := rp.repos[key]; exists {
                entry.LastAccess = time.Now()
                entry.AccessCount++
                rp.mu.RUnlock()

                rp.logger.Debug("Repository retrieved from pool",
                        zap.String("key", key),
                        zap.Int64("access_count", entry.AccessCount))

                return entry.Repository, nil
        }
        rp.mu.RUnlock()

        // Repository not in pool, create it
        repoPath, err := repository.GetRepoPath(rp.pathConfig, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository path: %w", err)
        }

        // Use filesystem storage for better performance with cached repositories
        repository, err := gogit.PlainOpen(repoPath)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
        }

        // Calculate approximate memory usage
        memUsage := rp.estimateRepositoryMemoryUsage(repository)

        // Add to pool
        rp.mu.Lock()
        defer rp.mu.Unlock()

        // Check if we need to evict entries
        if len(rp.repos) >= rp.config.MaxRepositories {
                rp.evictLeastRecentlyUsed()
        }

        rp.repos[key] = &RepositoryCacheEntry{
                Repository:  repository,
                LastAccess:  time.Now(),
                AccessCount: 1,
                MemoryUsage: memUsage,
        }

        rp.logger.Info("Repository added to pool",
                zap.String("key", key),
                zap.Int64("memory_usage", memUsage),
                zap.Int("pool_size", len(rp.repos)))

        return repository, nil
}

// estimateRepositoryMemoryUsage estimates the memory usage of a repository
func (rp *RepositoryPool) estimateRepositoryMemoryUsage(repo *gogit.Repository) int64 {
        // This is a simplified estimation
        // In a real implementation, you might want to calculate based on:
        // - Number of references
        // - Object store size
        // - Index size, etc.
        return 1024 * 1024 // 1MB base estimate
}

// evictLeastRecentlyUsed removes the least recently used repository from the pool
func (rp *RepositoryPool) evictLeastRecentlyUsed() {
        var oldestKey string
        var oldestTime time.Time
        first := true

        for key, entry := range rp.repos {
                if first || entry.LastAccess.Before(oldestTime) {
                        oldestKey = key
                        oldestTime = entry.LastAccess
                        first = false
                }
        }

        if oldestKey != "" {
                delete(rp.repos, oldestKey)
                rp.logger.Debug("Repository evicted from pool",
                        zap.String("key", oldestKey),
                        zap.Time("last_access", oldestTime))
        }
}

// Cleanup removes expired repositories from the pool
func (rp *RepositoryPool) Cleanup() {
        rp.mu.Lock()
        defer rp.mu.Unlock()

        now := time.Now()
        var removed []string

        for key, entry := range rp.repos {
                if now.Sub(entry.LastAccess) > rp.config.RepositoryTTL {
                        delete(rp.repos, key)
                        removed = append(removed, key)
                }
        }

        if len(removed) > 0 {
                rp.logger.Info("Repository pool cleanup completed",
                        zap.Strings("removed", removed),
                        zap.Int("remaining", len(rp.repos)))
        }
}

// MemoryMonitor monitors and manages memory usage
type MemoryMonitor struct {
        config   *ResourceConfig
        logger   *logging.Logger
        stats    *MemoryStats
        stopChan chan struct{}
        mu       sync.RWMutex
}

// MemoryStats contains memory usage statistics
type MemoryStats struct {
        Alloc        uint64    `json:"alloc"`          // Currently allocated bytes
        TotalAlloc   uint64    `json:"total_alloc"`    // Total allocated bytes
        Sys          uint64    `json:"sys"`            // System memory
        NumGC        uint32    `json:"num_gc"`         // Number of GC cycles
        LastGC       time.Time `json:"last_gc"`        // Last GC time
        GCPauseTotal uint64    `json:"gc_pause_total"` // Total GC pause time
        HeapAlloc    uint64    `json:"heap_alloc"`     // Heap allocated bytes
        HeapSys      uint64    `json:"heap_sys"`       // Heap system bytes
        HeapInuse    uint64    `json:"heap_inuse"`     // Heap in-use bytes
        StackInuse   uint64    `json:"stack_inuse"`    // Stack in-use bytes
        UsagePercent float64   `json:"usage_percent"`  // Memory usage percentage
        LastUpdated  time.Time `json:"last_updated"`   // Last update time
}

// NewMemoryMonitor creates a new memory monitor
func NewMemoryMonitor(config *ResourceConfig, logger *logging.Logger) *MemoryMonitor {
        return &MemoryMonitor{
                config:   config,
                logger:   logger,
                stats:    &MemoryStats{},
                stopChan: make(chan struct{}),
        }
}

// Start begins memory monitoring
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) Start() {
        go mm.monitorLoop()
}

// Stop stops memory monitoring
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) Stop() {
        select {
        case <-mm.stopChan:
                // Already closed
                return
        default:
                close(mm.stopChan)
        }
}

// monitorLoop runs the memory monitoring loop
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) monitorLoop() {
        ticker := time.NewTicker(mm.config.MemoryCheckInterval)
        defer ticker.Stop()

        for {
                select {
                case <-ticker.C:
                        mm.updateStats()
                        mm.checkMemoryPressure()
                case <-mm.stopChan:
                        return
                }
        }
}

// updateStats updates memory statistics
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) updateStats() {
        var m runtime.MemStats
        runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)

        mm.mu.Lock()
        defer mm.mu.Unlock()

        mm.stats.Alloc = m.Alloc
        mm.stats.TotalAlloc = m.TotalAlloc
        mm.stats.Sys = m.Sys
        mm.stats.NumGC = m.NumGC
        mm.stats.HeapAlloc = m.HeapAlloc
        mm.stats.HeapSys = m.HeapSys
        mm.stats.HeapInuse = m.HeapInuse
        mm.stats.StackInuse = m.StackInuse
        mm.stats.UsagePercent = float64(m.Alloc) / float64(mm.config.MaxMemoryUsage) * 100
        mm.stats.LastUpdated = time.Now()

        if m.NumGC > 0 {
                mm.stats.LastGC = time.Unix(0, int64(m.LastGC))
                mm.stats.GCPauseTotal = m.PauseTotalNs
        }
}

// checkMemoryPressure checks if memory usage is too high and triggers GC if needed
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) checkMemoryPressure() {
        mm.mu.RLock()
        usagePercent := mm.stats.UsagePercent
        mm.mu.RUnlock()

        if usagePercent > mm.config.GCThreshold*100 {
                mm.logger.Warn("High memory usage detected, triggering garbage collection",
                        zap.Float64("usage_percent", usagePercent),
                        zap.Float64("threshold", mm.config.GCThreshold*100))

                runtime.GC()

                // Update stats after GC
                mm.updateStats()

                mm.mu.RLock()
                newUsage := mm.stats.UsagePercent
                mm.mu.RUnlock()

                mm.logger.Info("Garbage collection completed",
                        zap.Float64("usage_before", usagePercent),
                        zap.Float64("usage_after", newUsage))
        }
}

// GetStats returns current memory statistics
func (mm *MemoryMonitor) GetStats() *MemoryStats {
        mm.mu.RLock()
        defer mm.mu.RUnlock()

        // Return a copy to avoid race conditions
        statsCopy := *mm.stats
        return &statsCopy
}

// ConnectionPool manages HTTP connections and resource limits
type ConnectionPool struct {
        config        *ResourceConfig
        logger        *logging.Logger
        activeConns   int
        totalConns    int64
        rejectedConns int64
        mu            sync.RWMutex
}

// NewConnectionPool creates a new connection pool
func NewConnectionPool(config *ResourceConfig, logger *logging.Logger) *ConnectionPool {
        return &ConnectionPool{
                config: config,
                logger: logger,
        }
}

// AcquireConnection attempts to acquire a connection slot
func (cp *ConnectionPool) AcquireConnection(ctx context.Context) error {
        cp.mu.Lock()
        defer cp.mu.Unlock()

        if cp.activeConns >= cp.config.MaxConnections {
                cp.rejectedConns++
                return fmt.Errorf("connection limit exceeded: %d/%d active connections",
                        cp.activeConns, cp.config.MaxConnections)
        }

        cp.activeConns++
        cp.totalConns++

        cp.logger.Debug("Connection acquired",
                zap.Int("active", cp.activeConns),
                zap.Int("max", cp.config.MaxConnections))

        return nil
}

// ReleaseConnection releases a connection slot
func (cp *ConnectionPool) ReleaseConnection() {
        cp.mu.Lock()
        defer cp.mu.Unlock()

        if cp.activeConns > 0 {
                cp.activeConns--
        }

        cp.logger.Debug("Connection released",
                zap.Int("active", cp.activeConns))
}

// GetStats returns connection pool statistics
func (cp *ConnectionPool) GetStats() map[string]interface{} {
        cp.mu.RLock()
        defer cp.mu.RUnlock()

        return map[string]interface{}{
                "active_connections":   cp.activeConns,
                "max_connections":      cp.config.MaxConnections,
                "total_connections":    cp.totalConns,
                "rejected_connections": cp.rejectedConns,
                "utilization_percent":  float64(cp.activeConns) / float64(cp.config.MaxConnections) * 100,
        }
}

// RequestTracker tracks and manages active requests
type RequestTracker struct {
        config         *ResourceConfig
        logger         *logging.Logger
        activeRequests map[string]*RequestInfo
        requestQueue   chan *RequestInfo
        totalRequests  int64
        completedReqs  int64
        timeoutReqs    int64
}

// RequestInfo contains information about an active request
type RequestInfo struct {
        ID        string
        StartTime time.Time
        Context   context.Context
        Cancel    context.CancelFunc
        Type      string
        Resource  string
}

// NewRequestTracker creates a new request tracker
func NewRequestTracker(config *ResourceConfig, logger *logging.Logger) *RequestTracker {
        return &RequestTracker{
                config:         config,
                logger:         logger,
                activeRequests: make(map[string]*RequestInfo),
                requestQueue:   make(chan *RequestInfo, config.RequestQueueSize),
        }
}

// CacheManager manages various caches for performance optimization
type CacheManager struct {
        config      *ResourceConfig
        logger      *logging.Logger
        objectCache map[string]*CacheEntry
}

// CacheEntry represents a cached object entry
