// generateRecommendations generates actionable recommendations based on analysis
func (h *MergePreviewHandler) generateRecommendations(conflictAnalysis *git.MergeAnalysisResult, changesSummary *ChangesSummary, req *MergePreviewRequest) []string {
        var recommendations []string

        if conflictAnalysis.IsFastForward {
                recommendations = append(recommendations, "This merge can be performed as a fast-forward merge for optimal performance")
        }

        if conflictAnalysis.HasConflicts {
                if conflictAnalysis.AutoResolvable > 0 {
                        recommendations = append(recommendations, fmt.Sprintf("%d conflicts can be automatically resolved", conflictAnalysis.AutoResolvable))
                }
                if conflictAnalysis.ConflictCount-conflictAnalysis.AutoResolvable > 0 {
                        recommendations = append(recommendations, "Manual conflict resolution will be required")
                }
                recommendations = append(recommendations, "Consider using a different merge strategy to reduce conflicts")
        }

        if changesSummary != nil && changesSummary.TotalFiles > 1000 {
                recommendations = append(recommendations, "Large number of files changed - consider breaking into smaller merges")
        }

        if changesSummary != nil && changesSummary.BinaryFiles > 0 {
                recommendations = append(recommendations, fmt.Sprintf("%d binary files detected - ensure proper Git LFS configuration", changesSummary.BinaryFiles))
        }

        if len(recommendations) == 0 {
                recommendations = append(recommendations, "Merge can proceed without issues")
        }

        return recommendations
}

// generateWarnings generates warnings based on analysis
func (h *MergePreviewHandler) generateWarnings(conflictAnalysis *git.MergeAnalysisResult, changesSummary *ChangesSummary, req *MergePreviewRequest) []string {
        var warnings []string

        if conflictAnalysis.HasConflicts && conflictAnalysis.ConflictCount > 50 {
                warnings = append(warnings, "High number of conflicts detected - merge may be complex")
        }

        if changesSummary != nil && changesSummary.TotalFiles > 5000 {
                warnings = append(warnings, "Very large merge - performance may be impacted")
        }

        if req.MaxFileSize < 1024*1024 {
                warnings = append(warnings, "Low max_file_size may limit content analysis accuracy")
        }

        if req.MaxFiles < 100 {
                warnings = append(warnings, "Low max_files limit may result in incomplete analysis")
        }

        return warnings
}

// commitToInfo converts a commit object to CommitInfo
func (h *MergePreviewHandler) commitToInfo(commit *object.Commit) *CommitInfo {
        return &CommitInfo{
                SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                Message:   commit.Message,
                Author:    AuthorInfo{Name: commit.Author.Name, Email: commit.Author.Email, Date: commit.Author.When},
                Committer: AuthorInfo{Name: commit.Committer.Name, Email: commit.Committer.Email, Date: commit.Committer.When},
                CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
        }
}

// SendSuccess sends a successful JSON response
func (h *MergePreviewHandler) SendSuccess(c *gin.Context, data interface{}, message string) {
        response := map[string]interface{}{
                "success": true,
                "message": message,
                "data":    data,
        }
        c.JSON(http.StatusOK, response)
}

// Package protocol implements Git Smart HTTP protocol handlers for the executor.
// This file handles receive-pack operations (push) as the executor counterpart to upload-pack (fetch).
package protocol

import (
        "bufio"
        "bytes"
        "context"
        "encoding/binary"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "sort"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "sync"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/git"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
        "github.com/go-git/go-billy/v5/osfs"
        gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/storage/filesystem"
)

// Repository lock manager for preventing concurrent pushes
var (
        repoLocks  = make(map[string]*sync.Mutex)
        locksMutex = sync.RWMutex{}
)

// ReceivePackRequest represents a parsed receive-pack request from the client
type ReceivePackRequest struct {
        Commands     []RefUpdateCommand
        Capabilities []string
        PackfileData []byte
}

// RefUpdateCommand represents a single reference update command in a push
type RefUpdateCommand struct {
        RefName string        // Reference name (e.g., refs/heads/main)
        OldHash plumbing.Hash // Current hash (zero hash for create)
        NewHash plumbing.Hash // New hash (zero hash for delete)
}

// ReceivePackHandler handles Git Smart HTTP protocol for push operations (executor side)
type ReceivePackHandler struct {
        pathConfig       *repository.PathConfig
        permissionClient permissions.PermissionClient
        errorHandler     *ErrorHandler
        capabilities     *ServerCapabilities
}

// NewReceivePackHandler creates a new receive-pack handler for the executor
func NewReceivePackHandler(cfg *config.Config, permClient permissions.PermissionClient) (*ReceivePackHandler, error) {
        // Initialize path configuration
        pathConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(cfg.Git.RepoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create path config: %w", err)
        }

        // Create error handler
        errorHandler := NewErrorHandler(nil) // Logger will be set if needed

        // Get server capabilities for receive-pack
        capabilities := DefaultServerCapabilities()

        return &ReceivePackHandler{
                pathConfig:       pathConfig,
                permissionClient: permClient,
                errorHandler:     errorHandler,
                capabilities:     capabilities,
        }, nil
}

// HandleInfoRefs handles GET /repos/:owner/:repo/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack
// This endpoint advertises references and capabilities for push operations
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) HandleInfoRefs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        ctx := r.Context()

        // Extract path parameters from gateway-forwarded request
        owner := URLParam(r, "owner")
        repo := URLParam(r, "repo")
        service := r.URL.Query().Get("service")

        // Validate service parameter
        if service != "git-receive-pack" {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrInvalidService, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }

        // Get user ID from gateway context (forwarded header)
        userID := r.Header.Get("X-USER-ID")
        if userID == "" {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrMissingUserContext, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }

        // Check user permissions for WRITE access (pushes require write permission)
        hasAccess, err := h.permissionClient.CheckWriteAccess(ctx, userID, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("permission check failed: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }
        if !hasAccess {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrPermissionDenied, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }

        // Get repository path and validate
        repoPath, err := repository.GetAndValidateRepoPath(h.pathConfig, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("invalid repository path: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }

        // Ensure repository exists
        if err := repository.EnsureRepoExists(h.pathConfig, repoPath); err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrRepositoryNotFound, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }

        // Open repository using go-git with caching
        gitRepo, err := git.OpenRepositorySimple(repoPath)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack_info_refs")
                return
        }
        defer func() { _ = gitRepo.Close() }()

        // Set response headers for Git Smart HTTP protocol
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-git-receive-pack-advertisement")
        w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")

        // Write service advertisement
        _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "001f# service=git-receive-pack\n")
        _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "0000") // flush packet

        // Write repository references with capabilities
        err = h.writeReferencesWithCapabilities(ctx, w, gitRepo)
        if err != nil {
                // If we've already started writing, we can't send an HTTP error
                // Log the error and write an error packet instead
                _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "0000") // end packet
                return
        }

        // End with null packet
        _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "0000")
}

// writeReferencesWithCapabilities writes Git references with server capabilities for receive-pack
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) writeReferencesWithCapabilities(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, repo git.Repository) error {
        // Get all repository references
        refs, err := h.getAllReferences(ctx, repo)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to get references: %w", err)
        }

        // Create packet line writer
        pktWriter := newPktLineWriter(w)

        // Create capability string for receive-pack operations
        capString := h.buildReceiveCapabilities()

        if len(refs) == 0 {
                // Empty repository - write capabilities on null ref
                line := fmt.Sprintf("0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 capabilities^{}\x00%s\n", capString)
                if err := pktWriter.writeLine(line); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to write capabilities: %w", err)
                }
        } else {
                // Sort references for consistent output
                sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool {
                        return refs[i].Name < refs[j].Name
                })

                // Write first reference with capabilities
                firstRef := refs[0]
                line := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s\x00%s\n", firstRef.Hash, firstRef.Name, capString)
                if err := pktWriter.writeLine(line); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to write first ref with capabilities: %w", err)
                }

                // Write remaining references without capabilities
                for _, ref := range refs[1:] {
                        line := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s\n", ref.Hash, ref.Name)
                        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(line); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write ref %s: %w", ref.Name, err)
                        }
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// getAllReferences retrieves all references from the repository
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) getAllReferences(ctx context.Context, repo git.Repository) ([]Reference, error) {
        var refs []Reference

        // Try to get commits to find references
        commits, err := repo.GetCommits(ctx, "HEAD", 1, 0)
        if err != nil {
                // Repository might be empty - return empty refs list
                return refs, nil
        }

        if len(commits) > 0 {
                // For now, add HEAD and main branch
                headHash := commits[0].Hash

                refs = append(refs, Reference{
                        Name: "HEAD",
                        Hash: headHash,
                })

                refs = append(refs, Reference{
                        Name: "refs/heads/main",
                        Hash: headHash,
                })

                // TODO: In a full implementation, we would iterate through all refs
                // using go-git's References() method and convert them to our Reference struct
        }

        return refs, nil
}

// buildReceiveCapabilities builds the capability string for receive-pack operations
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) buildReceiveCapabilities() string {
        caps := []string{
                "report-status",                    // Send status for each ref update
                "delete-refs",                      // Allow reference deletion
                "ofs-delta",                        // Support offset deltas in packfiles
                "side-band-64k",                    // Support side-band protocol
                "atomic",                           // Support atomic transactions
                "push-options",                     // Support push options
                "agent=collabops-git-executor/1.0", // Server identification
        }

        return strings.Join(caps, " ")
}

// HandleReceivePack handles POST /repos/:owner/:repo/git-receive-pack
// This endpoint processes push requests with packfiles and updates references
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) HandleReceivePack(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        ctx := r.Context()

        // Extract path parameters from gateway-forwarded request
        owner := URLParam(r, "owner")
        repo := URLParam(r, "repo")

        // Get user ID from gateway context (forwarded header)
        userID := r.Header.Get("X-USER-ID")
        if userID == "" {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrMissingUserContext, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Check user permissions for WRITE access
        hasAccess, err := h.permissionClient.CheckWriteAccess(ctx, userID, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("permission check failed: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack")
                return
        }
        if !hasAccess {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrPermissionDenied, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Get repository path and validate
        repoPath, err := repository.GetAndValidateRepoPath(h.pathConfig, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("invalid repository path: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Ensure repository exists
        if err := repository.EnsureRepoExists(h.pathConfig, repoPath); err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, ErrRepositoryNotFound, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Parse the receive-pack request from client (forwarded by gateway)
        receiveReq, err := h.parseReceivePackRequest(r.Body)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("invalid receive-pack request: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Acquire repository lock to prevent concurrent pushes
        repoLock := getRepositoryLock(repoPath)
        repoLock.Lock()
        defer repoLock.Unlock()

        // Open repository using go-git
        fs := osfs.New(repoPath)
        storage := filesystem.NewStorage(fs, nil)
        gitRepo, err := gogit.Open(storage, fs)
        if err != nil {
                wrappedErr := fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, wrappedErr, "receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Set response headers for Git Smart HTTP protocol
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-git-receive-pack-result")
        w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")

        // Process the push request
        err = h.processReceivePackRequest(ctx, gitRepo, receiveReq, w)
        if err != nil {
                // If we've started writing, we can't send HTTP error anymore
                // Write an error in protocol format
                pktWriter := newPktLineWriter(w)
                _ = pktWriter.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("unpack %s", err.Error()))
                _ = pktWriter.flush()
                return
        }
}

// parseReceivePackRequest parses the receive-pack request body in pkt-line format
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) parseReceivePackRequest(body io.Reader) (*ReceivePackRequest, error) {
        req := &ReceivePackRequest{
                Commands:     make([]RefUpdateCommand, 0),
                Capabilities: make([]string, 0),
        }

        scanner := bufio.NewScanner(body)
        firstCommand := true
        var packfileBuffer bytes.Buffer
        inPackfile := false

        for scanner.Scan() {
                line := scanner.Text()

                // Handle empty lines or flush packets
                if line == "" || line == "0000" {
                        continue
                }

                // Check if we've hit the packfile data
                if strings.HasPrefix(line, "PACK") || inPackfile {
                        inPackfile = true
                        packfileBuffer.WriteString(line)
                        packfileBuffer.WriteByte('\n')
                        continue
                }

                // Parse pkt-line format
                if len(line) < 4 {
                        continue
                }

                // Extract length prefix (first 4 hex characters)
                lengthHex := line[:4]
                length, err := strconv.ParseInt(lengthHex, 16, 32)
                if err != nil {
                        continue // Skip malformed lines
                }

                if length == 0 {
                        // Flush packet, indicates end of commands
                        break
                }

                // Extract actual content (skip length prefix)
                content := line[4:]
                if len(content) == 0 {
                        continue
                }

                // Parse command line: "old-hash new-hash ref-name [capabilities]"
                // Need to be careful with parsing since capabilities can be null-separated OR space-separated

                // First, split only on the first two spaces to get hashes
                firstSpaceIdx := strings.Index(content, " ")
                if firstSpaceIdx == -1 || len(content) <= firstSpaceIdx+1 {
                        continue
                }

                secondSpaceIdx := strings.Index(content[firstSpaceIdx+1:], " ")
                if secondSpaceIdx == -1 {
                        continue
                }
                secondSpaceIdx += firstSpaceIdx + 1

                oldHashStr := content[:firstSpaceIdx]
                newHashStr := content[firstSpaceIdx+1 : secondSpaceIdx]
                refAndCapsStr := content[secondSpaceIdx+1:]

                // Check for capabilities in the ref name (null-separated)
                var refName string
                var capabilities []string

                if strings.Contains(refAndCapsStr, "\x00") {
                        // Null-separated format: "refs/heads/main\x00report-status delete-refs"
                        refParts := strings.Split(refAndCapsStr, "\x00")
                        refName = refParts[0]
                        if len(refParts) > 1 {
                                // All remaining parts after null are capabilities (space-separated)
                                capStr := strings.Join(refParts[1:], " ")
                                capabilities = strings.Fields(capStr)
                        }
                } else {
                        // Space-separated format: parse normally
                        parts := strings.Fields(refAndCapsStr)
                        if len(parts) > 0 {
                                refName = parts[0]
                                if len(parts) > 1 {
                                        capabilities = parts[1:]
                                }
                        }
                }

                // Parse hashes
                oldHash := plumbing.NewHash(oldHashStr)
                newHash := plumbing.NewHash(newHashStr)

                // Create command
                cmd := RefUpdateCommand{
                        RefName: refName,
                        OldHash: oldHash,
                        NewHash: newHash,
                }

                req.Commands = append(req.Commands, cmd)

                // Store capabilities from first command
                if firstCommand && len(capabilities) > 0 {
                        req.Capabilities = append(req.Capabilities, capabilities...)
                        firstCommand = false
                }
        }

        if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("error reading request body: %w", err)
        }

        // Store packfile data if any
        if packfileBuffer.Len() > 0 {
                req.PackfileData = packfileBuffer.Bytes()
        }

        return req, nil
}

// processReceivePackRequest processes the push request and updates references
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) processReceivePackRequest(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository, req *ReceivePackRequest, w http.ResponseWriter) error {
        pktWriter := newPktLineWriter(w)

        // Validate that we have commands to process
        if len(req.Commands) == 0 {
                if err := pktWriter.writeLine("unpack ok"); err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to write unpack status: %w", err)
                }
                return pktWriter.flush()
        }

        // Process packfile if present
        if len(req.PackfileData) > 0 {
                err := h.processPackfile(ctx, repo, req.PackfileData)
                if err != nil {
                        // Report unpack failure
                        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("unpack %s", err.Error())); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write unpack error: %w", err)
                        }
                        return pktWriter.flush()
                }
        }

        // Report successful unpack
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine("unpack ok"); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write unpack status: %w", err)
        }

        // Process each reference update command
        for _, cmd := range req.Commands {
                err := h.processRefUpdate(ctx, repo, cmd)
                if err != nil {
                        // Report failure for this reference
                        statusLine := fmt.Sprintf("ng %s %s", cmd.RefName, err.Error())
                        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(statusLine); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write ref error status: %w", err)
                        }
                } else {
                        // Report success for this reference
                        statusLine := fmt.Sprintf("ok %s", cmd.RefName)
                        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(statusLine); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write ref success status: %w", err)
                        }
                }
        }

        // End with flush packet
        return pktWriter.flush()
}

// processPackfile processes the uploaded packfile and stores objects in the repository
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) processPackfile(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository, packfileData []byte) error {
        if len(packfileData) == 0 {
                return nil // No packfile to process
        }

        // Validate packfile format and extract basic information
        header, err := h.validatePackfileFormat(packfileData)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid packfile format: %w", err)
        }

        // For now, if the packfile is valid, we assume the objects will be properly handled
        // by the reference update process. A complete implementation would:
        // 1. Parse individual objects from the packfile
        // 2. Resolve delta objects
        // 3. Store objects in the repository
        // 4. Update indexes

        // Log successful validation
        if header.ObjectCount > 0 {
                // Objects will be validated during reference updates
                _ = header.ObjectCount
        }

        return nil
}

// PackfileHeader represents basic packfile information
type PackfileHeader struct {
        Version     uint32
        ObjectCount uint32
}

// validatePackfileFormat performs basic validation of packfile format
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) validatePackfileFormat(packfileData []byte) (*PackfileHeader, error) {
        if len(packfileData) < 12 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("packfile too short: need at least 12 bytes, got %d", len(packfileData))
        }

        // Check packfile signature (first 4 bytes should be "PACK")
        signature := string(packfileData[0:4])
        if signature != "PACK" {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid packfile signature: expected 'PACK', got '%s'", signature)
        }

        // Read version (bytes 4-7, big endian)
        version := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(packfileData[4:8])
        if version < 2 || version > 3 {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported packfile version: %d", version)
        }

        // Read object count (bytes 8-11, big endian)
        objectCount := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(packfileData[8:12])

        return &PackfileHeader{
                Version:     version,
                ObjectCount: objectCount,
        }, nil
}

// processRefUpdate processes a single reference update command
func (h *ReceivePackHandler) processRefUpdate(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository, cmd RefUpdateCommand) error {
        // Validate the reference name
        if !isValidRefName(cmd.RefName) {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid reference name: %s", cmd.RefName)
        }

        // Get current reference (if it exists)
        ref, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName(cmd.RefName), true)
        if err != nil && err != plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to get reference %s: %w", cmd.RefName, err)
        }

        // Check if this is a create, update, or delete operation
        isCreate := cmd.OldHash == plumbing.ZeroHash
        isDelete := cmd.NewHash == plumbing.ZeroHash

        // Validate the old hash matches current state (for updates and deletes)
        if !isCreate {
                if ref == nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("reference %s does not exist", cmd.RefName)
                }
                if ref.Hash() != cmd.OldHash {
                        return fmt.Errorf("reference %s has been modified (expected %s, got %s)", cmd.RefName, cmd.OldHash, ref.Hash())
                }
        }

        // Validate the new object exists (for creates and updates)
        if !isDelete {
                _, err := repo.CommitObject(cmd.NewHash)
                if err != nil {
                        // Try as a tag object
                        _, err = repo.TagObject(cmd.NewHash)
                        if err != nil {
                                // Try as any object
                                _, err = repo.Object(plumbing.AnyObject, cmd.NewHash)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return fmt.Errorf("object %s not found in repository", cmd.NewHash)
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        // Perform the reference update
        if isDelete {
                // Delete the reference
                err = repo.Storer.RemoveReference(plumbing.ReferenceName(cmd.RefName))
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete reference %s: %w", cmd.RefName, err)
                }
        } else {
                // Create or update the reference
                newRef := plumbing.NewHashReference(plumbing.ReferenceName(cmd.RefName), cmd.NewHash)
                err = repo.Storer.SetReference(newRef)
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to update reference %s: %w", cmd.RefName, err)
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// isValidRefName validates a Git reference name according to Git naming rules
func isValidRefName(refName string) bool {
        // Basic validation - Git has complex rules, but these cover most cases
        if refName == "" {
                return false
        }

        // Must start with refs/
        if !strings.HasPrefix(refName, "refs/") {
                return false
        }

        // Check for control characters (ASCII 0-31)
        for _, r := range refName {
                if r >= 0 && r <= 31 {
                        return false
                }
        }

        // Cannot contain certain characters
        invalidChars := []string{" ", "~", "^", ":", "?", "*", "[", "\\", "..", "//", "@{"}
        for _, char := range invalidChars {
                if strings.Contains(refName, char) {
                        return false
                }
        }

        // Cannot end with certain characters
        if strings.HasSuffix(refName, "/") || strings.HasSuffix(refName, ".lock") {
                return false
        }

        return true
}

// getRepositoryLock gets or creates a mutex for the specific repository path
func getRepositoryLock(repoPath string) *sync.Mutex {
        locksMutex.RLock()
        lock, exists := repoLocks[repoPath]
        locksMutex.RUnlock()

        if exists {
                return lock
        }

        // Create new lock
        locksMutex.Lock()
        defer locksMutex.Unlock()

        // Double-check in case another goroutine created it
        if lock, exists := repoLocks[repoPath]; exists {
                return lock
        }

        lock = &sync.Mutex{}
        repoLocks[repoPath] = lock
        return lock
}

package protocol

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "sort"
        "strings"
        "time"

        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "go.uber.org/zap"

        gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/api"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/git"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
)

// RepositoryStateHandler handles REST API operations for repository state queries
type RepositoryStateHandler struct {
        config             *config.Config
        logger             *logging.Logger
        permClient         permissions.PermissionClient
        pathConfig         *repository.PathConfig
        pathValidator      *repository.GitAPIPathValidator
        objectManager      *git.GitObjectManager
        responseMiddleware *api.JSONResponseMiddleware
        errorMapper        *api.GitErrorMapper
}

// NewRepositoryStateHandler creates a new repository state handler
func NewRepositoryStateHandler(cfg *config.Config, permClient permissions.PermissionClient) (*RepositoryStateHandler, error) {
        logger, err := logging.NewLogger(cfg.Logging)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create logger: %w", err)
        }

        pathConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(cfg.Git.RepoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create path config: %w", err)
        }

        pathValidator := repository.NewGitAPIPathValidator(pathConfig)

        objectManager, err := git.NewGitObjectManager(pathConfig, logger)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create object manager: %w", err)
        }

        responseMiddleware := api.NewJSONResponseMiddleware(logger, "v1")
        errorMapper := api.NewGitErrorMapper()

        return &RepositoryStateHandler{
                config:             cfg,
                logger:             logger,
                permClient:         permClient,
                pathConfig:         pathConfig,
                pathValidator:      pathValidator,
                objectManager:      objectManager,
                responseMiddleware: responseMiddleware,
                errorMapper:        errorMapper,
        }, nil
}

// RepositoryStateResponse represents the complete repository state information
type RepositoryStateResponse struct {
        Success        bool                   `json:"success"`
        RepositoryName string                 `json:"repository_name"`
        Owner          string                 `json:"owner"`
        Head           *HeadReferenceInfo     `json:"head"`
        References     *RepositoryReferences  `json:"references"`
        WorkingTree    *WorkingTreeStatus     `json:"working_tree,omitempty"`
        RepositoryInfo *RepositoryMetadata    `json:"repository_info"`
        Timestamp      time.Time              `json:"timestamp"`
        Details        map[string]interface{} `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

// HeadReferenceInfo contains information about the current HEAD
type HeadReferenceInfo struct {
        Type       string      `json:"type"`        // "symbolic" or "hash"
        Name       string      `json:"name"`        // branch name or "HEAD"
        Target     string      `json:"target"`      // target reference or commit hash
        CommitSHA  string      `json:"commit_sha"`  // actual commit hash
        CommitInfo *CommitInfo `json:"commit_info"` // detailed commit information
        IsBranch   bool        `json:"is_branch"`   // true if pointing to a branch
        IsDetached bool        `json:"is_detached"` // true if in detached HEAD state
}

// RepositoryReferences contains all repository references
type RepositoryReferences struct {
        Branches []BranchReference `json:"branches"`
        Tags     []TagReference    `json:"tags"`
        Remotes  []RemoteReference `json:"remotes"`
        Count    ReferenceCounts   `json:"count"`
}

// BranchReference represents a branch reference
type BranchReference struct {
        Name         string      `json:"name"`
        FullName     string      `json:"full_name"` // refs/heads/branch-name
        CommitSHA    string      `json:"commit_sha"`
        CommitInfo   *CommitInfo `json:"commit_info"`
        IsHead       bool        `json:"is_head"`      // true if this is the current HEAD branch
        IsProtected  bool        `json:"is_protected"` // true if this is a protected branch
        LastModified time.Time   `json:"last_modified"`
}

// TagReference represents a tag reference
type TagReference struct {
        Name         string      `json:"name"`
        FullName     string      `json:"full_name"` // refs/tags/tag-name
        CommitSHA    string      `json:"commit_sha"`
        CommitInfo   *CommitInfo `json:"commit_info"`
        IsAnnotated  bool        `json:"is_annotated"`       // true if this is an annotated tag
        TagInfo      *TagInfo    `json:"tag_info,omitempty"` // additional tag information
        LastModified time.Time   `json:"last_modified"`
}

// RemoteReference represents a remote reference
type RemoteReference struct {
        Name         string      `json:"name"`
        FullName     string      `json:"full_name"` // refs/remotes/origin/branch-name
        CommitSHA    string      `json:"commit_sha"`
        CommitInfo   *CommitInfo `json:"commit_info"`
        RemoteName   string      `json:"remote_name"` // e.g., "origin"
        BranchName   string      `json:"branch_name"` // e.g., "main"
        LastModified time.Time   `json:"last_modified"`
}

// TagInfo contains additional information for annotated tags
type TagInfo struct {
        Message    string      `json:"message"`
        Tagger     *AuthorInfo `json:"tagger"`
        TargetType string      `json:"target_type"` // "commit", "tree", "blob", "tag"
        TargetSHA  string      `json:"target_sha"`
}

// ReferenceCounts provides counts of different reference types
type ReferenceCounts struct {
        Branches int `json:"branches"`
        Tags     int `json:"tags"`
        Remotes  int `json:"remotes"`
        Total    int `json:"total"`
}

// WorkingTreeStatus represents the status of the working tree (for non-bare repos)
type WorkingTreeStatus struct {
        IsClean        bool                      `json:"is_clean"`
        HasChanges     bool                      `json:"has_changes"`
        ModifiedFiles  []string                  `json:"modified_files,omitempty"`
        AddedFiles     []string                  `json:"added_files,omitempty"`
        DeletedFiles   []string                  `json:"deleted_files,omitempty"`
        UntrackedFiles []string                  `json:"untracked_files,omitempty"`
        FileStatus     map[string]FileStatusInfo `json:"file_status,omitempty"`
}

// FileStatusInfo provides detailed status for individual files
type FileStatusInfo struct {
        Staging  string `json:"staging"`  // staging area status
        Worktree string `json:"worktree"` // working tree status
}

// RepositoryMetadata contains general repository information
type RepositoryMetadata struct {
        IsBare        bool   `json:"is_bare"`
        HasWorktree   bool   `json:"has_worktree"`
        GitDirectory  string `json:"git_directory"`
        WorktreeRoot  string `json:"worktree_root,omitempty"`
        DefaultBranch string `json:"default_branch,omitempty"`
}

// HandleGetRepositoryState handles GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/state for complete repository state
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) HandleGetRepositoryState(c *gin.Context) {
        ctx := c.Request.Context()

        // Extract URL parameters
        owner := c.Param("owner")
        repo := c.Param("repo")

        h.logger.Info("Processing repository state request",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo))

        // Validate path components
        if err := h.pathValidator.ValidateFilePath(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo)); err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "validate_path")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Validate permissions
        if err := h.validatePermissions(c, owner, repo, "read"); err != nil {
                if gitAPIErr, ok := err.(*api.GitAPIError); ok {
                        c.JSON(gitAPIErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": gitAPIErr.Message})
                } else {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{"success": false, "error": err.Error()})
                }
                return
        }

        // Open repository
        repository, err := h.objectManager.OpenRepository(ctx, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "open_repository")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get HEAD information
        headInfo, err := h.getHeadInfo(ctx, repository)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "get_head_info")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get all references
        references, err := h.getAllReferences(ctx, repository, headInfo)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "get_references")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get repository metadata
        repoInfo, err := h.getRepositoryMetadata(ctx, repository)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "get_repository_metadata")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get working tree status (only for non-bare repositories)
        var workingTree *WorkingTreeStatus
        if !repoInfo.IsBare {
                workingTree, err = h.getWorkingTreeStatus(ctx, repository)
                if err != nil {
                        // Log warning but don't fail the request
                        h.logger.Warn("Failed to get working tree status",
                                zap.Error(err))
                }
        }

        // Prepare response
        response := RepositoryStateResponse{
                Success:        true,
                RepositoryName: repo,
                Owner:          owner,
                Head:           headInfo,
                References:     references,
                WorkingTree:    workingTree,
                RepositoryInfo: repoInfo,
                Timestamp:      time.Now().UTC(),
        }

        // Add additional details
        details := map[string]interface{}{
                "request_type": "repository_state",
                "includes": map[string]bool{
                        "head_info":       headInfo != nil,
                        "references":      references != nil,
                        "working_tree":    workingTree != nil,
                        "repository_info": repoInfo != nil,
                },
        }

        response.Details = details

        // Log success
        h.logger.Info("Repository state retrieved successfully",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("head_type", headInfo.Type),
                zap.String("head_target", headInfo.Target),
                zap.Int("branches_count", references.Count.Branches),
                zap.Int("tags_count", references.Count.Tags),
                zap.Bool("is_bare", repoInfo.IsBare))

        // Send success response
        api.SendSuccess(c, response, "Repository state retrieved successfully")
}

// HandleGetRepositoryHead handles GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/head for HEAD information only

// HandleGetRepositoryReferences handles GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/references for all references
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) HandleGetRepositoryReferences(c *gin.Context) {
        ctx := c.Request.Context()

        // Extract URL parameters
        owner := c.Param("owner")
        repo := c.Param("repo")

        // Optional query parameters
        refType := c.Query("type") // "branches", "tags", "remotes", or empty for all
        includeCommitInfo := c.Query("include_commit_info") == "true"

        h.logger.Info("Processing repository references request",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("type", refType),
                zap.Bool("include_commit_info", includeCommitInfo))

        // Validate path components
        if err := h.pathValidator.ValidateFilePath(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo)); err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "validate_path")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Validate permissions
        if err := h.validatePermissions(c, owner, repo, "read"); err != nil {
                if gitAPIErr, ok := err.(*api.GitAPIError); ok {
                        c.JSON(gitAPIErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": gitAPIErr.Message})
                } else {
                        c.JSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{"success": false, "error": err.Error()})
                }
                return
        }

        // Open repository
        repository, err := h.objectManager.OpenRepository(ctx, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "open_repository")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get HEAD information (needed for identifying current branch)
        headInfo, err := h.getHeadInfo(ctx, repository)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "get_head_info")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Get references based on type filter
        references, err := h.getFilteredReferences(ctx, repository, headInfo, refType, includeCommitInfo)
        if err != nil {
                apiErr := h.errorMapper.MapError(err, "get_references")
                c.JSON(apiErr.HTTPStatusCode(), gin.H{"success": false, "error": apiErr.Message})
                return
        }

        // Prepare response
        response := map[string]interface{}{
                "success":    true,
                "repository": fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo),
                "references": references,
                "filters": map[string]interface{}{
                        "type":                refType,
                        "include_commit_info": includeCommitInfo,
                },
                "timestamp": time.Now().UTC(),
        }

        // Log success
        h.logger.Info("Repository references retrieved successfully",
                zap.String("owner", owner),
                zap.String("repo", repo),
                zap.String("filter_type", refType),
                zap.Int("total_references", references.Count.Total))

        // Send success response
        api.SendSuccess(c, response, "Repository references retrieved successfully")
}

// validatePermissions validates user permissions for repository access
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) validatePermissions(c *gin.Context, owner, repo, operation string) error {
        userID := c.GetHeader("X-USER-ID")
        if userID == "" {
                apiErr := api.NewGitAPIError(
                        api.ErrorCodeUnauthorized,
                        "Missing X-USER-ID header",
                        api.ErrorSeverityMedium,
                )
                _ = apiErr.WithDetails("http_status", http.StatusUnauthorized)
                return apiErr
        }

        source := c.GetHeader("X-Source")
        if source == "" {
                apiErr := api.NewGitAPIError(
                        api.ErrorCodeUnauthorized,
                        "Missing X-Source header",
                        api.ErrorSeverityMedium,
                )
                _ = apiErr.WithDetails("http_status", http.StatusUnauthorized)
                return apiErr
        }

        var hasAccess bool
        var err error

        if operation == "read" {
                hasAccess, err = h.permClient.CheckReadAccess(c.Request.Context(), userID, owner, repo)
        } else {
                hasAccess, err = h.permClient.CheckWriteAccess(c.Request.Context(), userID, owner, repo)
        }

        if err != nil {
                apiErr := api.NewGitAPIError(
                        api.ErrorCodeInternalError,
                        fmt.Sprintf("Permission check failed: %v", err),
                        api.ErrorSeverityHigh,
                )
                _ = apiErr.WithDetails("http_status", http.StatusInternalServerError)
                return apiErr
        }

        if !hasAccess {
                apiErr := api.NewGitAPIError(
                        api.ErrorCodeForbidden,
                        fmt.Sprintf("Access denied for %s operation", operation),
                        api.ErrorSeverityMedium,
                )
                _ = apiErr.WithDetails("http_status", http.StatusForbidden)
                return apiErr
        }

        return nil
}

// getHeadInfo retrieves HEAD reference information
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) getHeadInfo(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository) (*HeadReferenceInfo, error) {
        headRef, err := repo.Head()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD reference: %w", err)
        }

        headInfo := &HeadReferenceInfo{
                Type:       headRef.Type().String(),
                CommitSHA:  headRef.Hash().String(),
                IsDetached: headRef.Type() == plumbing.HashReference,
        }

        if headRef.Type() == plumbing.SymbolicReference {
                // HEAD points to a branch
                targetRef := headRef.Target()
                headInfo.Target = targetRef.String()
                headInfo.Name = strings.TrimPrefix(targetRef.String(), "refs/heads/")
                headInfo.IsBranch = strings.HasPrefix(targetRef.String(), "refs/heads/")
        } else {
                // Detached HEAD
                headInfo.Target = headRef.Hash().String()
                headInfo.Name = "HEAD"
                headInfo.IsBranch = false
        }

        // Get commit information
        commit, err := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
        if err == nil {
                headInfo.CommitInfo = &CommitInfo{
                        SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                        Message:   commit.Message,
                        CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
                        Author: AuthorInfo{
                                Name:  commit.Author.Name,
                                Email: commit.Author.Email,
                                Date:  commit.Author.When,
                        },
                        Committer: AuthorInfo{
                                Name:  commit.Committer.Name,
                                Email: commit.Committer.Email,
                                Date:  commit.Committer.When,
                        },
                }
        }

        return headInfo, nil
}

// getAllReferences retrieves all repository references
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) getAllReferences(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository, headInfo *HeadReferenceInfo) (*RepositoryReferences, error) {
        return h.getFilteredReferences(ctx, repo, headInfo, "", true)
}

// getFilteredReferences retrieves filtered repository references
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) getFilteredReferences(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository, headInfo *HeadReferenceInfo, refType string, includeCommitInfo bool) (*RepositoryReferences, error) {
        refs := &RepositoryReferences{
                Branches: []BranchReference{},
                Tags:     []TagReference{},
                Remotes:  []RemoteReference{},
                Count:    ReferenceCounts{},
        }

        // Get all references
        refIter, err := repo.References()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get references: %w", err)
        }

        err = refIter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
                refName := ref.Name().String()

                switch {
                case strings.HasPrefix(refName, "refs/heads/"):
                        if refType == "" || refType == "branches" {
                                branch := h.createBranchReference(ref, headInfo, includeCommitInfo, repo)
                                refs.Branches = append(refs.Branches, branch)
                                refs.Count.Branches++
                        }
                case strings.HasPrefix(refName, "refs/tags/"):
                        if refType == "" || refType == "tags" {
                                tag := h.createTagReference(ref, includeCommitInfo, repo)
                                refs.Tags = append(refs.Tags, tag)
                                refs.Count.Tags++
                        }
                case strings.HasPrefix(refName, "refs/remotes/"):
                        if refType == "" || refType == "remotes" {
                                remote := h.createRemoteReference(ref, includeCommitInfo, repo)
                                refs.Remotes = append(refs.Remotes, remote)
                                refs.Count.Remotes++
                        }
                }
                return nil
        })

        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate references: %w", err)
        }

        // Sort references by name
        sort.Slice(refs.Branches, func(i, j int) bool {
                return refs.Branches[i].Name < refs.Branches[j].Name
        })
        sort.Slice(refs.Tags, func(i, j int) bool {
                return refs.Tags[i].Name < refs.Tags[j].Name
        })
        sort.Slice(refs.Remotes, func(i, j int) bool {
                return refs.Remotes[i].Name < refs.Remotes[j].Name
        })

        refs.Count.Total = refs.Count.Branches + refs.Count.Tags + refs.Count.Remotes

        return refs, nil
}

// createBranchReference creates a BranchReference from a plumbing.Reference
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) createBranchReference(ref *plumbing.Reference, headInfo *HeadReferenceInfo, includeCommitInfo bool, repo *gogit.Repository) BranchReference {
        branchName := strings.TrimPrefix(ref.Name().String(), "refs/heads/")

        branch := BranchReference{
                Name:         branchName,
                FullName:     ref.Name().String(),
                CommitSHA:    ref.Hash().String(),
                IsHead:       headInfo != nil && headInfo.Target == ref.Name().String(),
                IsProtected:  h.isProtectedBranch(branchName),
                LastModified: time.Now(), // TODO: Get actual last modified time
        }

        if includeCommitInfo {
                if commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); err == nil {
                        branch.CommitInfo = &CommitInfo{
                                SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                                Message:   commit.Message,
                                CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
                                Author: AuthorInfo{
                                        Name:  commit.Author.Name,
                                        Email: commit.Author.Email,
                                        Date:  commit.Author.When,
                                },
                                Committer: AuthorInfo{
                                        Name:  commit.Committer.Name,
                                        Email: commit.Committer.Email,
                                        Date:  commit.Committer.When,
                                },
                        }
                }
        }

        return branch
}

// createTagReference creates a TagReference from a plumbing.Reference
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) createTagReference(ref *plumbing.Reference, includeCommitInfo bool, repo *gogit.Repository) TagReference {
        tagName := strings.TrimPrefix(ref.Name().String(), "refs/tags/")

        tag := TagReference{
                Name:         tagName,
                FullName:     ref.Name().String(),
                CommitSHA:    ref.Hash().String(),
                IsAnnotated:  false,      // Will be determined below
                LastModified: time.Now(), // TODO: Get actual last modified time
        }

        // Check if it's an annotated tag
        if tagObj, err := repo.TagObject(ref.Hash()); err == nil {
                tag.IsAnnotated = true
                tag.TagInfo = &TagInfo{
                        Message:    tagObj.Message,
                        TargetType: tagObj.TargetType.String(),
                        TargetSHA:  tagObj.Target.String(),
                }

                if tagObj.Tagger.Name != "" {
                        tag.TagInfo.Tagger = &AuthorInfo{
                                Name:  tagObj.Tagger.Name,
                                Email: tagObj.Tagger.Email,
                                Date:  tagObj.Tagger.When,
                        }
                }

                // Get the actual commit the tag points to
                if commit, err := tagObj.Commit(); err == nil {
                        tag.CommitSHA = commit.Hash.String()

                        if includeCommitInfo {
                                tag.CommitInfo = &CommitInfo{
                                        SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                                        Message:   commit.Message,
                                        CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
                                        Author: AuthorInfo{
                                                Name:  commit.Author.Name,
                                                Email: commit.Author.Email,
                                                Date:  commit.Author.When,
                                        },
                                        Committer: AuthorInfo{
                                                Name:  commit.Committer.Name,
                                                Email: commit.Committer.Email,
                                                Date:  commit.Committer.When,
                                        },
                                }
                        }
                }
        } else {
                // Lightweight tag - points directly to a commit
                if includeCommitInfo {
                        if commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); err == nil {
                                tag.CommitInfo = &CommitInfo{
                                        SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                                        Message:   commit.Message,
                                        CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
                                        Author: AuthorInfo{
                                                Name:  commit.Author.Name,
                                                Email: commit.Author.Email,
                                                Date:  commit.Author.When,
                                        },
                                        Committer: AuthorInfo{
                                                Name:  commit.Committer.Name,
                                                Email: commit.Committer.Email,
                                                Date:  commit.Committer.When,
                                        },
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        return tag
}

// createRemoteReference creates a RemoteReference from a plumbing.Reference
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) createRemoteReference(ref *plumbing.Reference, includeCommitInfo bool, repo *gogit.Repository) RemoteReference {
        fullName := ref.Name().String()
        parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(fullName, "refs/remotes/"), "/")

        var remoteName, branchName string
        if len(parts) >= 2 {
                remoteName = parts[0]
                branchName = strings.Join(parts[1:], "/")
        }

        remote := RemoteReference{
                Name:         strings.TrimPrefix(fullName, "refs/remotes/"),
                FullName:     fullName,
                CommitSHA:    ref.Hash().String(),
                RemoteName:   remoteName,
                BranchName:   branchName,
                LastModified: time.Now(), // TODO: Get actual last modified time
        }

        if includeCommitInfo {
                if commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash()); err == nil {
                        remote.CommitInfo = &CommitInfo{
                                SHA:       commit.Hash.String(),
                                Message:   commit.Message,
                                CreatedAt: commit.Author.When,
                                Author: AuthorInfo{
                                        Name:  commit.Author.Name,
                                        Email: commit.Author.Email,
                                        Date:  commit.Author.When,
                                },
                                Committer: AuthorInfo{
                                        Name:  commit.Committer.Name,
                                        Email: commit.Committer.Email,
                                        Date:  commit.Committer.When,
                                },
                        }
                }
        }

        return remote
}

// getRepositoryMetadata retrieves repository metadata
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) getRepositoryMetadata(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository) (*RepositoryMetadata, error) {
        worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
        isBare := err != nil

        metadata := &RepositoryMetadata{
                IsBare:      isBare,
                HasWorktree: !isBare,
        }

        if !isBare && worktree != nil {
                metadata.WorktreeRoot = worktree.Filesystem.Root()
        }

        // Try to determine default branch
        if headRef, err := repo.Head(); err == nil && headRef.Type() == plumbing.SymbolicReference {
                defaultBranch := strings.TrimPrefix(headRef.Target().String(), "refs/heads/")
                metadata.DefaultBranch = defaultBranch
        }

        return metadata, nil
}

// getWorkingTreeStatus retrieves working tree status for non-bare repositories
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) getWorkingTreeStatus(ctx context.Context, repo *gogit.Repository) (*WorkingTreeStatus, error) {
        worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree: %w", err)
        }

        status, err := worktree.Status()
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree status: %w", err)
        }

        workingTreeStatus := &WorkingTreeStatus{
                IsClean:        status.IsClean(),
                HasChanges:     !status.IsClean(),
                ModifiedFiles:  []string{},
                AddedFiles:     []string{},
                DeletedFiles:   []string{},
                UntrackedFiles: []string{},
                FileStatus:     make(map[string]FileStatusInfo),
        }

        for file, fileStatus := range status {
                workingTreeStatus.FileStatus[file] = FileStatusInfo{
                        Staging:  string(fileStatus.Staging),
                        Worktree: string(fileStatus.Worktree),
                }

                // Categorize files
                switch fileStatus.Worktree {
                case gogit.Modified:
                        workingTreeStatus.ModifiedFiles = append(workingTreeStatus.ModifiedFiles, file)
                case gogit.Deleted:
                        workingTreeStatus.DeletedFiles = append(workingTreeStatus.DeletedFiles, file)
                case gogit.Untracked:
                        workingTreeStatus.UntrackedFiles = append(workingTreeStatus.UntrackedFiles, file)
                }

                if fileStatus.Staging == gogit.Added {
                        workingTreeStatus.AddedFiles = append(workingTreeStatus.AddedFiles, file)
                }
        }

        // Sort file lists
        sort.Strings(workingTreeStatus.ModifiedFiles)
        sort.Strings(workingTreeStatus.AddedFiles)
        sort.Strings(workingTreeStatus.DeletedFiles)
        sort.Strings(workingTreeStatus.UntrackedFiles)

        return workingTreeStatus, nil
}

// isProtectedBranch checks if a branch is considered protected (reused from branch_operations.go)
func (h *RepositoryStateHandler) isProtectedBranch(branchName string) bool {
        protectedBranches := []string{"main", "master", "develop", "production"}
        for _, protected := range protectedBranches {
                if strings.EqualFold(branchName, protected) {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// Package protocol implements SSH protocol handlers for Git operations forwarded from collabops-git-ssh gateway.
// This file handles SSH-specific Git operations that are forwarded from the SSH gateway to the executor.
package protocol

import (
        "bufio"
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "reflect"
        "strings"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/git"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
)

// SSHProtocolHandler handles SSH-forwarded Git operations
type SSHProtocolHandler struct {
        pathConfig       *repository.PathConfig
        permissionClient permissions.PermissionClient
        errorHandler     *ErrorHandler
}

// SSHRequest represents a validated SSH-forwarded Git request
type SSHRequest struct {
        UserID          string // User ID from gateway authentication
        CorrelationID   string // Correlation ID for tracing
        Owner           string // Repository owner
        Repo            string // Repository name
        RepoPath        string // Validated repository path
        Operation       string // git-upload-pack or git-receive-pack
        ProtocolVersion string // SSH protocol version if specified
}

// NewSSHProtocolHandler creates a new SSH protocol handler
func NewSSHProtocolHandler(cfg *config.Config, permissionClient permissions.PermissionClient) (*SSHProtocolHandler, error) {
        if cfg == nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("config cannot be nil")
        }

        if permissionClient == nil || (permissionClient != nil && isNilInterface(permissionClient)) {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("permission client cannot be nil")
        }

        // Create path configuration for repository path validation
        pathConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(cfg.Git.RepoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create path config: %w", err)
        }

        // Create error handler for protocol errors
        errorHandler := NewErrorHandler(nil)

        return &SSHProtocolHandler{
                pathConfig:       pathConfig,
                permissionClient: permissionClient,
                errorHandler:     errorHandler,
        }, nil
}

// ValidateSSHRequest validates and extracts context from SSH-forwarded request
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) ValidateSSHRequest(r *http.Request, operation string) (*SSHRequest, error) {
        // Extract user ID from gateway authentication header
        userID := r.Header.Get("X-USER-ID")
        if userID == "" {
                return nil, NewGitProtocolError("authentication_required", "Missing user authentication context from SSH gateway", http.StatusUnauthorized, true)
        }

        // Extract correlation ID for tracing (optional, generate if not present)
        correlationID := r.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID")
        if correlationID == "" {
                correlationID = fmt.Sprintf("ssh-%s", GenerateRequestID())
        }

        // Validate source header for SSH gateway
        source := r.Header.Get("X-Source")
        if source != "ssh-gateway" {
                return nil, NewGitProtocolError("invalid_source", "Invalid source header: SSH operations must come from ssh-gateway", http.StatusForbidden, true)
        }

        // Extract repository parameters from URL
        owner := URLParam(r, "owner")
        repo := URLParam(r, "repo")

        if owner == "" || repo == "" {
                return nil, NewGitProtocolError("invalid_request", "Missing required repository parameters (owner/repo)", http.StatusBadRequest, true)
        }

        // Validate repository path using existing path validation
        repoPath, err := repository.GetAndValidateRepoPath(h.pathConfig, owner, repo)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, WrapRepositoryError(err, fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, repo))
        }

        // Extract protocol version if specified (optional for SSH)
        protocolVersion := r.Header.Get("Git-Protocol")

        // Validate operation parameter
        if operation != "git-upload-pack" && operation != "git-receive-pack" {
                return nil, NewGitProtocolError("invalid_operation", fmt.Sprintf("Invalid Git operation: %s", operation), http.StatusBadRequest, true)
        }

        return &SSHRequest{
                UserID:          userID,
                CorrelationID:   correlationID,
                Owner:           owner,
                Repo:            repo,
                RepoPath:        repoPath,
                Operation:       operation,
                ProtocolVersion: protocolVersion,
        }, nil
}

// CheckSSHPermissions validates user permissions for SSH operations
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) CheckSSHPermissions(ctx context.Context, req *SSHRequest) error {
        switch req.Operation {
        case "git-upload-pack":
                // Check read permission for fetch operations
                hasPermission, err := h.permissionClient.CheckReadAccess(ctx, req.UserID, req.Owner, req.Repo)
                if err != nil {
                        return WrapPermissionError(err, "check_read_access")
                }
                if !hasPermission {
                        return NewGitProtocolError("access_denied", "Access denied to repository", http.StatusForbidden, true)
                }

        case "git-receive-pack":
                // Check write permission for push operations
                hasPermission, err := h.permissionClient.CheckWriteAccess(ctx, req.UserID, req.Owner, req.Repo)
                if err != nil {
                        return WrapPermissionError(err, "check_write_access")
                }
                if !hasPermission {
                        return NewGitProtocolError("write_access_denied", "Write access denied to repository", http.StatusForbidden, true)
                }

        default:
                return NewGitProtocolError("unknown_operation", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown operation: %s", req.Operation), http.StatusBadRequest, true)
        }

        return nil
}

// EnsureSSHRepository ensures the repository exists and can be opened
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) EnsureSSHRepository(ctx context.Context, req *SSHRequest) (git.Repository, error) {
        // Ensure repository exists using existing repository utilities
        if err := repository.EnsureRepoExists(h.pathConfig, req.RepoPath); err != nil {
                return nil, WrapRepositoryError(err, req.RepoPath)
        }

        // Open repository using go-git
        repo, err := git.OpenRepository(req.RepoPath)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, WrapRepositoryError(err, req.RepoPath)
        }

        return repo, nil
}

// SSHStreamingOptions contains options for SSH protocol streaming
type SSHStreamingOptions struct {
        BufferSize     int    // Buffer size for streaming operations
        ContentType    string // Content type for response
        CorrelationID  string // Correlation ID for logging
        MaxRequestSize int64  // Maximum request size (0 = unlimited)
        EnableLogging  bool   // Enable detailed logging
}

// DefaultSSHStreamingOptions returns default streaming options for SSH operations
func DefaultSSHStreamingOptions(correlationID string) *SSHStreamingOptions {
        return &SSHStreamingOptions{
                BufferSize:     64 * 1024,                              // 64KB buffer
                ContentType:    "application/x-git-upload-pack-result", // Default, overridden by specific operations
                CorrelationID:  correlationID,
                MaxRequestSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024, // 100MB max request size
                EnableLogging:  true,
        }
}

// SSHProtocolWriter provides utilities for writing SSH protocol responses
type SSHProtocolWriter struct {
        writer io.Writer
        buffer *bufio.Writer
}

// NewSSHProtocolWriter creates a new SSH protocol writer
func NewSSHProtocolWriter(w io.Writer, bufferSize int) *SSHProtocolWriter {
        return &SSHProtocolWriter{
                writer: w,
                buffer: bufio.NewWriterSize(w, bufferSize),
        }
}

// Write writes data to the SSH protocol stream
func (w *SSHProtocolWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
        return w.buffer.Write(p)
}

// Flush flushes the buffered data to the underlying writer
func (w *SSHProtocolWriter) Flush() error {
        return w.buffer.Flush()
}

// WriteSSHError writes an SSH protocol error message
func (w *SSHProtocolWriter) WriteSSHError(errorMsg string) error {
        // SSH protocol error format: ERR <message>\n
        _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w.buffer, "ERR %s\n", errorMsg)
        if err != nil {
                return err
        }
        return w.buffer.Flush()
}

// GenerateRequestID generates a unique request ID for correlation
func GenerateRequestID() string {
        // Simple request ID generation - in production, use a more robust method
        return fmt.Sprintf("%d", generateRandomID())
}

// generateRandomID generates a random ID (simple implementation)
func generateRandomID() int64 {
        // This is a placeholder - in production, use crypto/rand or similar
        return 123456789
}

// ValidateSSHGitCommand validates Git command parameters from SSH requests
func ValidateSSHGitCommand(command, repoPath string) error {
        // Validate command format
        if command == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("empty Git command")
        }

        // Validate repository path format (no path traversal)
        if strings.Contains(repoPath, "..") || strings.Contains(repoPath, "/./") {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid repository path: path traversal detected")
        }

        // Basic command validation
        validCommands := []string{"git-upload-pack", "git-receive-pack"}
        for _, validCmd := range validCommands {
                if strings.HasPrefix(command, validCmd) {
                        return nil
                }
        }

        return fmt.Errorf("invalid Git command: %s", command)
}

// ParseSSHGitProtocolHeaders extracts Git protocol information from SSH request headers
func ParseSSHGitProtocolHeaders(r *http.Request) map[string]string {
        headers := make(map[string]string)

        // Extract Git protocol version
        if version := r.Header.Get("Git-Protocol"); version != "" {
                headers["protocol-version"] = version
        }

        // Extract SSH-specific headers
        if sshConnection := r.Header.Get("SSH-Connection"); sshConnection != "" {
                headers["ssh-connection"] = sshConnection
        }

        // Extract client capabilities if present
        if capabilities := r.Header.Get("Git-Capabilities"); capabilities != "" {
                headers["capabilities"] = capabilities
        }

        return headers
}

// HandleSSHUploadPack handles POST /ssh/upload-pack requests (SSH-forwarded git-upload-pack)
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) HandleSSHUploadPack(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        // Validate SSH request
        sshReq, err := h.ValidateSSHRequest(r, "git-upload-pack")
        if err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_upload_pack")
                return
        }

        // Check permissions
        if err := h.CheckSSHPermissions(r.Context(), sshReq); err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_upload_pack")
                return
        }

        // Ensure repository exists
        repo, err := h.EnsureSSHRepository(r.Context(), sshReq)
        if err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_upload_pack")
                return
        }

        // Set up streaming options
        streamOpts := DefaultSSHStreamingOptions(sshReq.CorrelationID)
        streamOpts.ContentType = "application/x-git-upload-pack-result"

        // Handle SSH upload-pack operation
        h.processSSHUploadPack(w, r, sshReq, repo, streamOpts)
}

// HandleSSHReceivePack handles POST /ssh/receive-pack requests (SSH-forwarded git-receive-pack)
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) HandleSSHReceivePack(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
        // Validate SSH request
        sshReq, err := h.ValidateSSHRequest(r, "git-receive-pack")
        if err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Check permissions
        if err := h.CheckSSHPermissions(r.Context(), sshReq); err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Ensure repository exists
        repo, err := h.EnsureSSHRepository(r.Context(), sshReq)
        if err != nil {
                h.errorHandler.HandleError(w, r, err, "ssh_receive_pack")
                return
        }

        // Set up streaming options
        streamOpts := DefaultSSHStreamingOptions(sshReq.CorrelationID)
        streamOpts.ContentType = "application/x-git-receive-pack-result"

        // Handle SSH receive-pack operation
        h.processSSHReceivePack(w, r, sshReq, repo, streamOpts)
}

// processSSHUploadPack processes the SSH upload-pack operation (fetch)
func (h *SSHProtocolHandler) processSSHUploadPack(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, sshReq *SSHRequest, repo git.Repository, opts *SSHStreamingOptions) {
        // Set content type for SSH upload-pack
        w.Header().Set("Content-Type", opts.ContentType)

        // Create SSH protocol writer for streaming
        writer := NewSSHProtocolWriter(w, opts.BufferSize)
        defer func() { _ = writer.Flush() }()

        // Parse SSH protocol headers
        protocolHeaders := ParseSSHGitProtocolHeaders(r)

        // For SSH upload-pack, we need to:
        // 1. Read the want/have negotiation from the request body
        // 2. Generate the appropriate packfile
        // 3. Stream it back to the gateway

        // Read request body for want/have negotiation
        requestBody := r.Body
        if opts.MaxRequestSize > 0 {
                requestBody = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, opts.MaxRequestSize)
        }
        defer func() { _ = r.Body.Close() }()

        // For now, delegate to the existing upload-pack logic
        // This is a simplified implementation - in production, you'd implement full SSH protocol negotiation
        err := h.executeSSHGitCommand(r.Context(), "git-upload-pack", sshReq.RepoPath, requestBody, writer, protocolHeaders)
        if err != nil {
                // Write SSH error format
                if sshErr := writer.WriteSSHError(fmt.Sprintf("upload-pack failed: %v", err)); sshErr != nil {
                        // Log the SSH error writing failure, but don't fail the request further
                        fmt.Printf("Failed to write SSH error: %v\n", sshErr)
                }
                return
        }
}

// processSSHReceivePack processes the SSH receive-pack operation (push)
