                }
        }

        return nil
}

// validateRequestBody validates the request body based on the endpoint
func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateRequestBody(c *gin.Context) error {
        if c.Request.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
                return fmt.Errorf("content-type must be application/json")
        }

        body, err := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to read request body: %w", err)
        }

        // Restore the body for later handlers
        c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(body)))

        // Validate based on endpoint pattern
        switch {
        case strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/files/") && c.Request.Method == "PUT":
                return vf.validateFileOperationRequest(body)
        case strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/files/") && c.Request.Method == "DELETE":
                return vf.validateFileDeleteRequest(body)
        case strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/commits") && c.Request.Method == "POST":
                return vf.validateMultiFileCommitRequest(body)
        case strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/branches") && (c.Request.Method == "POST" || c.Request.Method == "PUT"):
                return vf.validateBranchOperationRequest(body)
        case strings.Contains(c.Request.URL.Path, "/merge") && c.Request.Method == "POST":
                return vf.validateMergeRequest(body)
        }

        return nil
}

// Validation functions for specific request types

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateFileOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req FileOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON: %w", err)
        }

        if err := vf.validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Additional custom validation
        if len(req.Content) > int(vf.config.MaxFileSize) {
                return fmt.Errorf("content size exceeds maximum file size")
        }

        return nil
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateFileDeleteRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req FileDeleteRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON: %w", err)
        }

        return vf.validator.Struct(req)
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateMultiFileCommitRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req MultiFileCommitRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON: %w", err)
        }

        if err := vf.validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("validation failed: %w", err)
        }

        // Validate file count
        if len(req.Files) > vf.config.MaxFilesPerCommit {
                return fmt.Errorf("too many files in commit: %d (max %d)",
                        len(req.Files), vf.config.MaxFilesPerCommit)
        }

        return nil
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateBranchOperationRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req BranchOperationRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON: %w", err)
        }

        return vf.validator.Struct(req)
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateMergeRequest(body []byte) error {
        var req MergeRequest
        if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &req); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON: %w", err)
        }

        return vf.validator.Struct(req)
}

// Path and component validation functions

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validatePathComponent(component, componentType string) error {
        if component == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s cannot be empty", componentType)
        }

        if len(component) > 255 {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s too long (max 255 characters)", componentType)
        }

        // Check for path traversal
        if strings.Contains(component, "..") {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s contains path traversal attempt", componentType)
        }

        // Check for absolute paths
        if strings.HasPrefix(component, "/") {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s cannot start with slash", componentType)
        }

        // Check for invalid characters
        if !vf.pathPattern.MatchString(component) {
                return fmt.Errorf("%s contains invalid characters", componentType)
        }

        return nil
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateFilePath(path string) error {
        if path == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path cannot be empty")
        }

        if len(path) > vf.config.MaxPathLength {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path too long (max %d characters)", vf.config.MaxPathLength)
        }

        // Comprehensive path traversal protection
        if strings.Contains(path, "..") {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path contains path traversal attempt")
        }

        if strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") {
                return fmt.Errorf("file path cannot be absolute")
        }

        // Clean the path if enabled
        if vf.config.EnablePathCleaning {
                cleaned := filepath.Clean(path)
                if cleaned != path {
                        return fmt.Errorf("file path is not clean (would be: %s)", cleaned)
                }
        }

        // Check for Git internal paths
        if strings.HasPrefix(path, ".git/") {
                return fmt.Errorf("access to Git internal paths is forbidden")
        }

        // Validate file extension if enabled
        if vf.config.EnableContentValidation {
                ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path))
                for _, banned := range vf.config.BannedFileExtensions {
                        if ext == banned {
                                return fmt.Errorf("file extension %s is not allowed", ext)
                        }
                }
        }

        return nil
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateBranchName(branch string) error {
        if branch == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name cannot be empty")
        }

        if len(branch) > 255 {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name too long (max 255 characters)")
        }

        if !vf.branchPattern.MatchString(branch) {
                return fmt.Errorf("branch name contains invalid characters")
        }

        // Git-specific branch name rules
        if strings.HasPrefix(branch, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(branch, ".") {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid branch name format")
        }

        return nil
}

func (vf *ValidationFramework) validateRef(ref string) error {
        if ref == "" {
                return fmt.Errorf("ref cannot be empty")
        }

        // Check if it's a commit hash
        if vf.commitPattern.MatchString(ref) {
                return nil
        }

        // Check if it's a valid ref name
        if vf.refPattern.MatchString(ref) {
                return nil
        }

        return fmt.Errorf("invalid ref format")
}

// isAPIEndpoint checks if the path is a Git REST API endpoint
func (vf *ValidationFramework) isAPIEndpoint(path string) bool {
        apiPrefixes := []string{
                "/repos/",
                "/api/repos/",
        }

        for _, prefix := range apiPrefixes {
                if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
                        return true
                }
        }

        return false
}

// Custom validator functions for validator/v10

func validateGitPath(fl validator.FieldLevel) bool {
        path := fl.Field().String()

        // Basic checks
        if path == "" || len(path) > 4096 {
                return false
        }

        // Check for path traversal
        if strings.Contains(path, "..") {
                return false
        }

        // Check for absolute paths
        if strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") {
                return false
        }

        // Check for Git internal paths
        if strings.HasPrefix(path, ".git/") {
                return false
        }

        return true
}

func validateGitBranch(fl validator.FieldLevel) bool {
        branch := fl.Field().String()

        if branch == "" || len(branch) > 255 {
                return false
        }

        // Basic Git branch name validation
        if strings.HasPrefix(branch, "-") || strings.HasSuffix(branch, ".") {
                return false
        }

        // Check for invalid characters (simplified)
        invalidChars := []string{" ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "~", "^", ":", "?", "*", "[", "\\"}
        for _, char := range invalidChars {
                if strings.Contains(branch, char) {
                        return false
                }
        }

        return true
}

func validateGitRef(fl validator.FieldLevel) bool {
        ref := fl.Field().String()

        if ref == "" {
                return false
        }

        // Check if it's a commit hash (7-40 hex characters)
        if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(`^[a-f0-9]{7,40}$`, ref); matched {
                return true
        }

        // Check if it's a valid ref name (simplified)
        if matched, _ := regexp.MatchString(`^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]+$`, ref); matched {
                return true
        }

        return false
}

package server

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/signal"
        "syscall"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/api"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/observability"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/permissions"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/protocol"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/repository"
        "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
        "go.uber.org/zap"
)

// ginContextMiddleware stores the Gin context in the request context for protocol handlers
func ginContextMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
        return func(c *gin.Context) {
                // Store Gin context directly in request context for protocol handlers to access
                c.Request = c.Request.WithContext(context.WithValue(c.Request.Context(), protocol.GinContextKey{}, c))
                c.Next()
        }
}

// Server represents the HTTP server with integrated observability
type Server struct {
        server               *http.Server
        config               *config.Config
        logger               *logging.Logger
        observabilityManager *observability.Manager
}

// New creates a new HTTP server instance with observability
func New(cfg *config.Config) (*Server, error) {
        // Note: Simple cache initializes itself automatically on first use

        // Create permission client
        permConfig := permissions.DefaultConfig()
        permConfig.APIServiceURL = "http://localhost:8082" // Use mock permission service for testing
        permClient, err := permissions.NewPermissionClient(permConfig)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create permission client: %w", err)
        }

        // Initialize observability manager
        obsManager, err := observability.NewManager(cfg, permClient, "1.0.0")
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create observability manager: %w", err)
        }

        return &Server{
                config:               cfg,
                logger:               obsManager.GetLogger(),
                observabilityManager: obsManager,
        }, nil
}

// Start initializes and starts the HTTP server
func (s *Server) Start() error {
        // Create router
        router := s.SetupRouter()

        // Create HTTP server
        s.server = &http.Server{
                Addr:         fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.config.Server.Host, s.config.Server.Port),
                Handler:      router,
                ReadTimeout:  s.config.Server.ReadTimeout,
                WriteTimeout: s.config.Server.WriteTimeout,
                IdleTimeout:  s.config.Server.IdleTimeout,
        }

        // Start server in a goroutine
        go func() {
                s.logger.Info("Server starting",
                        zap.String("address", s.server.Addr),
                        zap.String("basePath", s.config.Server.BasePath))

                if err := s.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
                        s.logger.Error("Server failed to start", zap.Error(err))
                }
        }()

        // Wait for shutdown signal
        quit := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
        signal.Notify(quit, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
        <-quit

        s.logger.Info("Received shutdown signal, shutting down gracefully")
        return nil
}

// Shutdown gracefully shuts down the server
func (s *Server) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) error {
        if s.server == nil {
                return nil
        }
        s.logger.Info("Shutting down HTTP server...")
        return s.server.Shutdown(ctx)
}

// GetAddr returns the server's listening address
func (s *Server) GetAddr() string {
        if s.server == nil {
                return ""
        }
        return s.server.Addr
}

// SetupRouter configures the HTTP router with observability middleware and routes
func (s *Server) SetupRouter() *gin.Engine {
        // Set Gin to release mode for production
        gin.SetMode(gin.ReleaseMode)

        router := gin.New()

        // Add core middleware first
        router.Use(gin.Logger())   // Request logging
        router.Use(gin.Recovery()) // Panic recovery

        // Setup observability middleware and routes
        s.observabilityManager.SetupMiddleware(router)
        s.observabilityManager.SetupRoutes(router)

        // Keep the original simple health check for backward compatibility
        router.GET(s.config.Server.HealthCheckPath, s.healthCheck)

        // Mount API routes under base path if configured
        if s.config.Server.BasePath != "/" {
                apiGroup := router.Group(s.config.Server.BasePath)
                s.setupAPIRoutesOnGroup(apiGroup)
        } else {
                s.setupAPIRoutesOnGroup(router.Group("/"))
        }

        return router
}

// setupAPIRoutesOnGroup configures API routes on a router group
func (s *Server) setupAPIRoutesOnGroup(group *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Basic API info endpoint
        group.GET("/", func(c *gin.Context) {
                c.Header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                c.Status(http.StatusOK)

                // Record metrics for this request
                s.observabilityManager.RecordHTTPRequest("GET", "/", 200, time.Since(time.Now()), 0, 0)

                _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(c.Writer, `{
                        "service": "git-executor",
                        "version": "1.0.0",
                        "status": "running",
                        "timestamp": "%s"
                }`, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
        })

        // Setup REST API routes
        s.setupRestAPIRoutes(group)

        // Setup Git protocol routes
        s.setupProtocolRoutes(group)
}

// setupRestAPIRoutes configures REST API routes for Git operations
func (s *Server) setupRestAPIRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Initialize permission client for REST API routes
        permConfig := permissions.DefaultConfig()
        permConfig.APIServiceURL = "http://localhost:8082" // Use mock permission service for testing
        permClient, err := permissions.NewPermissionClient(permConfig)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create permission client for REST API", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Create path configuration for handlers
        pathConfig, err := repository.NewPathConfig(s.config.Git.RepoRoot)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create path config", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize handlers for REST API endpoints
        treeHandler, err := protocol.NewTreeHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create tree handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        blobHandler, err := protocol.NewBlobHandler(pathConfig, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create blob handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        commitsHandler, err := protocol.NewCommitsHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create commits handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize diff handler for enhanced Git operations
        diffHandler, err := protocol.NewDiffHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create diff handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize file operations handler for server-side Git REST APIs
        fileOpsHandler, err := protocol.NewFileOperationsHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create file operations handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize branch operations handler for branch management APIs
        branchOpsHandler, err := protocol.NewBranchOperationsHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create branch operations handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize repository state handler for repository management APIs
        repoStateHandler, err := protocol.NewRepositoryStateHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                s.logger.Error("Failed to create repository state handler", zap.Error(err))
                return
        }

        // Initialize JSON response middleware for proper error handling
        jsonResponseMiddleware := api.NewJSONResponseMiddleware(s.logger, "v1")

        // Git diff endpoints with enhanced middleware
        reposGroup := router.Group("/repos")
        reposGroup.Use(ginContextMiddleware()) // Add chi compatibility middleware
        reposGroup.Use(jsonResponseMiddleware.RequestMetadataMiddleware())
        reposGroup.Use(jsonResponseMiddleware.ErrorHandler())
        {
                ownerGroup := reposGroup.Group("/:owner")
                {
                        repoGroup := ownerGroup.Group("/:repo")
                        {
                                // Tree endpoint
                                repoGroup.GET("/tree", gin.WrapF(treeHandler.HandleTreeAPI))
                                // Blob endpoint
                                repoGroup.GET("/blob", blobHandler.HandleBlobAPIGin)
                                // Commits endpoint
                                repoGroup.GET("/commits", gin.WrapF(commitsHandler.HandleCommitsAPI))

                                // Diff endpoints
                                diffGroup := repoGroup.Group("/diff")
                                {
                                        // Compare two commits
                                        diffGroup.GET("/commits/:base/:head", gin.WrapF(diffHandler.HandleCommitDiff))
                                        // Compare two branches
                                        diffGroup.GET("/branches/:base/:head", gin.WrapF(diffHandler.HandleBranchDiff))
                                        // Compare specific file between two references
                                        diffGroup.GET("/file", gin.WrapF(diffHandler.HandleFileDiff))
                                }
                                // Patch endpoints
                                patchGroup := repoGroup.Group("/patch")
                                {
                                        // Generate Git patch format for commit range
                                        patchGroup.GET("/:base/:head", gin.WrapF(diffHandler.HandlePatch))
                                }

                                // File operations endpoints (server-side Git REST APIs)
                                filesGroup := repoGroup.Group("/files")
                                {
                                        // PUT endpoint for creating/updating files
                                        filesGroup.PUT("/*path", fileOpsHandler.HandleFilePUT)
                                        // DELETE endpoint for deleting files
                                        filesGroup.DELETE("/*path", fileOpsHandler.HandleFileDELETE)
                                }

                                // Multi-file commit endpoints
                                repoGroup.POST("/commits", fileOpsHandler.HandleMultiFileCommit)

                                // Branch operations endpoints
                                branchesGroup := repoGroup.Group("/branches")
                                {
                                        // POST endpoint for creating branches
                                        branchesGroup.POST("", branchOpsHandler.HandleCreateBranch)
                                        // PATCH endpoint for updating branches
                                        branchesGroup.PATCH("/*branch", branchOpsHandler.HandleUpdateBranch)
                                        // DELETE endpoint for deleting branches
                                        branchesGroup.DELETE("/*branch", branchOpsHandler.HandleDeleteBranch)
                                }

                                // Repository state endpoints
                                repoGroup.GET("/state", repoStateHandler.HandleGetRepositoryState)
                                repoGroup.GET("/head", repoStateHandler.HandleGetRepositoryHead)
                                repoGroup.GET("/references", repoStateHandler.HandleGetRepositoryReferences)
                        }
                }
        }
}

// healthCheck handles health check requests
func (s *Server) healthCheck(c *gin.Context) {
        c.Header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        c.Status(http.StatusOK)
        _, _ = fmt.Fprintf(c.Writer, `{"status": "healthy", "timestamp": "%s"}`, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
}

// setupProtocolRoutes configures Git Smart HTTP protocol routes
func (s *Server) setupProtocolRoutes(router *gin.RouterGroup) {
        // Initialize permission client (for now, we'll create a basic config)
        // TODO: This should be properly configured with actual API service URL
        permConfig := permissions.DefaultConfig()
        permConfig.APIServiceURL = "http://localhost:8082" // Use mock permission service for testing
        permClient, err := permissions.NewPermissionClient(permConfig)
        if err != nil {
                // For now, log the error and continue without Smart HTTP
                fmt.Printf("⚠️  Warning: Failed to initialize permission client: %v\n", err)
                return
        }

        // Initialize upload-pack handler (fetch operations)
        uploadPackHandler, err := protocol.NewUploadPackHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                // For now, log the error and continue without Smart HTTP
                fmt.Printf("⚠️  Warning: Failed to initialize upload-pack handler: %v\n", err)
                return
        }

        // Initialize receive-pack handler (push operations)
        receivePackHandler, err := protocol.NewReceivePackHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                // For now, log the error and continue without receive-pack
                fmt.Printf("⚠️  Warning: Failed to initialize receive-pack handler: %v\n", err)
                // Continue with upload-pack only
        }

        // Initialize SSH protocol handler (SSH-forwarded operations)
        sshHandler, err := protocol.NewSSHProtocolHandler(s.config, permClient)
        if err != nil {
                // For now, log the error and continue without SSH support
                fmt.Printf("⚠️  Warning: Failed to initialize SSH protocol handler: %v\n", err)
                // Continue without SSH support
        }

        // Git Smart HTTP routes for both fetch and push operations (executor endpoints)
        ownerRepoGroup := router.Group("/:owner/:repo")
        ownerRepoGroup.Use(ginContextMiddleware()) // Add chi compatibility middleware
        {
                // Fetch operations (git clone, git fetch)
                // GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
                ownerRepoGroup.GET("/info/refs", func(c *gin.Context) {
                        service := c.Query("service")
                        switch service {
                        case "git-upload-pack":
                                uploadPackHandler.HandleInfoRefs(c.Writer, c.Request)
                        case "git-receive-pack":
                                if receivePackHandler != nil {
                                        receivePackHandler.HandleInfoRefs(c.Writer, c.Request)
                                } else {
                                        c.Status(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
                                        _, _ = c.Writer.Write([]byte("Receive-pack service not available"))
                                }
                        default:
                                c.Status(http.StatusBadRequest)
                                _, _ = c.Writer.Write([]byte("Invalid service parameter"))
                        }
                })

                // POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git-upload-pack
                ownerRepoGroup.POST("/git-upload-pack", gin.WrapF(uploadPackHandler.HandleUploadPack))

                // Push operations (git push)
                // POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git-receive-pack
                if receivePackHandler != nil {
                        ownerRepoGroup.POST("/git-receive-pack", gin.WrapF(receivePackHandler.HandleReceivePack))
                }
        }

        // SSH protocol routes for SSH-forwarded Git operations
        if sshHandler != nil {
                sshGroup := router.Group("/ssh/:owner/:repo")
                sshGroup.Use(ginContextMiddleware()) // Add chi compatibility middleware
                {
                        // SSH-forwarded fetch operations
                        // POST /ssh/{owner}/{repo}/upload-pack
                        sshGroup.POST("/upload-pack", gin.WrapF(sshHandler.HandleSSHUploadPack))

                        // SSH-forwarded push operations
                        // POST /ssh/{owner}/{repo}/receive-pack
                        sshGroup.POST("/receive-pack", gin.WrapF(sshHandler.HandleSSHReceivePack))
                }
        }
}

// Package streaming provides efficient streaming mechanisms for Git operations
// to handle large repository data transfers without loading everything into memory.
// Optimized for gateway forwarding patterns.
package streaming

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "sync"

        gogit "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing"
        "github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object"
)

// GitStreamer provides streaming functionality for Git operations
type GitStreamer struct {
        repo *gogit.Repository
}

// NewGitStreamer creates a new GitStreamer for the given repository
func NewGitStreamer(repo *gogit.Repository) *GitStreamer {
        return &GitStreamer{
                repo: repo,
        }
}

// PackfileStreamRequest represents a request for streaming a packfile
type PackfileStreamRequest struct {
        Wants        []string // Object hashes that the client wants
        Haves        []string // Object hashes that the client already has
        Capabilities []string // Client capabilities
}

// StreamPackfile streams a packfile to the provided writer using efficient streaming
// without loading all objects into memory at once
func (gs *GitStreamer) StreamPackfile(ctx context.Context, req *PackfileStreamRequest, w io.Writer) error {
        // Validate inputs
        if gs.repo == nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("repository is nil")
        }
        if req == nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("request is nil")
        }
        if w == nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("writer is nil")
        }
        if len(req.Wants) == 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("no objects requested")
        }

        // Create a pipe for streaming data
        pipeReader, pipeWriter := io.Pipe()

        // Channel for error communication
        errChan := make(chan error, 1)

        // Start packfile generation in a goroutine
        go func() {
                // defer pipeWriter.Close()
                // defer _ = pipeReader.Close()
                defer func() {
                        _ = pipeWriter.Close() // 리턴값 무시. 함수에 넣어줘야함. defer 는 바로실행되는 function이어야함.
                }()
                // defer = 함수탈출할때 실행되는것.
                err := gs.generatePackfileStream(ctx, req, pipeWriter)
                errChan <- err
        }()

        // Copy from pipe to destination writer (gateway response)
        _, copyErr := io.Copy(w, pipeReader)

        // Wait for generation to complete and get any errors
        generateErr := <-errChan

        // Return the first error encountered
        if generateErr != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("packfile generation failed: %w", generateErr)
        }
        if copyErr != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("packfile streaming failed: %w", copyErr)
        }

        return nil
}

// generatePackfileStream generates packfile data and streams it through the pipe
func (gs *GitStreamer) generatePackfileStream(ctx context.Context, req *PackfileStreamRequest, w io.Writer) error {
        // Create a packet line writer for the stream
        pktWriter := &StreamingPktLineWriter{w: w}

        // Send negotiation response
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine("NAK"); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to write NAK: %w", err)
        }

        // Send packfile start indicator
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine("0008NAK\n"); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Flush negotiation phase
        if err := pktWriter.flush(); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Stream objects without collecting them all in memory
        return gs.streamObjects(ctx, req, pktWriter)
}

// streamObjects streams Git objects one by one without accumulating in memory
func (gs *GitStreamer) streamObjects(ctx context.Context, req *PackfileStreamRequest, pktWriter *StreamingPktLineWriter) error {
        // Track processed objects to avoid duplicates
        processed := make(map[plumbing.Hash]bool)
        objectCount := 0

        // Send simplified packfile header
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine("# streaming pack\n"); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // Stream each wanted object and its dependencies
        for _, want := range req.Wants {
                hash := plumbing.NewHash(want)

                // Check if client already has this object
                if gs.clientHasObject(hash.String(), req.Haves) {
                        continue
                }

                // Stream this object and its dependencies
                err := gs.streamObjectTree(ctx, hash, processed, req.Haves, pktWriter, &objectCount)
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to stream object tree for %s: %w", want, err)
                }

                // Check for cancellation
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done():
                        return ctx.Err()
                default:
                        // Continue processing
                }
        }

        // Send packfile summary
        summary := fmt.Sprintf("# pack completed: %d objects streamed\n", objectCount)
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(summary); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        // End with flush packet
        return pktWriter.flush()
}

// streamObjectTree streams an object and its dependencies without loading everything into memory
func (gs *GitStreamer) streamObjectTree(ctx context.Context, hash plumbing.Hash, processed map[plumbing.Hash]bool, haves []string, pktWriter *StreamingPktLineWriter, objectCount *int) error {
        // Skip if already processed or client has it
        if processed[hash] || gs.clientHasObject(hash.String(), haves) {
                return nil
        }

        // Mark as processed
        processed[hash] = true

        // Try to get the object
        obj, err := gs.repo.Object(plumbing.AnyObject, hash)
        if err != nil {
                // Object not found - skip silently (might be a partial clone scenario)
                return nil
        }

        // Stream this object
        objectInfo := fmt.Sprintf("object %s %s\n", hash.String(), obj.Type().String())
        if err := pktWriter.writeLine(objectInfo); err != nil {
                return err
        }

        *objectCount++

        // For commits, recursively stream parent commits
        if obj.Type() == plumbing.CommitObject {
                commit, err := object.GetCommit(gs.repo.Storer, hash)
                if err == nil {
                        // Stream parent commits (but limit depth to prevent memory issues)
                        for _, parentHash := range commit.ParentHashes {
                                // Recursive call for parent
                                err = gs.streamObjectTree(ctx, parentHash, processed, haves, pktWriter, objectCount)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }

                                // Check for context cancellation
                                select {
                                case <-ctx.Done():
                                        return ctx.Err()
                                default:
                                        // Continue
                                }

                                // Safety limit to prevent infinite recursion
                                if *objectCount > 10000 {
                                        return fmt.Errorf("object count limit reached (10000) - stopping to prevent memory exhaustion")
                                }
                        }
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// clientHasObject checks if the client already has the specified object
func (gs *GitStreamer) clientHasObject(objectHash string, haves []string) bool {
        for _, have := range haves {
                if have == objectHash {
                        return true
                }
        }
        return false
}

// StreamingPktLineWriter provides packet line writing for streaming operations
type StreamingPktLineWriter struct {
        w  io.Writer
        mu sync.Mutex // Protect concurrent writes
}

// writeLine writes a Git protocol packet line
func (p *StreamingPktLineWriter) writeLine(data string) error {
        p.mu.Lock()
        defer p.mu.Unlock()

        // Calculate packet length (4 bytes for length + data)
        length := len(data) + 4
        line := fmt.Sprintf("%04x%s", length, data)

        _, err := p.w.Write([]byte(line))
        return err
}

// flush writes a flush packet (0000)
func (p *StreamingPktLineWriter) flush() error {
        p.mu.Lock()
        defer p.mu.Unlock()

        _, err := p.w.Write([]byte("0000"))
        return err
}

// StreamRefs streams repository references for info/refs endpoint
func (gs *GitStreamer) StreamRefs(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer, capabilities []string) error {
        pktWriter := &StreamingPktLineWriter{w: w}

        // Get all references from the repository
        refs, err := gs.repo.References()
        if err != nil {
                // Empty repository case - send dummy reference
                capabilities := "multi_ack thin-pack side-band side-band-64k ofs-delta shallow no-progress include-tag multi_ack_detailed no-done symref=HEAD:refs/heads/main agent=git/collabops-git-executor"
                line := fmt.Sprintf("0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 capabilities^{}\x00%s\n", capabilities)
                return pktWriter.writeLine(line)
        }

        firstRef := true
        refCount := 0

        // Stream each reference
        err = refs.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done():
                        return ctx.Err()
                default:
                }

                // Format reference line
                var line string
                if firstRef {
                        // First reference includes capabilities
                        capabilities := "multi_ack thin-pack side-band side-band-64k ofs-delta shallow no-progress include-tag multi_ack_detailed no-done symref=HEAD:refs/heads/main agent=git/collabops-git-executor"
                        line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s\x00%s\n", ref.Hash().String(), ref.Name().String(), capabilities)
                        firstRef = false
                } else {
                        // Subsequent references without capabilities
                        line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s\n", ref.Hash().String(), ref.Name().String())
                }

                refCount++
                return pktWriter.writeLine(line)
        })

        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to stream references: %w", err)
        }

        // If no refs were streamed (empty repo), send dummy reference
        if refCount == 0 {
                capabilities := "multi_ack thin-pack side-band side-band-64k ofs-delta shallow no-progress include-tag multi_ack_detailed no-done symref=HEAD:refs/heads/main agent=git/collabops-git-executor"
                dummyLine := fmt.Sprintf("0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 capabilities^{}\x00%s\n", capabilities)
                if err := pktWriter.writeLine(dummyLine); err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }

        // End with flush packet
        return pktWriter.flush()
}

package testutils

import (
        "bytes"
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "net/http/httptest"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strings"
        "sync"
        "testing"
        "time"

        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/config"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/logging"
        "github.com/collabops/git-executor/internal/server"
        "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
        "go.uber.org/zap/zaptest"
)

// IntegrationTestHarness provides comprehensive end-to-end testing utilities
type IntegrationTestHarness struct {
        // Core components
        Config           *config.Config
        Logger           *logging.Logger
        Server           *server.Server
        PermissionClient *MockPermissionClient

        // Test infrastructure
        TempDir    string
        TestServer *httptest.Server
        TestRepos  map[string]*TestRepository

        // Synchronization
        mu sync.RWMutex

        // Cleanup functions
        cleanupFuncs []func() error
}

// TestRepository represents a test Git repository with known state
type TestRepository struct {
        Name    string
        Path    string
        Refs    map[string]string // ref name -> commit hash
        Commits []TestCommit
        Files   map[string]string // file path -> content
        IsBare  bool
}

// TestCommit represents a test commit with known metadata
type TestCommit struct {
        Hash      string
        Message   string
        Author    string
        Timestamp time.Time
        Files     []string
}

// GitClientSimulator simulates Git client requests for testing
type GitClientSimulator struct {
        BaseURL    string
        UserID     string
        UserAgent  string
        HTTPClient *http.Client
}

// MockPermissionClient provides controllable permission responses for testing
type MockPermissionClient struct {
        mu            sync.RWMutex
        Permissions   map[string]bool // "user:repo" -> allowed
        ShouldError   bool
        ErrorResponse error
        ResponseDelay time.Duration
        CallLog       []PermissionCall
}

// PermissionCall represents a logged permission check call
type PermissionCall struct {
        UserID    string
        RepoOwner string
        RepoName  string
        Operation string
        Timestamp time.Time
        Result    bool
        Error     error
}

// NewIntegrationTestHarness creates a new integration test harness
func NewIntegrationTestHarness(t *testing.T) *IntegrationTestHarness {
        tempDir := t.TempDir()

        zapLogger := zaptest.NewLogger(t)
        logger := &logging.Logger{Logger: zapLogger}

        cfg := &config.Config{
                Server: config.ServerConfig{
                        Host:         "localhost",
                        Port:         0, // Let the test server choose a port
                        ReadTimeout:  30 * time.Second,
                        WriteTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
                        BasePath:     "/",
                },
                Git: config.GitConfig{
                        RepoRoot: tempDir,
                },
                Logging: config.LoggingConfig{
                        Level:  "debug",
                        Format: "text",
                        Output: "stdout",
                },
        }

        permClient := &MockPermissionClient{
                Permissions: make(map[string]bool),
                CallLog:     make([]PermissionCall, 0),
        }

        harness := &IntegrationTestHarness{
                Config:           cfg,
                Logger:           logger,
                PermissionClient: permClient,
                TempDir:          tempDir,
                TestRepos:        make(map[string]*TestRepository),
                cleanupFuncs:     make([]func() error, 0),
        }

        // Initialize server
        srv, err := server.New(cfg)
        if err != nil {
                t.Fatalf("failed to create server: %v", err)
        }
        harness.Server = srv

        // Start test HTTP server
        // Note: For testing, we'll access the router setup method directly
        // In production, this would be handled by the server's Start() method
        router := srv.SetupRouter()
        harness.TestServer = httptest.NewServer(router)
        harness.cleanupFuncs = append(harness.cleanupFuncs, func() error {
                harness.TestServer.Close()
                return nil
        })

        return harness
}

// CreateTestRepository creates a test repository with known state
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) CreateTestRepository(name string, owner string) *TestRepository {
        h.mu.Lock()
        defer h.mu.Unlock()

        repoKey := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", owner, name)
        repoPath := filepath.Join(h.TempDir, owner, fmt.Sprintf("%s.git", name))

        // Create repository directory
        err := os.MkdirAll(repoPath, 0755)
        if err != nil {
                panic(fmt.Sprintf("failed to create test repo directory: %v", err))
        }

        // Create basic Git repository structure
        dirs := []string{"objects", "refs/heads", "refs/tags"}
        for _, dir := range dirs {
                dirPath := filepath.Join(repoPath, dir)
                err := os.MkdirAll(dirPath, 0755)
                if err != nil {
                        panic(fmt.Sprintf("failed to create repo subdirectory %s: %v", dir, err))
                }
        }

        // Create basic Git files
        files := map[string]string{
                "HEAD":        "ref: refs/heads/main\n",
                "description": "Test repository for integration testing\n",
                "config":      "[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n\tfilemode = true\n\tbare = true\n",
        }

        for filename, content := range files {
                filePath := filepath.Join(repoPath, filename)
                err := os.WriteFile(filePath, []byte(content), 0644)
                if err != nil {
                        panic(fmt.Sprintf("failed to create repo file %s: %v", filename, err))
                }
        }

        testRepo := &TestRepository{
                Name:    repoKey,
                Path:    repoPath,
                Refs:    make(map[string]string),
                Commits: make([]TestCommit, 0),
                Files:   make(map[string]string),
                IsBare:  true,
        }

        h.TestRepos[repoKey] = testRepo
        return testRepo
}

// GrantPermission grants permission for a user to access a repository
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) GrantPermission(userID, repoOwner, repoName string) {
        h.PermissionClient.mu.Lock()
        defer h.PermissionClient.mu.Unlock()

        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s/%s", userID, repoOwner, repoName)
        h.PermissionClient.Permissions[key] = true
}

// DenyPermission denies permission for a user to access a repository
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) DenyPermission(userID, repoOwner, repoName string) {
        h.PermissionClient.mu.Lock()
        defer h.PermissionClient.mu.Unlock()

        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s/%s", userID, repoOwner, repoName)
        h.PermissionClient.Permissions[key] = false
}

// NewGitClientSimulator creates a new Git client simulator
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) NewGitClientSimulator(userID string) *GitClientSimulator {
        return &GitClientSimulator{
                BaseURL:    h.TestServer.URL,
                UserID:     userID,
                UserAgent:  "git/2.40.0 (test-client)",
                HTTPClient: h.TestServer.Client(),
        }
}

// SimulateGitClone simulates a git clone operation
func (g *GitClientSimulator) SimulateGitClone(owner, repo string) (*http.Response, error) {
        // Step 1: Get info/refs
        infoRefsURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack", g.BaseURL, owner, repo)
        req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", infoRefsURL, nil)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create info/refs request: %w", err)
        }

        req.Header.Set("X-USER-ID", g.UserID)
        req.Header.Set("User-Agent", g.UserAgent)
        req.Header.Set("X-REQUEST-ID", fmt.Sprintf("clone-req-%d", time.Now().Unix()))

        resp, err := g.HTTPClient.Do(req)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute info/refs request: %w", err)
        }

        // For now, just return the info/refs response
        // In a more complete implementation, we'd parse the response and make the upload-pack request
        return resp, nil
}

// SimulateGitFetch simulates a git fetch operation with specific wants/haves
func (g *GitClientSimulator) SimulateGitFetch(owner, repo string, wants, haves []string) (*http.Response, error) {
        // Create upload-pack request body
        var requestBody bytes.Buffer

        // Write want lines
        for _, want := range wants {
                line := fmt.Sprintf("want %s multi_ack side-band-64k ofs-delta agent=%s\n", want, g.UserAgent)
                requestBody.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%04x%s", len(line)+4, line))
        }

        // Write have lines
        for _, have := range haves {
                line := fmt.Sprintf("have %s\n", have)
                requestBody.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%04x%s", len(line)+4, line))
        }

        // Write done
        requestBody.WriteString("0009done\n")
        requestBody.WriteString("0000") // Flush packet

        uploadPackURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s/git-upload-pack", g.BaseURL, owner, repo)
        req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", uploadPackURL, &requestBody)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create upload-pack request: %w", err)
        }

        req.Header.Set("X-USER-ID", g.UserID)
        req.Header.Set("User-Agent", g.UserAgent)
        req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-git-upload-pack-request")
        req.Header.Set("X-REQUEST-ID", fmt.Sprintf("fetch-req-%d", time.Now().Unix()))

        return g.HTTPClient.Do(req)
}

// ValidateProtocolResponse validates that a response follows Git Smart HTTP protocol
func (g *GitClientSimulator) ValidateProtocolResponse(resp *http.Response, expectedContentType string) error {
        // Check content type
        contentType := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")
        if !strings.Contains(contentType, expectedContentType) {
                return fmt.Errorf("invalid content type: expected %s, got %s", expectedContentType, contentType)
        }

        // Read and validate pkt-line format
        body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
        if err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("failed to read response body: %w", err)
        }

        return g.validatePktLineFormat(body)
}

// validatePktLineFormat validates that the response follows pkt-line format
func (g *GitClientSimulator) validatePktLineFormat(data []byte) error {
        reader := bytes.NewReader(data)

        for {
                // Read 4-byte length header
                lengthBytes := make([]byte, 4)
                n, err := reader.Read(lengthBytes)
                if err == io.EOF {
                        break
                }
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to read pkt-line length: %w", err)
                }
                if n != 4 {
                        return fmt.Errorf("incomplete pkt-line length header")
                }

                // Parse length
                lengthStr := string(lengthBytes)
                if lengthStr == "0000" {
                        // Flush packet
                        continue
                }

                // Parse hex length
                var length int
                _, err = fmt.Sscanf(lengthStr, "%04x", &length)
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid pkt-line length format: %s", lengthStr)
                }

                // Validate length bounds
                if length < 4 || length > 65520 {
                        return fmt.Errorf("invalid pkt-line length: %d", length)
                }

                // Read the data portion
                dataLength := length - 4
                dataBytes := make([]byte, dataLength)
                n, err = reader.Read(dataBytes)
                if err != nil {
                        return fmt.Errorf("failed to read pkt-line data: %w", err)
                }
                if n != dataLength {
                        return fmt.Errorf("incomplete pkt-line data")
                }
        }

        return nil
}

// GetPermissionCallLog returns the log of permission calls made during testing
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) GetPermissionCallLog() []PermissionCall {
        h.PermissionClient.mu.RLock()
        defer h.PermissionClient.mu.RUnlock()

        // Return a copy to avoid race conditions
        calls := make([]PermissionCall, len(h.PermissionClient.CallLog))
        copy(calls, h.PermissionClient.CallLog)
        return calls
}

// Cleanup cleans up all test resources
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) Cleanup() error {
        var errors []error

        for _, cleanup := range h.cleanupFuncs {
                if err := cleanup(); err != nil {
                        errors = append(errors, err)
                }
        }

        if len(errors) > 0 {
                return fmt.Errorf("cleanup errors: %v", errors)
        }

        return nil
}

// Mock implementation of PermissionClient interface
func (m *MockPermissionClient) CheckRepositoryAccess(ctx context.Context, userID, repoOwner, repoName, operation string) (bool, error) {
        m.mu.Lock()
        defer m.mu.Unlock()

        // Add delay if configured
        if m.ResponseDelay > 0 {
                time.Sleep(m.ResponseDelay)
        }

        // Return configured error if set
        if m.ShouldError {
                call := PermissionCall{
                        UserID:    userID,
                        RepoOwner: repoOwner,
                        RepoName:  repoName,
                        Operation: operation,
                        Timestamp: time.Now(),
                        Result:    false,
                        Error:     m.ErrorResponse,
                }
                m.CallLog = append(m.CallLog, call)
                return false, m.ErrorResponse
        }

        // Check permission
        key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s/%s", userID, repoOwner, repoName)
        allowed, exists := m.Permissions[key]
        if !exists {
                allowed = false // Default deny
        }

        call := PermissionCall{
                UserID:    userID,
                RepoOwner: repoOwner,
                RepoName:  repoName,
                Operation: operation,
                Timestamp: time.Now(),
                Result:    allowed,
                Error:     nil,
        }
        m.CallLog = append(m.CallLog, call)

        return allowed, nil
}

// WaitForCondition waits for a condition to be met or times out
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) WaitForCondition(condition func() bool, timeout time.Duration, message string) error {
        ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
        defer cancel()

        ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
        defer ticker.Stop()

        for {
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done():
                        return fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for condition: %s", message)
                case <-ticker.C:
                        if condition() {
                                return nil
                        }
                }
        }
}

// AssertEndToEndFlow validates a complete end-to-end Git operation flow
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) AssertEndToEndFlow(t *testing.T, userID, owner, repo string) {
        // Create test repository
        testRepo := h.CreateTestRepository(repo, owner)
        require.NotNil(t, testRepo)

        // Grant permission
        h.GrantPermission(userID, owner, repo)

        // Create Git client simulator
        client := h.NewGitClientSimulator(userID)

        // Simulate git clone (info/refs step)
        resp, err := client.SimulateGitClone(owner, repo)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.StatusCode)
        defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

        // Validate protocol compliance
        err = client.ValidateProtocolResponse(resp, "application/x-git-upload-pack-advertisement")
        require.NoError(t, err)

        // Verify permission was checked
        calls := h.GetPermissionCallLog()
        require.NotEmpty(t, calls)

        lastCall := calls[len(calls)-1]
        require.Equal(t, userID, lastCall.UserID)
        require.Equal(t, owner, lastCall.RepoOwner)
        require.Equal(t, repo, lastCall.RepoName)
        require.True(t, lastCall.Result)
}

// BenchmarkEndToEndPerformance benchmarks end-to-end operation performance
func (h *IntegrationTestHarness) BenchmarkEndToEndPerformance(b *testing.B, operation string) {
        // Setup
        userID := "bench-user"
        owner := "bench-owner"
        repo := "bench-repo"

        h.CreateTestRepository(repo, owner)
        h.GrantPermission(userID, owner, repo)
        client := h.NewGitClientSimulator(userID)

        b.ResetTimer()
        b.RunParallel(func(pb *testing.PB) {
                for pb.Next() {
                        resp, err := client.SimulateGitClone(owner, repo)
                        if err != nil {
                                b.Errorf("Benchmark failed: %v", err)
                                return
                        }
                        _ = resp.Body.Close()
                }
        })
}
